II Chronicles 14:6#1 Alia exempl..en: “While we possess the land” instead of “before the land we shall rule”.

0852.1.5.la: Sic Comp. (cum κυριεύομεν τῆς γ.), Ald., Codd. III, 19 (cum κυριεύωμεν ἡμεῖς τῆς γ.), 44 (cum κυριεύσωμεν), 55 (cum κυριεύσομεν), 60, alii (inter quos 93 (cum κυριεύσομεν τῆς γ.) 108 (ut Comp.)). Hieron. παραφράζει: _donec a bellis quieta sunt omnia._
0852.1.5.en: So Comp. (with κυριεύομεν τῆς γ.), Ald., Codd. III, 19 (with κυριεύωμεν ἡμεῖς τῆς γ.), 44 (with κυριεύσωμεν), 55 (with κυριεύσομεν), 60, and others (among them 93 (with κυριεύσομεν τῆς γ.) 108 (as Comp.)). Hieron. παραφράζει:“_until all things are at rest from wars._”

II Chronicles 14:6#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ εὐώδωσεν ἡμῖν. Alia exempl. καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν καὶ κατεύθυναν.^6
II Chronicles 14:6#2 Alia exempl..n: „Sie bauten und hatten Erfolg“ statt „er ließ es uns gelingen“.
II Chronicles 14:6#2 Alia exempl..en: “They built and prospered” instead of “he granted us success”.

0852.1.6.la: Sic Comp. (cum κατηύθυναν), Codd. 19 (cum κατηύθυνον), 93, 108 (cum καθηύθυναν).
0852.1.6.en: So Comp. (with κατηύθυναν), Codd. 19 (with κατηύθυνον), 93, 108 (with καθηύθυναν).

II Chronicles 14:7#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. πολεμισταὶ δυνάμεως. Alia exempl. υἱοὶ δυνάμεως.^7

II Chronicles 14:10#0 Ἄλλος.unitText: Ο΄. οὐκ ἀδυνατεῖ (Ἄλλος· οὐκ ἔστιν^8) παρὰ σοί.
II Chronicles 14:10#0 Ἄλλος.n: „Bei dir ist nicht“ ersetzt „bei dir ist unmöglich“; der Vergleich wird anders konstruiert.
II Chronicles 14:10#0 Ἄλλος.en: “There is not with you” replaces “is impossible with you”; the comparison is constructed differently.

II Chronicles 14:10#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐν ὀλίγοις. Alia exempl. ἢ ἐν ὀλίγοις οἷς οὐκ ἔστιν ἰσχύς.^9
II Chronicles 14:10#1 Alia exempl..n: Die Wenigen werden ausdrücklich als kraftlos bezeichnet.
II Chronicles 14:10#1 Alia exempl..en: The few are explicitly described as lacking strength.

II Chronicles 14:10#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. κατίσχυσον ἡμᾶς. Alia exempl. βοήθησον ἡμῖν.^10

II Chronicles 14:10#3 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. σὺ εἶ; alia, σὺ εἶ ὁ θεός.^11
II Chronicles 14:10#3 Alia exempl..n: „Du bist“ beziehungsweise „du bist Gott“ wird ergänzt.
II Chronicles 14:10#3 Alia exempl..en: “You are” or “you are God” is added.

0852.1.11.la: Prior lectio est in Ald., Codd. 74, 106, aliis; posterior in Comp., Codd. 19 (cum ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν), 93, 108, 121 (om. ὁ).
0852.1.11.en: The former reading is in Ald., Codd. 74, 106, and others; the latter in Comp., Codd. 19 (with ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν), 93, 108, 121 (omitting ὁ).

II Chronicles 14:10#4 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. πρὸς σέ. Alia exempl. μετὰ σοῦ.^12

0853.1.1.la: Sic Ald., Codd. III, XI, 44, 55, alii (inter quos 243). Cf. ad v. 8.
0853.1.1.en: So Ald., Codd. III, XI, 44, 55, and others (among them 243). Cf. on v. 8.

II Chronicles 15:8#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Ἀδάδ. Alia exempl. Ὠδήδ; alia, Ἀζαρίου; alia, Ἀδδώ.^8
II Chronicles 15:8#2 Alia exempl..n: Oded, Asarja beziehungsweise Iddo statt Adad als Prophetenname.
II Chronicles 15:8#2 Alia exempl..en: Oded, Azariah or Iddo instead of Adad as the prophet’s name.

0853.1.8.la: Prior lectio est in Comp., Codd. 19, 93; altera in Ald., Codd. III, XI, 52, 55, aliis (inter quos 243); tertia in Codd. 44, 74 (cum Ἀδὼ), 106, aliis.
0853.1.8.en: The first reading is in Comp., Codd. 19, 93; the second in Ald., Codd. III, XI, 52, 55, and others (among them 243); the third in Codd. 44, 74 (with Ἀδὼ), 106, and others.

II Chronicles 15:8#4 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. [Ἱεροβοὰμ] ἐν ὄρει Ἐφραΐμ. Alia exempl. ἀπὸ Ἱεροβοὰμ ἐξ ὄρους Ἐφραΐμ.^10
II Chronicles 15:8#4 Alia exempl..n: Die Eroberung wird ausdrücklich als Wegnahme von Jerobeam formuliert.
II Chronicles 15:8#4 Alia exempl..en: The capture is explicitly expressed as taking from Jeroboam.

0853.1.10.la: Iidem. Vox Ἱεροβοὰμ deest in Codd. II, III, XI, 52, 55, aliis (inter quos 243).
0853.1.10.en: The same. The word Ἱεροβοὰμ is wanting in Codd. II, III, XI, 52, 55, and others (among them 243).

II Chronicles 15:3#0 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. ἐν οὐ θεῷ ἀληθινῷ, καὶ οὐχ ἱερέως ὑποδεικνῦντος. Σ. ἄνευ θεοῦ ἀληθείας καὶ ἱερέως ὑποδεικνύοντος.^2
II Chronicles 15:3#0 Σ..n: „Ohne den wahren Gott und einen unterweisenden Priester“ statt der negierten Ortskonstruktion.
II Chronicles 15:3#0 Σ..en: “Without the true God and an instructing priest” replaces the negated prepositional construction.

0853.1.2.la: Sic in textu sine nom. Cod. 71. Cod. 108 in marg.: Σ. ἄνευ θεοῦ ἀληθείας.
0853.1.2.en: So in the text without name Cod. 71. Cod. 108 in the margin: Σ. ἄνευ θεοῦ ἀληθείας.

II Chronicles 15:4#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐπιστρέψει αὐτούς. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐν στενότητι, καὶ ἐπιστρέψει αὐτοὺς ἐν θλίψει.^3
II Chronicles 15:4#0 Alia exempl..n: Enge und Bedrängnis werden ausdrücklich vor der Umkehr genannt.
II Chronicles 15:4#0 Alia exempl..en: Straits and affliction are explicitly mentioned before the turning back.

0853.1.3.la: Duplex versio est in Codd. 19, 93 (om. αὐτοὺς), 108, Theodoret. (cum ἐκάθισαν et ἐπιστρέψουσιν ἐν θλ.).
0853.1.3.en: A double version is in Codd. 19, 93 (omitting αὐτοὺς), 108, Theodoret. (with ἐκάθισαν and ἐπιστρέψουσιν ἐν θλ.).

II Chronicles 15:4#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. καὶ ζητήσουσιν αὐτόν.^4

II Chronicles 15:5#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐν τοῖς καιροῖς ἐκείνοις.^5
II Chronicles 15:5#0 Alia exempl..en: “In those times” instead of “at that time”.

II Chronicles 15:5#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἔκστασις κυρίου. Alia exempl. ἔκστασις κυρίου πολλή.^6
II Chronicles 15:5#1 Alia exempl..n: „Große“ verstärkt die Aussage über die gottgewirkte Bestürzung.
II Chronicles 15:5#1 Alia exempl..en: “Great” intensifies the statement about God-sent consternation.

0853.1.6.la: Sic Comp., Codd. 93, 108, Theodoret. (cum γαίας pro χώρας).
0853.1.6.en: So Comp., Codd. 93, 108, Theodoret. (with γαίας for χώρας).

II Chronicles 15:13#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἀποθανεῖται. Alia exempl. θανάτῳ θανατωθήσεται.^11
II Chronicles 15:13#0 Alia exempl..n: „Mit dem Tod soll er getötet werden“ statt „er wird sterben“.
II Chronicles 15:13#0 Alia exempl..en: “He shall be put to death” instead of “he will die”.

II Chronicles 15:14#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐν ἀλαλαγμῷ.^12
II Chronicles 15:14#0 Alia exempl..en: “With a shout of joy” is added.

II Chronicles 15:16#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ. Alia exempl. τὴν μητέρα Ἀσὰ τοῦ βασιλέως.^13
II Chronicles 15:16#0 Alia exempl..n: „Die Mutter des Königs Asa“ statt „seine Mutter“.

II Chronicles 15:17#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. οὐκ ἀπέστησαν. Alia exempl. οὐκ ἐξῆραν; alia, οὐκ ἐξῆρεν.^14
II Chronicles 15:17#0 Alia exempl..n: „Sie beziehungsweise er entfernten nicht“ statt „sie wichen nicht“.
II Chronicles 15:17#0 Alia exempl..en: “They or he did not remove” instead of “they did not depart”.

0853.1.14.la: Prior lectio est in Codd. III, XI, 60, 93, 108, 119, 243; posterior in Comp., Ald., Codd. 19, 44, 52, aliis.
0853.1.14.en: The former reading is in Codd. III, XI, 60, 93, 108, 119, 243; the latter in Comp., Ald., Codd. 19, 44, 52, and others.

II Chronicles 15:17#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἀλλ’ ἡ καρδία Ἀσὰ ἐγένετο πλήρης. Alia exempl. πλὴν καρδία Ἀσὰ τελεία οὐκ ἦν.^15
II Chronicles 15:17#1 Alia exempl..n: „Asas Herz war nicht vollkommen“ statt „Asas Herz war vollkommen“.
II Chronicles 15:17#1 Alia exempl..en: “Asa’s heart was not perfect” instead of “Asa’s heart was perfect”.

II Chronicles 15:18#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ τὰ ἅγια οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ. Alia exempl. καὶ τὰ ἅγια αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ.^16
II Chronicles 15:18#0 Alia exempl..n: „Seine geweihten Gaben ins Gotteshaus“ statt „die heiligen Dinge des Gotteshauses“.
II Chronicles 15:18#0 Alia exempl..en: “His consecrated gifts into God’s house” instead of “the holy things of God’s house”.

II Chronicles 16:1#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀγδόῳ καὶ τριακοστῷ ἔτει. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ τριακοστῷ καὶ ἕκτῳ.^1
II Chronicles 16:1#0 Alia exempl..en: The thirty-sixth instead of the thirty-eighth year.

0853.2.1.la: Sic Comp. (om. καὶ posteriore), Codd. 19 (om. καὶ ἕκτῳ), 71 (cum καὶ ἐν ἔτει τρ. ἕκτῳ), 93, 108 (ut 19).
0853.2.1.en: So Comp. (omitting the second καὶ), Codd. 19 (omitting καὶ ἕκτῳ), 71 (with καὶ ἐν ἔτει τρ. ἕκτῳ), 93, 108 (as 19).

II Chronicles 16:3#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. διασκέδασον ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ τὸν Βαασὰ βασιλέα Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἀπελθέτω. Alia exempl. διασκέδασον τὴν διαθήκην σου τὴν μετὰ Βαασὰ βασιλέως Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἀπελεύσεται.^2
II Chronicles 16:3#0 Alia exempl..n: Ben-Hadad soll den Bund mit Bascha brechen, statt Bascha selbst zu zerstreuen.
II Chronicles 16:3#0 Alia exempl..en: Ben-hadad is to break his covenant with Baasha instead of scattering Baasha himself.

0853.2.3.la: Sic Ald., Codd. III, XI, 44, 52, 55, alii (inter quos 243).
0853.2.3.en: So Ald., Codd. III, XI, 44, 52, 55, and others (among them 243).

II Chronicles 16:7#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἡ δύναμις Συρίας. Alia exempl. δύναμις βασιλέως Ἰσραήλ.^4
II Chronicles 16:7#0 Alia exempl..en: “Army of Israel’s king” instead of “army of Syria”.

0853.2.4.la: Sic Comp. (cum Συρίας pro Ἰσραὴλ), Codd. 19, 93, 108, Theodoret. (cum ἡ δύναμις).
0853.2.4.en: So Comp. (with Συρίας for Ἰσραὴλ), Codd. 19, 93, 108, Theodoret. (with ἡ δύναμις).

II Chronicles 16:8#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. εἰς δύναμιν πολλὴν, εἰς θάρσος εἰς ἱππεῖς. Alia exempl. εἰς δύναμιν πολλὴν καὶ θάρσος, εἰς ἅρματα καὶ ἱππεῖς.^5
II Chronicles 16:8#0 Alia exempl..n: Wagen werden neben Reitern ausdrücklich genannt.
II Chronicles 16:8#0 Alia exempl..en: Chariots are explicitly mentioned alongside horsemen.

0853.2.5.la: Sic Comp., Codd. 19 (om. καὶ ante θάρσος), 93, 108. Vet. Lat.: _in virtute magna, et in currus et equites._ 5 C 2
0853.2.5.en: So Comp., Codd. 19 (omitting καὶ before θάρσος), 93, 108. Vet. Lat.: “_in great strength, and in chariots and horsemen._”

II Chronicles 16:9#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐν πάσῃ καρδίᾳ πλήρει πρὸς αὐτόν. Alia exempl. μετὰ πάσης καρδίας τελείας πρὸς αὐτόν.^6
II Chronicles 16:9#0 Alia exempl..n: „Mit ganzem vollkommenem Herzen“ statt „in jedem vollen Herzen“.
II Chronicles 16:9#0 Alia exempl..en: “With a wholly perfect heart” instead of “in every full heart”.

0854.0.6.la: Iidem. Vet. Lat.: _illum qui est perfecto corde ad eum._
0854.0.6.en: The same. Vet. Lat.: “_him who is of perfect heart toward him._”

II Chronicles 16:10#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. εἰς φυλακήν. Alia exempl. εἰς οἶκον φυλακῆς.^7
II Chronicles 16:10#0 Alia exempl..en: “Into the prison house” instead of “into custody”.

0854.0.7.la: Iidem. Ad vocem Hebraeam cf. Hex. ad Jerem. xx. 2. xxix. 26.
0854.0.7.en: The same. On the Hebrew word cf. Hex. on Jerem. xx. 2. xxix. 26.

II Chronicles 16:12#0 Ἄλλος.en: “He fell ill” instead of “he grew weak”.

0854.0.8.la: Sic in textu Cod. 93. Cf. Hex. ad Gen. xlviii. 1. Jerem. xiv. 18.
0854.0.8.en: So in the text Cod. 93. Cf. Hex. on Gen. xlviii. 1. Jerem. xiv. 18.

II Chronicles 16:12#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τοὺς πόδας. Alia exempl. ἐν τοῖς ποσὶν αὐτοῦ.^9
II Chronicles 16:12#1 Alia exempl..n: „An seinen Füßen“ statt des bloßen „die Füße“.
II Chronicles 16:12#1 Alia exempl..en: “In his feet” instead of the bare “the feet”.

II Chronicles 16:12#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἕως σφόδρα ἐμαλακίσθη. Alia exempl. ἕως ἄνω ἡ ἀρρωστία αὐτοῦ.^10
II Chronicles 16:12#2 Alia exempl..n: Die Krankheit reicht „bis nach oben“ statt nur sehr schwer zu werden.
II Chronicles 16:12#2 Alia exempl..en: The illness extends “upwards” instead of merely becoming very severe.

0854.0.10.la: Sic Comp., Codd. 19, 93, 108 (cum ἕως ἀνά). Mox ἐν τῇ ἀρρωστίᾳ αὐτοῦ Cod. 93.
0854.0.10.en: So Comp., Codd. 19, 93, 108 (with ἕως ἀνά). Presently Cod. 93 has ἐν τῇ ἀρρωστίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

II Chronicles 16:14#2 Ἄλλος.unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐποίησαν αὐτῷ ἐκφορὰν μεγάλην. Ἄλλος· καὶ ἔκαυσαν αὐτῷ καῦσιν μεγάλην.^14
II Chronicles 16:14#2 Ἄλλος.n: „Sie entzündeten einen großen Brand“ statt „sie veranstalteten ein großes Begräbnis“.
II Chronicles 16:14#2 Ἄλλος.en: “They made a great burning” instead of “they held a great funeral”.

0854.0.14.la: Duplex versio, καὶ ἐποίησαν—μεγάλην, καὶ ἔκαυσαν—μεγάλην, est in Comp., et (cum vitiosa scriptura ἔκλαυσαν .. κλαῦσιν) Codd. 19, 93 (cum αὐτὸ), 108. Cod. 121: καὶ ἐπ. αὐτῷ ἐκφορὰν, καὶ ἔκλαυσαν αὐτὸν κλ. μ.
0854.0.14.en: A double version, καὶ ἐποίησαν—μεγάλην, καὶ ἔκαυσαν—μεγάλην, is in Comp., and (with the faulty spelling ἔκλαυσαν .. κλαῦσιν) Codd. 19, 93 (with αὐτὸ), 108. Cod. 121: καὶ ἐπ. αὐτῷ ἐκφορὰν, καὶ ἔκλαυσαν αὐτὸν κλ. μ.

0854.1.2.la: Joseph. Antiq. VIII, 15, 1: οὐδὲν ἧττον (ταῖς) ὑπὸ Ἀβία τοῦ πάππου καταληφθείσαις τῆς ἐν Ἐφραΐμ κληρουχίας . . . φρουρὰς ἐγκαθίδρυσεν. Cf. Hex. ad 2 Reg. viii. 6, 14.
0854.1.2.en: Joseph. Antiq. VIII, 15, 1: οὐδὲν ἧττον (ταῖς) ὑπὸ Ἀβία τοῦ πάππου καταληφθείσαις τῆς ἐν Ἐφραΐμ κληρουχίας . . . φρουρὰς ἐγκαθίδρυσεν. Cf. Hex. on 2 Reg. viii. 6, 14.

II Chronicles 17:4#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ οὐχ ὡς τὰ ἔργα τοῦ Ἰσραήλ (potior scriptura ὡς τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ τὰ ἔργα^4). Alia exempl. καὶ οὐ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα Ἰσραήλ.^5
II Chronicles 17:4#1 Alia exempl..n: „Nicht gemäß Israels Taten“ statt „nicht wie Israels Taten“; gleichsinniger Vergleich.
II Chronicles 17:4#1 Alia exempl..en: “Not according to Israel’s deeds” instead of “not like Israel’s deeds”; a synonymous comparison.

0854.1.5.la: Sic Comp., Codd. 19 (cum τοῦ Ἰσρ.), 93, 108, Theodoret.
0854.1.5.en: So Comp., Codd. 19 (with τοῦ Ἰσρ.), 93, 108, Theodoret.

II Chronicles 17:6#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τὰ ὑψηλὰ καὶ τὰ ἄλση. Alia exempl. τὰ ἄλση καὶ τὰ εἴδωλα.^8
II Chronicles 17:6#2 Alia exempl..n: „Heilige Haine und Götzen“ statt „Höhen und heilige Haine“.
II Chronicles 17:6#2 Alia exempl..en: “Sacred groves and idols” instead of “high places and sacred groves”.

0854.1.8.la: Sic Codd. 19, 93, 108, Theodoret. (om. καὶ τὰ εἴδωλα), Lucif. Calar. (idem).
0854.1.8.en: So Codd. 19, 93, 108, Theodoret. (omitting καὶ τὰ εἴδωλα), Lucif. Calar. (the same).

II Chronicles 17:7#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν δυνατῶν. Alia exempl. add. τὸν υἱὸν Ἀϊά.^9
II Chronicles 17:7#0 Alia exempl..en: “The son of Aiah” is additionally named.

II Chronicles 17:11#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. κριοὺς προβάτων. Alia exempl. προβάτων κριούς.^12
II Chronicles 17:11#1 Alia exempl..n: „Widder unter den Schafen“ wird durch umgekehrte Wortstellung ausgedrückt.
II Chronicles 17:11#1 Alia exempl..en: “Rams among the sheep” is expressed with reversed word order.

0854.1.12.la: Sic Comp., Ald., Codd. 19, 44, 71, alii (inter quos 93, 108).
0854.1.12.en: So Comp., Ald., Codd. 19, 44, 71, and others (among them 93, 108).

II Chronicles 17:11#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. καὶ τράγους ἑπτακισχιλίους ἑπτακοσίους.^13
II Chronicles 17:11#2 Alia exempl..en: A further 7,700 male goats are added.

0854.1.13.la: Sic Comp., Ald. (om. καὶ), Codd. III (idem), XI, 44, 52, 55 (ut Ald.), alii (inter quos 93, cum καὶ ἑπτακοσίους).
0854.1.13.en: So Comp., Ald. (omitting καὶ), Codd. III (the same), XI, 44, 52, 55 (as Ald.), and others (among them 93, with καὶ ἑπτακοσίους).

II Chronicles 17:12#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. μείζων. Alia exempl. καὶ μεγαλυνόμενος.^14

0855.0.15.en: The same. Cf. on Cap. xxvii. 4.

II Chronicles 17:14#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. υἱοὶ δυνατοὶ δυνάμεως. Alia exempl. υἱοὶ δυνάμεως ἄνδρες δυνατοί.^16
II Chronicles 17:14#0 Alia exempl..n: „Söhne der Stärke, mächtige Männer“ statt der anders verbundenen Stärkeangaben.
II Chronicles 17:14#0 Alia exempl..en: “Sons of strength, mighty men” replaces differently connected strength expressions.

II Chronicles 17:15#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ μετ’ αὐτόν. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐχόμενοι αὐτῶν.^17

0855.0.17.la: Iidem. Cf. Hex. ad Jerem. v. 31.
0855.0.17.en: The same. Cf. Hex. on Jerem. v. 31.

II Chronicles 18:2#1 Ἄλλος.unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἠγάπα (Ἄλλος· ἠπάτα^2) αὐτόν. Alia exempl. καὶ Ἀχαὰβ ἔπεισε τὸν Ἰωσαφάτ.^3

0855.1.2.la: Sic in textu Cod. 243. Cf. Hex. ad Job. xxxvi. 16. Jesai. xxxvi. 18. Jerem. xxxviii. 22.
0855.1.2.en: So in the text Cod. 243. Cf. Hex. on Job. xxxvi. 16. Jesai. xxxvi. 18. Jerem. xxxviii. 22.

0855.1.3.la: Sic Comp., Codd. 19, 93, 108. Hieron.: _persuasitque illi._ Cf. Hex. ad Jos. xv. 18. Jud. i. 14.
0855.1.3.en: So Comp., Codd. 19, 93, 108. Hieron.: “_and he persuaded him._” Cf. Hex. on Jos. xv. 18. Jud. i. 14.

II Chronicles 18:2#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἠγάπα (Ἄλλος· ἠπάτα^2) αὐτόν. Alia exempl. καὶ Ἀχαὰβ ἔπεισε τὸν Ἰωσαφάτ.^3
II Chronicles 18:2#1 Alia exempl..n: Ahab überredet Joschafat ausdrücklich, statt ihn zu lieben.
II Chronicles 18:2#1 Alia exempl..en: Ahab explicitly persuades Jehoshaphat instead of loving him.

0855.1.2.la: Sic in textu Cod. 243. Cf. Hex. ad Job. xxxvi. 16. Jesai. xxxvi. 18. Jerem. xxxviii. 22.
0855.1.2.en: So in the text Cod. 243. Cf. Hex. on Job. xxxvi. 16. Jesai. xxxvi. 18. Jerem. xxxviii. 22.

0855.1.3.la: Sic Comp., Codd. 19, 93, 108. Hieron.: _persuasitque illi._ Cf. Hex. ad Jos. xv. 18. Jud. i. 14.
0855.1.3.en: So Comp., Codd. 19, 93, 108. Hieron.: “_and he persuaded him._” Cf. Hex. on Jos. xv. 18. Jud. i. 14.

II Chronicles 18:3#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ὡς ἐγὼ οὕτω καὶ σύ. Alia exempl. ὡς σὺ οὕτω καὶ ἐγώ.^4
II Chronicles 18:3#0 Alia exempl..n: „Wie du, so auch ich“ statt „wie ich, so auch du“.
II Chronicles 18:3#0 Alia exempl..en: “As you, so also I” instead of “as I, so also you”.

II Chronicles 18:3#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. μετὰ σοῦ. Alia exempl. καὶ μετὰ σοῦ.^5

0855.1.5.en: So Comp., Codd. 93, 108. Hieron.: “_and we will be with thee._”

II Chronicles 18:4#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τὸν κύριον. Alia exempl. τὸν λόγον κυρίου.^6

0866.1.4.la: Cod. 108 (cum χολάσαι). Ad ἐξέδρας cf. Hex. ad 1 Reg. ix. 22. Jerem. xxxv. 2. Ezech. xl. 17. Pro mendosa scriptura χολάσαι indubitanter correximus σχολάσαι, _vacuas reddere, praeparare._ Cf. Hex. ad Mal. iii. 1, ubi hodie quidem Aquilae ἀποσκευάσει, Symmacho autem σχολάσει tribuerimus, coll. Hex. ad Jesai. lvii. 14.
0866.1.4.en: Cod. 108 (with χολάσαι). On ἐξέδρας cf. Hex. on 1 Reg. ix. 22. Jerem. xxxv. 2. Ezech. xl. 17. For the faulty spelling χολάσαι we have without hesitation corrected σχολάσαι, _to make empty, to prepare._ Cf. Hex. on Mal. iii. 1, where today we would indeed assign ἀποσκευάσει to Aquila, but σχολάσει to Symmachus, comparing Hex. on Jesai. lvii. 14.

0866.2.4.la: Cod. 108. Huc autem pertinere videtur Hieronymi locus a nobis in Hex. ad 2 Reg. v. 9 allegatus: “Mello, civitas quam aedificavit Salomon [hucusque Euseb. in Onomastico, p. 284]. Porro Sym. et Theod. _adimpletionem_ transtulerunt.” Praeterea in Hex. ad 3 Reg. ix. 15. xi. 27 pro ܫܘܡܠܝܐ[?] (= ἀναπλήρωσις 1 Esdr. i. 54) fortasse non τελείωσις, sed derivativum nescio quod a πληροῦν Symmacho tribuendum erat. (Ad ἀνάλημμα cf. Sirac. l. 2, ubi in Syro-hex. est ܫܘܡܠܐ[?].)
0866.2.4.en: Cod. 108. To this place, moreover, seems to belong the passage of Jerome cited by us in Hex. on 2 Reg. v. 9: “Mello, a city which Solomon built [thus far Euseb. in the Onomasticon, p. 284]. Further, Sym. and Theod. rendered it _a filling up_.” Besides, in Hex. on 3 Reg. ix. 15. xi. 27, for ܫܘܡܠܝܐ[?] (= ἀναπλήρωσις 1 Esdr. i. 54) perhaps not τελείωσις, but some derivative or other of πληροῦν should have been assigned to Symmachus. (On ἀνάλημμα cf. Sirac. l. 2, where in Syro-hex. there is ܫܘܡܠܐ[?].)

II Chronicles 34:3#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἀπὸ τῶν ὑψηλῶν, καὶ τῶν ἄλσεων, [καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν περιβωμίων].^1 Alia exempl. ἀπὸ τῶν ὑψηλῶν, καὶ τῶν ἄλσεων, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν βωμῶν, καὶ τῶν γλυπτῶν.^2

0867.2.1.la: Clausulam καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν περιβωμίων reprobant Codd. II, III, XI, 52, 55, 60, 64, 119, 158, recte; nam non exprimit Hebraeum וְהַפְּסִלִים, sed duplex versio est vocis praecedentis וְהָאֲשֵׁרִים, et Symmachum interpretem aperte prodit. Cf. Hex. ad 4 Reg. xvii. 16. xxi. 7. xxiii. 4, 7.
0867.2.1.en: The clause καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν περιβωμίων is rejected by Codd. II, III, XI, 52, 55, 60, 64, 119, 158, rightly; for it does not express the Hebrew וְהַפְּסִלִים, but is a double version of the preceding word וְהָאֲשֵׁרִים, and plainly betrays Symmachus as its translator. 0867.2.2.la: Sic Comp. (om. ἀπὸ posteriore), Codd. 19, 108 (ut Comp.). Etiam in hac lectione Symmacho, ni fallor, debetur clausula καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν βωμῶν, quae duplex versio est Hebraei מִן־הַבָּמוֹת. Cf. Hex. ad 3 Reg. xii. 32.
0867.2.2.en: So Comp. (omitting the second ἀπὸ), Codd. 19, 108 (as Comp.). In this reading too the clause καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν βωμῶν, which is a double version of the Hebrew מִן־הַבָּמוֹת, is due, unless I am mistaken, to Symmachus. Cf. Hex. on 3 Reg. xii. 32.

0868.0.12.la: Procop. p. 389. Cf. Hex. ad 4 Reg. xxii. 14. Vocem δευτέρωσιν nescio an recte ceperit Geiger (_Symmachus_ etc. p. 53) de _schola_ ubi Judaeorum doctores traditiones (δευτερώσεις) suas discentibus exponerent. Certe in loco parallelo pro בַּמִּשְׁנֶה paraphrastes Chaldaeus exhibet בְּבֵית אוּלְפָנָא.
0868.0.12.en: Procop. p. 389. Cf. Hex. on 4 Reg. xxii. 14. I doubt whether Geiger (_Symmachus_ etc. p. 53) rightly took the word δευτέρωσιν of a _school_ where the teachers of the Jews expounded their traditions (δευτερώσεις) to their pupils. Certainly in the parallel passage, for בַּמִּשְׁנֶה the Chaldee paraphrast exhibits בְּבֵית אוּלְפָנָא.

0868.1.11.la: Sic Codd. 52, 64, 119, 158. In Codd. II, III, XI, 55, 60, haec, ἐποιήθη τὸ φ. τοῦτο. μετὰ ταῦτα—τὸν οἶκον, non leguntur. Supplementum est, ut videtur, Aquilae aut Symmachi, qui pro הֵכִין vel כּוֹנֵן non ἔδρασεν, a δράω, quae forma in Bibliis Graecis vix occurrit, sed ἥδρασεν ab ἑδράζω ponere solent.
0868.1.11.en: So Codd. 52, 64, 119, 158. In Codd. II, III, XI, 55, 60, these words, ἐποιήθη τὸ φ. τοῦτο. μετὰ ταῦτα—τὸν οἶκον, are not read. It is a supplement, as it seems, of Aquila or Symmachus, who for הֵכִין or כּוֹנֵן are wont to put not ἔδρασεν, from δράω, a form which scarcely occurs in the Greek Bible, but ἥδρασεν from ἑδράζω.

0869.0.14.la: Sic Codd. II (cum καρασεὶμ), III, XI, 55, 64, 119, 158. Theodoret. Quaest. in 2 Paral. p. 600: τὸ δὲ κερεσεὶμ (sic) εἶδος εἶναι μαντείας ὑπολαμβάνω. In loco 4 Regum in Hebraeo est הַשִּׁקֻּצִים, in Graeco autem τὰ προσοχθίσματα. Scriptura καδησεὶμ, quam exhibet Cod. 121, pertinet ad aliam historiam quae narratur 4 Reg. xxiii. 7. Mox ἐνεπύρισεν est versio deterior vocis בִּעֵר, quae in loco 4 Regum ἐξῆρε sonat.
0869.0.14.en: So Codd. II (with καρασεὶμ), III, XI, 55, 64, 119, 158. Theodoret. Quaest. in 2 Paral. p. 600: τὸ δὲ κερεσεὶμ (sic) εἶδος εἶναι μαντείας ὑπολαμβάνω. In the passage of 4 Kings the Hebrew has הַשִּׁקֻּצִים, but the Greek τὰ προσοχθίσματα. The spelling καδησεὶμ, which Cod. 121 exhibits, belongs to another story, which is narrated in 4 Reg. xxiii. 7. Presently ἐνεπύρισεν is an inferior rendering of the word בִּעֵר, which in the passage of 4 Kings is rendered ἐξῆρε.

0876.2.2.en: The former reading is in Comp., Ald., Codd. III (with ἐν Ἀμ. ἐν π.), 52, 64, 119 (as III), 243, 248; the latter in Codd. 19, 93 (with Ἐκβετ.), 108 (with ἐν Ἐκβ. ἐν τῇ π.), 121.

Ezra 6:3#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἔθηκεν ἔπαρμα. Alia exempl. καὶ τὰ θεμέλια τεθήτω, θεμέλια παχέα.^4

0876.2.4.en: So Comp., Codd. 19, 93 (with τεθείτω), 108, 121 (adding ἔπαρμα at the end).

Ezra 6:4#0 Alia exempl..en: New timber is explicitly specified instead of unspecified wood.

0876.2.5.la: Sic Comp., Codd. 19, 93 (cum καινὸν), 108 (cum ξύλινον καινόν).
0876.2.5.en: So Comp., Codd. 19, 93 (with καινὸν), 108 (with ξύλινον καινόν).

Ezra 6:5#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπὶ τόπου οὗ ἐτέθη. Alia exempl. εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτῶν, καὶ τεθήτω.^7

0876.2.7.en: So Comp. (with ἐπὶ τόπου αὐτῶν), Codd. 19, 93, 108.

Ezra 6:9#0 Alia exempl..en: “What is needed” instead of “what is lacking”.

Ezra 6:9#1 Alia exempl..en: “Without variation” is added concerning granting what is requested.

0877.0.13.en: So Comp., Codd. 19, 93, 108. Cf. on Cap. iv. 22.

Ezra 6:10#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. εἰς ζωήν. Alia exempl. περὶ τῆς σωτηρίας.^14

Ezra 6:11#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τὸ κατ᾿ ἐμὲ ποιηθήσεται. Alia exempl. ἔσται εἰς διαρπαγήν.^16
Ezra 6:11#1 Alia exempl..n: „Es wird zur Plünderung sein“ statt „das Meine wird geschehen“.
Ezra 6:11#1 Alia exempl..en: “It will be for plunder” instead of “what concerns me will happen”.

0877.0.16.la: Sic Comp., Codd. 19, 93, 108, 121 (cum εἰς δ. τὸ κατ᾿ ἐμὲ π.). Cf. Dan. ii. 5. iii. 29 juxta Theod. (Locutio paulo insolentior, τὸ κατ᾿ ἐμὲ ποιηθήσεται, non aliud innuere videtur quam δημευθήσεται (Dan. iii. 29 juxta LXX), vel ἀναληφθήσεται εἰς τὸ βασιλικόν (Dan. ii. 5 juxta eosdem). Cf. 1 Esdr. vi. 31. Mire Schleusner. in _Nov. Thes._ s. v. κατά: “Τὸ κατ᾿ ἐμὲ, _latrina_, ex Graecismo[?] quo utebantur honestatis in loquendo studiosi, i. q. ἀφεδρών.”)
0877.0.16.en: So Comp., Codd. 19, 93, 108, 121 (with εἰς δ. τὸ κατ᾿ ἐμὲ π.). Cf. Dan. ii. 5. iii. 29 according to Theod. (The somewhat unusual expression, τὸ κατ᾿ ἐμὲ ποιηθήσεται, seems to intimate nothing else than δημευθήσεται (Dan. iii. 29 according to the LXX), or ἀναληφθήσεται εἰς τὸ βασιλικόν (Dan. ii. 5 according to the same). Cf. 1 Esdr. vi. 31. Strangely Schleusner. in _Nov. Thes._ s. v. κατά: “Τὸ κατ᾿ ἐμὲ, _a privy_, from a Graecism[?] used by those careful of decency in speaking, i. q. ἀφεδρών.”)

Ezra 6:12#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. οὗ κατασκηνοῖ. Alia exempl. ὁ κατασκηνώσας.^17

0877.1.4.en: So Comp., Codd. 19, 93, 108. Cf. on Cap. v. 6.

0880.0.9.la: Sic Comp. (cum πᾶς ὁ ἔντρομος λόγον), Codd. 19, 93, 108.
0880.0.9.en: So Comp. (with πᾶς ὁ ἔντρομος λόγον), Codd. 19, 93, 108.

Ezra 9:6#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τοῦ ὑψῶσαι. Alia exempl. τοῦ ἐπᾶραι.^10

Ezra 9:7#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ ἡμῶν. Alia exempl. καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς ἡμῶν, καὶ οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν.^11
Ezra 9:7#0 Alia exempl..en: “Our priests and fathers” instead of “our sons”.

0880.0.11.la: Sic Comp. (om. καὶ οἱ π. ἡμῶν), Codd. 19 (cum καὶ οἱ πάντες (om. ἡμῶν)), 93, 108 (cum πάντες pro πατέρες), 121.
0880.0.11.en: So Comp. (omitting καὶ οἱ π. ἡμῶν), Codd. 19 (with καὶ οἱ πάντες (omitting ἡμῶν)), 93, 108 (with πάντες for πατέρες), 121.

Ezra 9:8#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. ὡς βραχύ.^13

0880.0.13.la: Sic Comp., Codd. 19, 93, 108 (cum ἐν pro ὡς).
0880.0.13.en: So Comp., Codd. 19, 93, 108 (with ἐν for ὡς).

Ezra 9:8#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. εἰς σωτηρίαν. Alia exempl. ἀνασωζόμενον.^14

0880.0.14.la: Sic Codd. 19, 93 (cum –νος), 108. Cf. Hex. ad 2 Paral. xx. 24.
0880.0.14.en: So Codd. 19, 93 (with –νος), 108. Cf. Hex. on 2 Paral. xx. 24.

Ezra 9:8#4 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐν τῇ δουλείᾳ ἡμῶν. ὅτι δοῦλοί ἐσμεν. Alia exempl. ἐν τῇ παραβάσει ἡμῶν, ἐν ᾗ παρέβημεν ἡμεῖς.^17
Ezra 9:8#4 Alia exempl..n: „In unserer Übertretung“ statt „in unserer Knechtschaft; denn wir sind Knechte“.
Ezra 9:8#4 Alia exempl..en: “In our transgression” instead of “in our bondage; for we are slaves”.

0880.0.18.la: Iidem. Cf. Hex. ad Hos. ii. 6.
0880.0.18.en: The same. Cf. Hex. on Hos. ii. 6.

Ezra 9:10#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. καὶ νῦν; alia, νῦν οὖν.^19

0880.0.19.la: Prior lectio est in Comp., Codd. 19, 93, 108; posterior in Codd. 44, 71, 74, aliis.
0880.0.19.en: The former reading is in Comp., Codd. 19, 93, 108; the latter in Codd. 44, 71, 74, and others.

Ezra 9:11#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐν μακρύμμασιν αὐτῶν. Alia exempl. τῶν γαιῶν ἐν βδελύγμασιν αὐτῶν.^20
Ezra 9:11#0 Alia exempl..n: „Länder mit ihren Gräueln“ statt „Völker mit ihren Entfernungen“.
Ezra 9:11#0 Alia exempl..en: “Lands with their abominations” instead of “nations with their distances”.

Ezra 9:13#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ὡς ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν, ὅτι ἐκούφισας ἡμῶν τὰς ἀνομίας. Alia exempl. ὅτι σὺ ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν κατέπαυσας τὸ σκῆπτρον ἡμῶν διὰ τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν· καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὡς σὺ, ὅτι ἐκούφισας τὰς ἀνομίας ἡμῶν.^23
Ezra 9:13#1 Alia exempl..n: Das Ende unseres Zepters wegen unserer Sünden wird zusätzlich genannt.
Ezra 9:13#1 Alia exempl..en: The ending of our sceptre because of our sins is additionally stated.

0880.0.23.la: Sic, ex duplici versione, Codd. 19, 93, 108 (cum ἡμῶν τὰς ἀνομίας), 121 (idem).
0880.0.23.en: So, from a double version, Codd. 19, 93, 108 (with ἡμῶν τὰς ἀνομίας), 121 (the same).

Ezra 9:14#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. μὴ παροξυνθῇς ἐν ἡμῖν. Alia exempl. καὶ οὐκ ὠργίσθης ἡμῖν.^25
Ezra 9:14#0 Alia exempl..n: „Du warst uns nicht zornig“ statt „werde uns nicht zornig“.
Ezra 9:14#0 Alia exempl..en: “You were not angry with us” instead of “do not become angry with us”.

Ezra 9:14#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τοῦ μὴ εἶναι ἐγκατάλειμμα καὶ διασωζόμενον. Alia exempl. ὥστε μὴ εἶναι ὑπόλειμμα καὶ ἀνασωζόμενον.^26
Ezra 9:14#1 Alia exempl..n: Das Fehlen eines geretteten Restes wird als Folge statt als Zweck ausgedrückt.
Ezra 9:14#1 Alia exempl..en: The absence of a surviving remnant is expressed as a result rather than a purpose.

Ezra 9:15#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ὅτι οὐκ ἔστι. Alia exempl. καὶ οὐ δυνάμεθα.^27

Ezra 10:1#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ νεανίσκοι. Alia exempl. νεανίσκοι καὶ παιδάρια.^3
Ezra 10:1#2 Alia exempl..n: Kinder werden zusätzlich zu den jungen Männern genannt.
Ezra 10:1#2 Alia exempl..en: Children are mentioned in addition to young men.

Ezra 10:1#3 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ὅτι ἔκλαυσαν ὁ λαὸς, καὶ ὕψωσε κλαίων. Alia exempl. ὅτι κλαυθμῷ μεγάλῳ ἔκλαυσεν ὁ λαός.^4
Ezra 10:1#3 Alia exempl..n: „Das Volk weinte sehr“ statt der umständlicheren Verbindung von Weinen und Erheben.
Ezra 10:1#3 Alia exempl..en: “The people wept greatly” replaces the more elaborate combination of weeping and raising.

Ezra 10:2#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἔστιν ὑπομονή. Alia exempl. ἐλπίς ἐστιν.^6
Ezra 10:2#1 Alia exempl..en: “There is hope” instead of “there is endurance”.

0881.0.6.la: Sic Comp. (cum ἔστιν ἐλπὶς), Codd. 19, 93, 108. Cf. Hex. ad 1 Paral. xxix. 15.
0881.0.6.en: So Comp. (with ἔστιν ἐλπὶς), Codd. 19, 93, 108. Cf. Hex. on 1 Paral. xxix. 15.

Ezra 10:3#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐκβαλεῖν. Alia exempl. τοῦ ἐξαγαγεῖν.^7

Ezra 10:3#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ὡς ἂν βούλῃ· ἀνάστηθι, καὶ φοβέρισον αὐτοὺς ἐν ἐντολαῖς θεοῦ ἡμῶν. Alia exempl. ἐν βουλῇ κυρίου καὶ τῶν τρεμόντων ἐν ταῖς ἐντολαῖς αὐτοῦ.^9
Ezra 10:3#2 Alia exempl..n: „Nach dem Rat des Herrn und der vor seinen Geboten Zitternden“ statt einer Aufforderung zur Einschüchterung.
Ezra 10:3#2 Alia exempl..en: “By the counsel of the Lord and those trembling at his commandments” replaces an instruction to intimidate.

0881.0.9.la: Sic Comp. (cum ἐν ἐντολαῖς θ. ἡμῶν), Codd. 19, 93, 108.
0881.0.9.en: So Comp. (with ἐν ἐντολαῖς θ. ἡμῶν), Codd. 19, 93, 108.

Ezra 10:3#3 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ὡς ὁ νόμος, γενηθήτω. Alia exempl. καὶ ποιηθήσεται κατὰ τὸν νόμον τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν.^10
Ezra 10:3#3 Alia exempl..n: „Gemäß dem Gesetz unseres Gottes“ statt nur „wie das Gesetz“.
Ezra 10:3#3 Alia exempl..en: “According to our God’s law” instead of merely “as the law”.

Ezra 10:4#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τὸ ῥῆμα. Alia exempl. ὁ λόγος.^11
Ezra 10:4#0 Alia exempl..n: „Die Sache“ mit einem anderen gleichbedeutenden Wort.
Ezra 10:4#0 Alia exempl..en: “The matter” with a different synonymous word.

Ezra 10:4#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. κραταιοῦ καὶ ποίησον. Alia exempl. ἀνδρίζου καὶ ποίει.^12
Ezra 10:4#1 Alia exempl..n: „Sei mutig und handle“ statt „werde stark und tue“.
Ezra 10:4#1 Alia exempl..en: “Be courageous and act” instead of “be strong and do”.

Ezra 10:6#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐκεῖ. Alia exempl. καὶ ηὐλίσθη (וַיָּלֶן) ἐκεῖ.^13
Ezra 10:6#0 Alia exempl..en: “He lodged there” instead of “he went there”.

0881.0.13.la: Sic Comp., Ald., Codd. 52, 64, 243. Cf. 1 Esdr. ix. 2. Clausulam reprobant Codd. 19, 44, 93, 108.
0881.0.13.en: So Comp., Ald., Codd. 52, 64, 243. Cf. 1 Esdr. ix. 2. The clause is rejected by Codd. 19, 44, 93, 108.

Ezra 10:9#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἀπὸ θορύβου αὐτῶν περὶ τοῦ ῥήματος. Alia exempl. ἐν τρόμῳ ἀπὸ τοῦ ῥήματος.^14
Ezra 10:9#0 Alia exempl..n: „Im Zittern wegen der Sache“ statt „wegen ihres Tumults um die Sache“.
Ezra 10:9#0 Alia exempl..en: “Trembling because of the matter” instead of “because of their disturbance over the matter”.

0881.0.14.la: Sic Comp. (cum περὶ τ. ῥ.), Codd. 19, 93, 108. Pro ἐν τρόμῳ fortasse pingendum ἔντρομοι, coll. Dan. x. 11 juxta Theod. Statim post ἀπὸ τοῦ χειμῶνος Cod. 44 infert: εἶχον βίαν ἄπειρον· ψῦχος γὰρ ἦν πάνυ; quae glossatoris esse videntur.
0881.0.14.en: So Comp. (with περὶ τ. ῥ.), Codd. 19, 93, 108. For ἐν τρόμῳ perhaps ἔντρομοι should be written, comparing Dan. x. 11 according to Theod. Immediately after ἀπὸ τοῦ χειμῶνος Cod. 44 inserts: εἶχον βίαν ἄπειρον· ψῦχος γὰρ ἦν πάνυ; which seem to be a glossator's.

Ezra 10:11#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. αἴνεσιν. Alia exempl. αἴνεσιν καὶ ἐξομολόγησιν.^15

Ezra 10:13#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τοῦ ἀδικῆσαι ἐν τῷ ῥήματι. Alia exempl. τοῦ ἀσεβῆσαι ἐν τῷ λόγῳ.^18

Ezra 10:14#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. τῇ πάσῃ ἐκκλησίᾳ.^19

0881.0.19.la: Sic Comp., Ald., Codd. III, XI, 19 (cum ἐν π. τῇ ἐκκ.), 44 (cum π. τῇ ἐκκ.), 52, 55 (om. τῇ), alii (inter quos 243).
0881.0.19.en: So Comp., Ald., Codd. III, XI, 19 (with ἐν π. τῇ ἐκκ.), 44 (with π. τῇ ἐκκ.), 52, 55 (omitting τῇ), and others (among them 243).

Ezra 10:14#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς ἐν πόλεσιν ἡμῶν ὃς ἐκάθισε .. ἐλθέτωσαν εἰς καιροὺς ἀπὸ συνταγῶν. Alia exempl. καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν ἡμῶν οἱ λαβόντες .. ἡκέτωσαν εἰς καιροὺς ἀπὸ καιρῶν.^20
Ezra 10:14#1 Alia exempl..n: Die betroffenen Männer sollen zu festgesetzten Zeiten kommen; der Satz ist anders gegliedert.
Ezra 10:14#1 Alia exempl..en: The men concerned are to come at appointed times; the sentence is divided differently.

Ezra 10:15#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. βοηθῶν αὐτοῖς. Alia exempl. ἀντελαμβάνοντο αὐτῶν.^21

0881.0.21.la: Sic Comp. (cum αὐτοῖς), Codd. 19, 93 (cum ἀντελάβοντο), 108. Cf. Hex. ad 3 Reg. i. 7.
0881.0.21.en: So Comp. (with αὐτοῖς), Codd. 19, 93 (with ἀντελάβοντο), 108. Cf. Hex. on 3 Reg. i. 7.

Ezra 10:16#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ διεστάλησαν Ἔσδρας ὁ ἱερεὺς, καὶ ἄνδρες ἄρχοντες πατριῶν τῷ οἴκῳ. Alia exempl. καὶ διέστειλεν Ἔσδρας ὁ ἱερεὺς ἄρχοντας τῶν οἴκων τῶν πατριῶν αὐτῶν.^22
Ezra 10:16#0 Alia exempl..n: Esra wählt ausdrücklich die Oberhäupter aus, statt gemeinsam mit ihnen ausgesondert zu werden.
Ezra 10:16#0 Alia exempl..en: Ezra explicitly selects the heads instead of being selected together with them.

0881.0.22.la: Sic Codd. 19 (om. ὁ ἱερεὺς), 93 (cum ἄρχοντες), 108. Cf. 1 Esdr. ix. 16.
0881.0.22.en: So Codd. 19 (omitting ὁ ἱερεὺς), 93 (with ἄρχοντες), 108. Cf. 1 Esdr. ix. 16.

Ezra 10:16#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ πάντες ἐν ὀνόμασιν, ὅτι ἐπέστρεψαν. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐκάθισαν πάντες οἱ κληθέντες ἐν ὀνόμασιν.^23
Ezra 10:16#1 Alia exempl..n: Die namentlich Berufenen setzten sich, statt umzukehren.
Ezra 10:16#1 Alia exempl..en: Those called by name sat down instead of returning.

Ezra 10:24#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Σολμὴν, καὶ Τελμὴν, καὶ Ὠδούθ. Alia exempl. Σελλὴμ, καὶ Τελλὴμ, καὶ Οὐρίας.^27
Ezra 10:24#1 Alia exempl..n: Abweichende Namenformen Schellem, Tellem und Uria.
Ezra 10:24#1 Alia exempl..en: Alternative name forms Shellem, Tellem and Uriah.

Ezra 10:30#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Φαάθ. Alia exempl. Φαὰθ ἡγουμένου.^29
Ezra 10:30#0 Alia exempl..n: „Des Anführers“ wird dem Namen Phahat hinzugefügt.
Ezra 10:30#0 Alia exempl..en: “Of the leader” is added to the name Phaath.

0882.0.29.la: Sic Codd. 19, 93, 108. Cf. ad Cap. ii. 6.
0882.0.29.en: So Codd. 19, 93, 108. Cf. on Cap. ii. 6.

Ezra 10:44#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐλάβοσαν. Alia exempl. οἱ λαβόντες.^30
Ezra 10:44#0 Alia exempl..en: “Those who had taken” instead of “they took”.

Ezra 10:44#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐγέννησαν ἐξ αὐτῶν υἱούς. Alia exempl. εἰσὶ δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν τῶν γυναικῶν αἳ ἐγέννησαν υἱούς.^31
Ezra 10:44#1 Alia exempl..n: Die Frauen werden ausdrücklich als Mütter der geborenen Söhne bezeichnet.
Ezra 10:44#1 Alia exempl..en: The women are explicitly identified as mothers of the sons born.

0882.0.31.la: Sic Comp. (cum καὶ εἰσὶ δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν τ. γ. αἳ ἐγ. ἐξ αὐτῶν υἱοὺς), Codd. 19, 93, 108.
0882.0.31.en: So Comp. (with καὶ εἰσὶ δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν τ. γ. αἳ ἐγ. ἐξ αὐτῶν υἱοὺς), Codd. 19, 93, 108.

Nehemiah 1:1#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐν Σουσὰν ἀβιρά. Alia exempl. ἐν Σούσοις τῇ βάρει.^2
Nehemiah 1:1#1 Alia exempl..n: „Susa, die Festung“ übersetzt die bislang unübersetzte Festungsbezeichnung.
Nehemiah 1:1#1 Alia exempl..en: “Susa the citadel” translates the previously untranslated citadel term.

Nehemiah 1:2#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Ἰούδα. Alia exempl. ἐξ Ἰούδα.^3

Nehemiah 1:2#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. περὶ τῶν σωθέντων. Alia exempl. περὶ τῶν Ἰουδαίων τῶν διασωθέντων.^4
Nehemiah 1:2#1 Alia exempl..n: Die Geretteten werden ausdrücklich als Juden bezeichnet.
Nehemiah 1:2#1 Alia exempl..en: The survivors are explicitly identified as Jews.

Nehemiah 1:3#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐν πονηρίᾳ μεγάλῃ. Alia exempl. ἐν κακοῖς πολλοῖς.^5
Nehemiah 1:3#0 Alia exempl..en: “In many troubles” instead of “in great distress”.

Nehemiah 1:4#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἡμέρας. Alia exempl. ἐφ᾿ ἡμέραις πολλαῖς.^6

Nehemiah 1:5#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. μὴ δή. Alia exempl. ὢ δή.^7
Nehemiah 1:5#0 Alia exempl..n: Eine bejahende Anrufung statt der verneinenden Partikel.
Nehemiah 1:5#0 Alia exempl..en: An affirmative invocation instead of the negative particle.

0885.1.7.la: Sic (cum ὢ) Comp., Codd. 93, 108, 121. Cf. Hex. ad Psal. cxvii. 25. Jesai. xxxviii. 3.
0885.1.7.en: So (with ὢ) Comp., Codd. 93, 108, 121. Cf. Hex. on Psal. cxvii. 25. Jesai. xxxviii. 3.

Nehemiah 1:7#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. διαλύσει διελύσαμεν πρὸς σέ. Alia exempl. καὶ ματαιώσει ἐματαιώθημεν (הֲבֹל הָבַלְנוּ) ἐν σοί.^8
Nehemiah 1:7#0 Alia exempl..n: „Wir wurden völlig nichtig“ statt „wir brachen völlig mit dir“.
Nehemiah 1:7#0 Alia exempl..en: “We became utterly vain” instead of “we broke utterly with you”.

Nehemiah 1:8#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐγὼ διασκορπίσω. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐγὼ διασπερῶ.^11
Nehemiah 1:8#1 Alia exempl..n: „Ich werde zerstreuen“ mit einem anderen gleichbedeutenden Verb.
Nehemiah 1:8#1 Alia exempl..en: “I will scatter” with a different synonymous verb.

Nehemiah 1:11#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. μὴ δὴ, κύριε. Alia exempl. add. μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου.^12
Nehemiah 1:11#0 Alia exempl..n: „Wende dein Angesicht nicht ab“ wird ergänzt.
Nehemiah 1:11#0 Alia exempl..en: “Do not turn your face away” is added.

Nehemiah 2:2#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. διὰ τί τὸ πρόσωπόν σου πονηρόν; Alia exempl. ἱνατί τὸ πρόσωπόν σου σκυθρωπόν;^2
Nehemiah 2:2#0 Alia exempl..n: „Warum ist dein Gesicht traurig?“ statt „warum ist dein Gesicht böse?“.
Nehemiah 2:2#0 Alia exempl..en: “Why is your face sad?” instead of “why is your face evil?”.

0885.2.2.la: Sic Codd. 93, 108, 121 (cum διὰ τί). Cf. Gen. xl. 7 in Hebr. et LXX.
0885.2.2.en: So Codd. 93, 108, 121 (with διὰ τί). Cf. Gen. xl. 7 in the Hebrew and the LXX.

Nehemiah 2:2#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ οὐκ εἶ μετριάζων. Alia exempl. σὺ δὲ οὐκ εἶ ἀρρωστῶν.^3
Nehemiah 2:2#1 Alia exempl..n: Ein anderes Verb bezeichnet ebenfalls das Kranksein.
Nehemiah 2:2#1 Alia exempl..en: Another verb likewise denotes being ill.

0885.2.3.la: Sic Comp., Codd. 93 (cum ηρρωστον pro εἶ ἀρρ.), 108 (cum ἀρροστῶν), 121 (cum ἀρωστῶν). (Ad μετριάζων cf. nos ad S. Chrysost. in S. Pauli Epistolas, T. II, p. 587.) 5 G 2
0885.2.3.en: So Comp., Codd. 93 (with ηρρωστον for εἶ ἀρρ.), 108 (with ἀρροστῶν), 121 (with ἀρωστῶν). (On μετριάζων cf. our note on S. Chrysost. in S. Pauli Epistolas, T. II, p. 587.)

Nehemiah 2:5#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. εἰ ἐπὶ τὸν βασιλέα ἀγαθὸν, καὶ εἰ ἀγαθυνθήσεται. Alia exempl. ἐπίσταμαι τὸν βασιλέα ἀγαθὸν, καὶ εἰ ἀγαθὸν ἐπὶ τὸν βασιλέα, καὶ ἀρέσει.^8
Nehemiah 2:5#0 Alia exempl..n: „Ich weiß, der König ist gut“ wird vor der Bitte ergänzt.
Nehemiah 2:5#0 Alia exempl..en: “I know the king is good” is added before the request.

Nehemiah 2:8#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τὰς πύλας. Alia exempl. τὰς πύλας τῆς βάρεως τοῦ οἴκου.^12
Nehemiah 2:8#1 Alia exempl..n: Die Tore werden ausdrücklich der Festung des Hauses zugeordnet.
Nehemiah 2:8#1 Alia exempl..en: The gates are explicitly assigned to the citadel of the house.

Nehemiah 2:8#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ὡς χεὶρ θεοῦ ἡ ἀγαθή. Alia exempl. κατὰ τὴν χεῖρα τοῦ θεοῦ μου τὴν ἀγαθὴν ἐπ᾿ ἐμέ.^13
Nehemiah 2:8#2 Alia exempl..n: „Die gute Hand meines Gottes über mir“ statt „wie die gute Hand Gottes“.
Nehemiah 2:8#2 Alia exempl..en: “My God’s good hand upon me” instead of “like God’s good hand”.

Nehemiah 2:12#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. μετὰ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ. Alia exempl. τῇ Ἱερουσαλὴμ καὶ μετὰ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.^15
Nehemiah 2:12#0 Alia exempl..n: Jerusalem wird neben Israel zusätzlich genannt.
Nehemiah 2:12#0 Alia exempl..en: Jerusalem is additionally named alongside Israel.

Nehemiah 2:13#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ πρὸς στόμα πηγῆς τῶν συκῶν. Alia exempl. καὶ κατὰ πρόσωπον τῆς πηγῆς τοῦ δράκοντος.^17

0886.0.17.la: Sic Comp. (cum πρὸς στ. πηγῆς τοῦ δρ.), Codd. 93 (cum γῆς pro πηγῆς), 108. Hieron.: _et ante fontem draconis._
0886.0.17.en: So Comp. (with πρὸς στ. πηγῆς τοῦ δρ.), Codd. 93 (with γῆς for πηγῆς), 108. Hieron.: “_and before the dragon's fountain._”

Nehemiah 2:13#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. συντρίβων ἐν τῷ τείχει. Alia exempl. κατανοῶν τοῖς τείχεσιν.^18
Nehemiah 2:13#2 Alia exempl..n: „Die Mauern betrachtend“ statt „an der Mauer zerbrechend“.
Nehemiah 2:13#2 Alia exempl..en: “Inspecting the walls” instead of “breaking at the wall”.

0886.0.18.la: Iidem. Hieron.: _considerabam murum._ Ad alteram lectionem שֹׁבֵר cf. De Dieu _Crit. Sacr._ p. 89.
0886.0.18.en: The same. Hieron.: “_I viewed the wall._” On the other reading שֹׁבֵר cf. De Dieu _Crit. Sacr._ p. 89.

Nehemiah 2:14#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τοῦ ἀΐν. Alia exempl. τῆς πηγῆς.^20
Nehemiah 2:14#0 Alia exempl..en: “Of the spring” translates the untranslated expression.

Nehemiah 2:15#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐν τῷ τείχει χειμάρρου. Alia exempl. διὰ τοῦ χειμάρρου.^21
Nehemiah 2:15#0 Alia exempl..en: “Through the stream” instead of “at the stream’s wall”.

Nehemiah 2:15#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἤμην συντρίβων ἐν τῷ τείχει. Alia exempl. καὶ κατενόουν τῷ τείχει.^22
Nehemiah 2:15#1 Alia exempl..n: „Ich betrachtete die Mauer“ statt „ich zerbrach an der Mauer“.
Nehemiah 2:15#1 Alia exempl..en: “I inspected the wall” instead of “I was breaking at the wall”.

0886.0.22.la: Sic Comp. (cum καὶ ἤμην κατανοῶν), Codd. 93, 108.
0886.0.22.en: So Comp. (with καὶ ἤμην κατανοῶν), Codd. 93, 108.

Nehemiah 2:15#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἤμην ἐν πύλῃ τῆς φάραγγος, καὶ ἐπέστρεψα. Alia exempl. καὶ ἤμην ἐν τῇ πύλῃ τῆς φάραγγος, καὶ ἀνέστρεψα, καὶ διῆλθον διὰ τῆς πύλης γαΐ.^23
Nehemiah 2:15#2 Alia exempl..n: Das Durchschreiten des Gai-Tores wird zusätzlich zur Rückkehr genannt.
Nehemiah 2:15#2 Alia exempl..en: Passing through the Gai Gate is mentioned in addition to returning.

Nehemiah 2:16#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ τοῖς ἐντίμοις, καὶ τοῖς στρατηγοῖς. Alia exempl. καὶ τοῖς Λευΐταις, καὶ τοῖς ἄρχουσιν.^24
Nehemiah 2:16#0 Alia exempl..en: “Levites and leaders” instead of “notables and commanders”.

Nehemiah 2:17#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τὴν πονηρίαν [ταύτην] ἐν ᾗ ἐσμεν ἐν αὐτῇ. Alia exempl. τὰ κακὰ ἐν οἷς ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν ἐν αὐτοῖς.^25
Nehemiah 2:17#0 Alia exempl..n: „Die Übel, in denen wir sind“ statt „die Not, in der wir sind“.
Nehemiah 2:17#0 Alia exempl..en: “The troubles we are in” instead of “the distress we are in”.

Nehemiah 2:17#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐδόθησαν πυρί. Alia exempl. πυρίκαυστοι.^26

Nehemiah 2:18#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ εἶπα. Alia exempl. καὶ αὐτοὶ εἶπόν μοι.^27
Nehemiah 2:18#0 Alia exempl..en: “They said to me” instead of “I said”.

Nehemiah 2:19#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐξεγέλασαν ἡμᾶς, καὶ ἦλθον ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐξεμυκτήρισαν ἡμᾶς, καὶ κατεφρόνουν ἡμῶν, καὶ ἦλθον ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς.^28
Nehemiah 2:19#0 Alia exempl..n: Das Verachten wird zusätzlich zum Verspotten genannt.
Nehemiah 2:19#0 Alia exempl..en: Despising is mentioned in addition to mocking.

0887.0.28.la: Sic Codd. 93 (cum κατευφρόνουν), 108 (cum ὑμᾶς pro ἡμῶν). In textu LXXvirali pro καὶ ἦλθον ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς Comp. edidit καὶ κατεφρόνουν ἡμῶν.
0887.0.28.en: So Codd. 93 (with κατευφρόνουν), 108 (with ὑμᾶς for ἡμῶν). In the LXX text, for καὶ ἦλθον ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς Comp. printed καὶ κατεφρόνουν ἡμῶν.

Nehemiah 2:19#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἢ ἐπὶ τὸν βασιλέα. Alia exempl. μὴ κατὰ τοῦ βασιλέως.^29
Nehemiah 2:19#1 Alia exempl..n: „Etwa gegen den König?“ statt „oder auf den König?“.
Nehemiah 2:19#1 Alia exempl..en: “Surely not against the king?” instead of “or toward the king?”.

Nehemiah 2:20#0 Alia exempl..n: „Er führt zum Ziel“ statt „er lässt Erfolg haben“.
Nehemiah 2:20#0 Alia exempl..en: “He guides to success” instead of “he grants prosperity”.

Nehemiah 2:20#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καθαροί (נְקִיִּם). Alia exempl. καθαροὶ ἀναστησόμεθα.^31

0887.0.31.la: Sic Comp. (cum καθ. καὶ ἀναστησώμεθα), Codd. 93, 108, 121.
0887.0.31.en: So Comp. (with καθ. καὶ ἀναστησώμεθα), Codd. 93, 108, 121.

Nehemiah 3:2#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρας ἀνδρῶν υἱῶν. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐχόμενα αὐτοῦ (ᾠκοδόμησαν) οἱ ἄνδρες.^1
Nehemiah 3:2#0 Alia exempl..n: „Neben ihm bauten die Männer“ statt der unklaren Verbindung mit Männerhänden.
Nehemiah 3:2#0 Alia exempl..en: “The men built beside him” replaces the unclear connection with men’s hands.

0887.1.1.la: Sic Codd. 93, 108. Mox καὶ ἐχόμενα αὐτοῦ (sic constanter) ᾠκοδόμησεν Ζ. υἱὸς Ἀμαρὶ iidem. Cf. Hex. ad 1 Paral. vi. 31.
0887.1.1.en: So Codd. 93, 108. Presently καὶ ἐχόμενα αὐτοῦ (so constantly) ᾠκοδόμησεν Ζ. υἱὸς Ἀμαρὶ the same. Cf. Hex. on 1 Paral. vi. 31.

Nehemiah 3:4#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπὶ (alia exempl. ἀπὸ) Ῥαμώθ. Alia exempl. Μαριμώθ.^4
Nehemiah 3:4#1 Alia exempl..en: “Meremoth” instead of the divided phrase “at Ramoth”.

Nehemiah 3:5#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἀδωρίμ. Alia exempl. καὶ οἱ ἰσχυροὶ αὐτῶν.^5
Nehemiah 3:5#0 Alia exempl..en: “Their mighty men” translates the untranslated expression.

Nehemiah 3:5#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. εἰς δουλείαν αὐτῶν. Alia exempl. ἐν τῇ δουλείᾳ τοῦ κυρίου.^6
Nehemiah 3:5#1 Alia exempl..n: „Im Dienst des Herrn“ statt „zu ihrem Dienst“.
Nehemiah 3:5#1 Alia exempl..en: “In the Lord’s service” instead of “for their service”.

0887.1.6.la: Sic Comp. (cum εἰς δ. τοῦ κ. αὐτῶν), Codd. 93, 108.
0887.1.6.en: So Comp. (with εἰς δ. τοῦ κ. αὐτῶν), Codd. 93, 108.

Nehemiah 3:6#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἰασαναΐ. Alia exempl. τοῦ ἰασανά.^7 Ἄλλος· τῆς παλαιᾶς.^8
Nehemiah 3:6#0 Alia exempl..n: Andere grammatische Verbindung des unübersetzten Tornamens.
Nehemiah 3:6#0 Alia exempl..en: A different grammatical connection of the untranslated gate name.

0887.1.7.la: Sic Comp., Ald. (cum ἰασαναὶ), Codd. III (cum αἰσανὰ), 44, 64, alii.
0887.1.7.en: So Comp., Ald. (with ἰασαναὶ), Codd. III (with αἰσανὰ), 44, 64, and others.

0887.1.8.en: Cod. 108 in the margin without name.

Nehemiah 3:6#0 Ἄλλος.unitText: Ο΄. ἰασαναΐ. Alia exempl. τοῦ ἰασανά.^7 Ἄλλος· τῆς παλαιᾶς.^8
Nehemiah 3:6#0 Ἄλλος.n: „Des alten Tores“ übersetzt den unübersetzten Tornamen.
Nehemiah 3:6#0 Ἄλλος.en: “Of the old gate” translates the untranslated gate name.

0887.1.7.la: Sic Comp., Ald. (cum ἰασαναὶ), Codd. III (cum αἰσανὰ), 44, 64, alii.
0887.1.7.en: So Comp., Ald. (with ἰασαναὶ), Codd. III (with αἰσανὰ), 44, 64, and others.

0887.1.8.en: Cod. 108 in the margin without name.

Nehemiah 3:8#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. παρησφαλίσατο … ἐκράτησεν. Alia exempl. ἐκραταίωσεν (bis).^9
Nehemiah 3:8#0 Alia exempl..n: „Er verstärkte“ wird zweimal mit demselben Verb wiedergegeben.
Nehemiah 3:8#0 Alia exempl..en: “He strengthened” is rendered twice with the same verb.

Nehemiah 3:8#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τοῦ ῥωκεΐμ. Alia exempl. τῶν μυρεψῶν.^10
Nehemiah 3:8#1 Alia exempl..en: “Of the perfumers” translates the untranslated expression.

Nehemiah 3:11#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ δεύτερος. Alia exempl. καὶ μέτρον δεύτερον.^12
Nehemiah 3:11#0 Alia exempl..en: “A second section” instead of merely “a second”.

Nehemiah 3:11#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Φαάτ. Alia exempl. Φαὰθ ἡγουμένου.^13
Nehemiah 3:11#1 Alia exempl..n: „Des Anführers“ wird dem Namen Phahat hinzugefügt.
Nehemiah 3:11#1 Alia exempl..en: “Of the leader” is added to the name Phaath.

0887.1.13.la: Sic Codd. 93 (cum ἡγούμενος), 108. Cf. Hex. ad Esdr. x. 30.
0887.1.13.en: So Codd. 93 (with ἡγούμενος), 108. Cf. Hex. on Esdr. x. 30.

Nehemiah 3:11#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἕως πύργου. Alia exempl. καὶ τὸν πύργον.^14
Nehemiah 3:11#2 Alia exempl..en: “The tower” instead of “as far as the tower”.

Nehemiah 3:13#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐκράτησαν. Alia exempl. ἴσχυσαν (s. ἐνίσχυσαν).^15
Nehemiah 3:13#0 Alia exempl..en: “They grew strong” instead of “they held fast”.

Nehemiah 3:15#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ τὸ τεῖχος κολυμβήθρας τῶν κωδίων τῇ κουρᾷ (לְגֶז־) τοῦ βασιλέως. Alia exempl. καὶ τὸ τεῖχος τῆς κρήνης τῆς Σιλωὰ εἰς τὸν κῆπον τοῦ βασιλέως.^16
Nehemiah 3:15#0 Alia exempl..n: „Siloahquelle beim Königsgarten“ statt der anders aufgeteilten Wörter für Becken und Schafschur.
Nehemiah 3:15#0 Alia exempl..en: “Siloam spring by the king’s garden” replaces differently divided words for pool and sheep-shearing.

0887.1.16.la: Sic Comp. (cum κολυμβήθρας pro κρήνης), Codd. 93 (cum prava scriptura καὶ τὴν πύλην τῆς πηγῆς ἐκραταίωσεν εἰς τὸν κ. τοῦ β.), 108.
0887.1.16.en: So Comp. (with κολυμβήθρας for κρήνης), Codd. 93 (with the corrupt reading καὶ τὴν πύλην τῆς πηγῆς ἐκραταίωσεν εἰς τὸν κ. τοῦ β.), 108.

Nehemiah 3:15#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τῶν κλιμάκων. Alia exempl. τῶν βαθμῶν.^17
Nehemiah 3:15#1 Alia exempl..en: “Of the steps” instead of “of the stairways”.

Nehemiah 3:16#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἕως Βηθαγγαρίμ (potior scriptura Βηθαγγαβαρίμ). Alia exempl. καὶ ἕως οἴκου τῶν δυνατῶν.^18
Nehemiah 3:16#0 Alia exempl..en: “House of the mighty” translates the place name.

0887.1.18.la: Iidem. Hieron.: _et usque ad domum fortium._
0887.1.18.en: The same. Hieron.: "_and even unto the house of the mighty._"

Nehemiah 3:19#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. πύργου ἀναβάσεως τῆς συναπτούσης τῆς γωνίας. Alia exempl. ἐξεναντίας πύργου τῶν ὅπλων τῆς συναπτούσης εἰς τὴν γωνίαν.^19
Nehemiah 3:19#0 Alia exempl..n: Der Turm wird ausdrücklich als Waffenturm statt als Aufstiegsturm bezeichnet.
Nehemiah 3:19#0 Alia exempl..en: The tower is explicitly called an armoury tower instead of an ascent tower.

0887.1.19.la: Sic Comp. (om. πύργου), Codd. 93, 108. Cf. Hex. ad 2 Paral. ix. 24.
0887.1.19.en: So Comp. (omitting πύργου), Codd. 93, 108. Cf. Hex. on 2 Paral.

Nehemiah 3:19#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. μετ’ αὐτὸν ἐκράτησε. Alia exempl. ὀπίσω εἰς τὸ ὄρος αὐτοῦ μετ’ αὐτὸν ἐκραταίωσε.^20
Nehemiah 3:19#1 Alia exempl..n: Eine zusätzliche Angabe „hinten zu seinem Berg“ steht vor der Verstärkung.
Nehemiah 3:19#1 Alia exempl..en: An additional phrase “behind toward his mountain” precedes the repair.

0888.0.20.la: Sic Comp. (cum ἐκράτησε pro μετ’ αὐτὸν ἐκραταίωσε), Codd. 93, 108.
0888.0.20.en: So Comp. (with ἐκράτησε for μετ’ αὐτὸν ἐκραταίωσε), Codd. 93, 108.

Nehemiah 3:24#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἀπὸ Βηθαζαρία. Alia exempl. ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου Ἀζαρίου.^23
Nehemiah 3:24#0 Alia exempl..n: „Vom Haus Asarjas“ statt des zusammengezogenen Ortsnamens Bethasaria.
Nehemiah 3:24#0 Alia exempl..en: “From Azariah’s house” instead of the combined place name Bethazaria.

Nehemiah 3:25#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ὁ πύργος ὁ ἐξέχων ‥ ὁ ἀνώτερος ὁ τῆς αὐλῆς. Alia exempl. τοῦ πύργου τοῦ ἐξέχοντος ‥ ἐπάνω τῆς αὐλῆς.^24
Nehemiah 3:25#0 Alia exempl..n: Der vorspringende Turm wird ausdrücklich oberhalb des Hofs verortet.
Nehemiah 3:25#0 Alia exempl..en: The projecting tower is explicitly located above the courtyard.

0888.0.24.la: Sic Comp. (cum καὶ τοῦ πύργου), Codd. 93, 108.
0888.0.24.en: So Comp. (with καὶ τοῦ πύργου), Codd. 93, 108.

Nehemiah 3:26#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἕως κήπου πύλης. Alia exempl. ἕως ἀπέναντι κήπου τῆς πύλης.^25
Nehemiah 3:26#0 Alia exempl..n: „Gegenüber dem Garten des Tores“ statt „bis zum Torgarten“.
Nehemiah 3:26#0 Alia exempl..en: “Opposite the gate’s garden” instead of “as far as the gate garden”.

Nehemiah 3:31#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἕως Βηθανναθινὶμ, καὶ οἱ ῥοποπῶλαι (potior scriptura ῥωποπῶλαι. Cf. Hex. ad 3 Reg. x. 15. Ezech. xxvii. 8). Alia exempl. ἕως οἴκου τῶν Ναθιναίων καὶ τῶν μεταβόλων.^26
Nehemiah 3:31#0 Alia exempl..n: „Haus der Tempeldiener und Händler“ statt der zusammengezogenen Ortsbezeichnung.
Nehemiah 3:31#0 Alia exempl..en: “House of the temple servants and merchants” replaces the combined place designation.

0888.0.26.la: Sic Comp., Codd. 93 (cum ἀθηναίων), 108. Cf. Hex. ad Ezech. xvii. 4.
0888.0.26.en: So Comp., Codd. 93 (with ἀθηναίων), 108. Cf. Hex. on Ezech. xvii. 4.

Nehemiah 3:31#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τοῦ Μαφεκάδ. Alia exempl. τῆς ἐπισκέψεως.^27
Nehemiah 3:31#1 Alia exempl..n: „Der Musterung“ übersetzt den unübersetzten Tornamen Mifkad.
Nehemiah 3:31#1 Alia exempl..en: “Of the muster” translates the untranslated gate name Miphkad.

0888.0.27.en: The same. Hieron.: "_over against the gate of judgment._"

Nehemiah 3:32#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἀναμέσον (alia exempl. add. ἀναβάσεως^28) τῆς πύλης. Alia exempl. καὶ ἕως ἀναμέσον τῆς ἀναβάσεως τῆς πύλης.^29
Nehemiah 3:32#0 Alia exempl..n: Der Aufstieg des Tores wird ausdrücklich in die Ortsangabe aufgenommen.
Nehemiah 3:32#0 Alia exempl..en: The gate’s ascent is explicitly included in the location statement.

Nehemiah 3:32#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. οἱ χαλκεῖς καὶ οἱ ῥοποπῶλαι. Alia exempl. οἱ χαλκουργοὶ καὶ οἱ μετάβολοι.^30
Nehemiah 3:32#1 Alia exempl..en: “Metalworkers and merchants” instead of “smiths and petty traders”.

Nehemiah 3:33#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπὶ πολύ. Alia exempl. σφόδρα.^2

Nehemiah 3:33#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐξεγέλα ἐπὶ τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐμυκτήριζε τοὺς Ἰουδαίους.^3
Nehemiah 3:33#2 Alia exempl..n: „Er verhöhnte die Juden“ statt „er lachte über die Juden“.
Nehemiah 3:33#2 Alia exempl..en: “He derided the Jews” instead of “he laughed at the Jews”.

Nehemiah 3:34#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. αὕτη ἡ δύναμις Σομόρων. Alia exempl. καὶ τῆς δυνάμεως Σαμαρείας.^4
Nehemiah 3:34#0 Alia exempl..n: „Des Heeres Samarias“ statt „dies ist die Macht Somorons“.
Nehemiah 3:34#0 Alia exempl..en: “Of Samaria’s army” instead of “this is Somoron’s power”.

Nehemiah 3:34#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ὅτι οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι οὗτοι οἰκοδομοῦσι τὴν ἑαυτῶν πόλιν. Alia exempl. καὶ εἶπεν· τί οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι οὐδαμινοὶ οὗτοι ποιοῦσιν, ὅτι οἰκοδομοῦσι τὴν ἑαυτῶν πόλιν;^5
Nehemiah 3:34#1 Alia exempl..n: Eine spöttische Frage bezeichnet die Juden ausdrücklich als unbedeutend.
Nehemiah 3:34#1 Alia exempl..en: A mocking question explicitly describes the Jews as insignificant.

0888.1.5.la: Sic Comp. (cum οἱ οὐδ. οὗτοι π. οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι tantum), Codd. 93 (cum οἱ δυνάμενοι pro οὐδαμινοὶ), 108. Hesych.: Οὐδαμινός· οὐδενὸς λόγου ἄξιός ἐστι, βραχὺς, εὐτελής. S. Chrysost. Opp. T. XI, p. 88 F (de injuriis sibi illatis): Εἰ τοῦτο γέγονεν, οὐδὲν ἂν ἦν, οὐδαμινὸν ἄνθρωπον καὶ οὐδενὸς ἄξιον λόγου τοιαῦτα πάσχειν.
0888.1.5.en: So Comp. (with οἱ οὐδ. οὗτοι π. οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι only), Codd. 93 (with οἱ δυνάμενοι for οὐδαμινοὶ), 108. Hesych.: Οὐδαμινός· οὐδενὸς λόγου ἄξιός ἐστι, βραχὺς, εὐτελής. S. Chrysost. Opp. T. XI, p. 88 F (concerning the injuries inflicted on himself): Εἰ τοῦτο γέγονεν, οὐδὲν ἂν ἦν, οὐδαμινὸν ἄνθρωπον καὶ οὐδενὸς ἄξιον λόγου τοιαῦτα πάσχειν.

Nehemiah 3:34#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. μὴ καταλείψομεν αὐτούς;^6
Nehemiah 3:34#2 Alia exempl..n: „Werden wir sie etwa gewähren lassen?“ wird ergänzt.
Nehemiah 3:34#2 Alia exempl..en: “Shall we let them be?” is added.

Nehemiah 3:34#3 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καυθέντας. Alia exempl. καυθέντας, καὶ τὸ τεῖχος (וְחוֹמָה) ἐμπεπρησμένον.^7
Nehemiah 3:34#3 Alia exempl..n: Die verbrannte Mauer wird neben den verbrannten Steinen zusätzlich genannt.
Nehemiah 3:34#3 Alia exempl..en: The burned wall is mentioned in addition to the burned stones.

Nehemiah 3:35#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐχόμενα αὐτοῦ ἦλθε. Alia exempl. ἦν ἐχόμενα αὐτοῦ.^8
Nehemiah 3:35#0 Alia exempl..n: „Er war neben ihm“ statt „er kam neben ihn“.
Nehemiah 3:35#0 Alia exempl..en: “He was beside him” instead of “he came beside him”.

Nehemiah 3:35#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. μὴ θυσιάζουσιν (potior scriptura θυσιάσουσιν) ἢ φάγονται ἐπὶ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῶν; Alia exempl. καίγε αὐτοὶ οἰκοδομοῦσιν· μὴ θυσιάζουσιν—αὐτῶν;^9
Nehemiah 3:35#1 Alia exempl..n: „Sie bauen tatsächlich“ wird vor der Frage nach dem Opfern ergänzt.
Nehemiah 3:35#1 Alia exempl..en: “They really are building” is added before the question about sacrificing.

Nehemiah 3:35#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. οὐχὶ ἀναβήσεται ‥ καὶ καθελεῖ. Alia exempl. ἐὰν ἀναβῇ ‥ καθελεῖ.^10
Nehemiah 3:35#2 Alia exempl..n: „Wenn er hinaufsteigt“ statt „wird er nicht hinaufsteigen?“.
Nehemiah 3:35#2 Alia exempl..en: “If it climbs up” instead of “will it not climb up?”.

Nehemiah 3:37#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπὶ ἀνομίαν. Alia exempl. ἐπὶ τὴν ἀνομίαν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἡ ἁμαρτία αὐτῶν ἐκ προσώπου σου μὴ ἐξαλειφθείη, ὅτι παρώργισαν ἐναντίον τῶν οἰκοδομούντων.^11
Nehemiah 3:37#1 Alia exempl..n: Die Bitte, ihre Sünde nicht zu tilgen, und die Begründung werden ergänzt.
Nehemiah 3:37#1 Alia exempl..en: The plea not to erase their sin and its reason are added.

0889.0.11.la: Sic Comp. (om. τὴν), Codd. 93, 108. Lucif. Calar.: (_Et ne operias_) _iniquitatem ipsorum, et peccata eorum a facie tua non deleantur_ …
0889.0.11.en: So Comp. (omitting τὴν), Codd. 93, 108. Lucif. Calar.: "(_And cover not_) _their iniquity, and let not their sins be blotted out from before thy face_ …"

Nehemiah 3:38#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. καὶ ᾠκοδομήσαμεν τὸ τεῖχος, καὶ συνήφθη πᾶν τὸ τεῖχος ἕως τοῦ ἡμίσους αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ καρδία τοῦ λαοῦ ὥστε οἰκοδομῆσαι.^12
Nehemiah 3:38#0 Alia exempl..n: Der Mauerbau bis zur halben Höhe und der Arbeitswille des Volkes werden ergänzt.
Nehemiah 3:38#0 Alia exempl..en: Building the wall to half its height and the people’s willingness to work are added.

Nehemiah 4:1#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. καὶ οἱ Ἀζώτιοι.^13

0889.0.13.en: So Comp., Codd. 71, 93, 106, 108 (with Ἀζάτιοι), and others.

Nehemiah 4:1#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. αἱ διασφαγαί. Alia exempl. αἱ διακοπαί.^14

Nehemiah 4:2#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. παρατάξασθαι. Alia exempl. καὶ πολεμῆσαι.^16
Nehemiah 4:2#0 Alia exempl..en: “Wage war” instead of “form up for battle”.

Nehemiah 4:5#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. οἱ θλίβοντες ἡμᾶς. Alia exempl. οἱ ἐκθλίβοντες ἡμᾶς, καὶ οἱ ἐπίβουλοι ἡμῶν.^18
Nehemiah 4:5#0 Alia exempl..n: Verschwörer werden zusätzlich zu den Bedrängern genannt.
Nehemiah 4:5#0 Alia exempl..en: Plotters are mentioned in addition to oppressors.

Nehemiah 4:6#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. ὧν (s. ὅτι) ἐπεστρέψατε.^20
Nehemiah 4:6#0 Alia exempl..n: Eine Aussage über eure Rückkehr wird ergänzt.
Nehemiah 4:6#0 Alia exempl..en: A statement about your return is added.

Nehemiah 4:7#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἔστησα εἰς τὰ κατώτατα τοῦ τόπου κατόπισθεν τοῦ τείχους ἐν τοῖς σκεπεινοῖς. Alia exempl. add. καὶ ἔστησα ὑποκάτωθεν τοῦ τόπου ἐξόπισθεν τοῦ τείχους ἐν τοῖς ἀναπεπταμένοις.^21
Nehemiah 4:7#0 Alia exempl..n: Eine zweite Aufstellung in offenen statt geschützten Bereichen wird ergänzt.
Nehemiah 4:7#0 Alia exempl..en: A second deployment in open rather than sheltered areas is added.

0889.0.21.la: Sic Codd. 93 (cum ἔστησαν), 108. Suidas: Ἀναπεπταμένα χωρία· πεδία, κάμποι.
0889.0.21.en: So Codd. 93 (with ἔστησαν), 108. Suidas: Ἀναπεπταμένα χωρία· πεδία, κάμποι.

Nehemiah 4:7#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. κατὰ δήμους. Alia exempl. κατὰ συγγενείας αὐτῶν.^22
Nehemiah 4:7#1 Alia exempl..en: “By their kinship groups” instead of “by divisions”.

0889.0.22.la: Iidem. Statim μετὰ τῶν μαχαιρῶν αὐτῶν, καὶ τῶν δοράτων αὐτῶν, καὶ τῶν τόξων αὐτῶν iidem.
0889.0.22.en: The same. Immediately after, μετὰ τῶν μαχαιρῶν αὐτῶν, καὶ τῶν δοράτων αὐτῶν, καὶ τῶν τόξων αὐτῶν the same.

Nehemiah 4:8#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. μνήσθητε τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ‥ Alia exempl. καὶ ὥρκισα αὐτοὺς κύριον λέγων· τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ‥ μνήσθητε.^23
Nehemiah 4:8#0 Alia exempl..n: Eine feierliche Beschwörung beim Herrn wird vor der Erinnerung an Gott ergänzt.
Nehemiah 4:8#0 Alia exempl..en: A solemn adjuration by the Lord is added before the reminder of God.

Nehemiah 4:11#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐν ὅπλοις. Alia exempl. ἔνοπλοι.^25

Nehemiah 4:11#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τὴν βολίδα. Alia exempl. τὸ ὅπλον.^26

Nehemiah 4:16#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἕκαστος μετὰ τοῦ νεανίσκου αὐτοῦ. Alia exempl. ἀνὴρ καὶ τὸ παιδάριον αὐτοῦ.^27
Nehemiah 4:16#0 Alia exempl..n: „Ein Mann und sein Knecht“ statt „jeder mit seinem jungen Mann“.
Nehemiah 4:16#0 Alia exempl..en: “A man and his servant” instead of “each with his young man”.

0889.0.27.la: Iidem. Clausula deest in Codd. II, III, XI, 55, 58.
0889.0.27.en: The same. The clause is wanting in Codd. II, III, XI, 55, 58.

Nehemiah 4:17#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἤμην ἐγώ. Alia exempl. καὶ ἤμην ἐγὼ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί μου καὶ τὰ παιδάρια.^28
Nehemiah 4:17#0 Alia exempl..n: Seine Brüder und Diener werden ausdrücklich neben ihm genannt.
Nehemiah 4:17#0 Alia exempl..en: His brothers and servants are explicitly named alongside him.

Nehemiah 4:17#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. καὶ ἄνδρα ὃν ἀπέστελλον (שִׁלְחוּ) ἐπὶ τὸ ὕδωρ· ἀνὴρ καὶ ὅπλον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ὕδωρ.^29
Nehemiah 4:17#1 Alia exempl..n: Das Wasserschöpfen mit mitgeführter Waffe wird ergänzt.
Nehemiah 4:17#1 Alia exempl..en: Fetching water while carrying a weapon is added.

0889.0.29.la: Duplex versio est in Codd. 93, 108 (cum καὶ τὸ ὅπλον); posterior tantum in Comp.
0889.0.29.en: A double version is in Codd. 93, 108 (with καὶ τὸ ὅπλον); the latter only in Comp.

Nehemiah 5:2#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ληψόμεθα. Alia exempl. δότε οὖν ἡμῖν.^1
Nehemiah 5:2#0 Alia exempl..en: “Give us therefore” instead of “we will take”.

0889.1.1.la: Sic Codd. 93, 108. Mox (v. 3) τοὺς ἀγροὺς ἡμῶν καὶ τοὺς ἀμπελῶνας ἡμῶν καὶ τὰς οἰκίας ἡμῶν ἡμεῖς διενεγγυήσαμεν, καὶ ἐλάβομεν σῖτον, καὶ ἐφάγομεν iidem.

Nehemiah 5:5#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ εἰσὶν ἀπὸ θυγατέρων ἡμῶν καταδυναστευόμεναι. Alia exempl. καί τινες τῶν θυγατέρων ἡμῶν βίᾳ ἀφαιροῦνται.^3
Nehemiah 5:5#0 Alia exempl..n: „Gewaltsam weggenommen“ statt „unterdrückt“ für das Schicksal der Töchter.
Nehemiah 5:5#0 Alia exempl..en: “Taken away by force” instead of “oppressed” describes the daughters’ plight.

Nehemiah 5:5#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ οὐκ ἔστι δύναμις χειρῶν ἡμῶν. Alia exempl. καὶ οὐκ ἰσχύει ἡ χεὶρ ἡμῶν.^4
Nehemiah 5:5#1 Alia exempl..n: „Unsere Hand ist nicht stark“ statt „die Kraft unserer Hände fehlt“.
Nehemiah 5:5#1 Alia exempl..en: “Our hand is not strong” instead of “our hands lack strength”.

Nehemiah 5:7#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐβουλεύσατο καρδία μου ἐπ’ ἐμέ. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐβουλευσάμην ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ μου.^5
Nehemiah 5:7#0 Alia exempl..n: „Ich überlegte in meinem Herzen“ statt „mein Herz beriet gegen mich“.
Nehemiah 5:7#0 Alia exempl..en: “I deliberated in my heart” instead of “my heart took counsel against me”.

Nehemiah 5:8#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐν ἑκουσίῳ ἡμῶν. Alia exempl. ἱκανῶς τέκνα ἐποιήσατε.^8
Nehemiah 5:8#0 Alia exempl..n: „Ihr habt genügend Kinder gemacht“ statt „nach unserem freien Willen“.
Nehemiah 5:8#0 Alia exempl..en: “You have made enough children” instead of “according to our free will”.

0890.0.8.la: Sic Codd. 93, 108, 121. Vide Parsons. in _Var. Lect._
0890.0.8.en: So Codd. 93, 108, 121. See Parsons. in _Var. Lect._

Nehemiah 5:10#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐγκατελίπομεν δὴ τὴν ἀπαίτησιν ταύτην. Alia exempl. ἀποθέσθαι ἀφ’ ἡμῶν τὸ βάρος (הַמַּשָּׁא) τοῦτο.^10
Nehemiah 5:10#0 Alia exempl..n: „Diese Last von uns ablegen“ statt „diese Forderung aufgeben“.
Nehemiah 5:10#0 Alia exempl..en: “Lay this burden aside from us” instead of “abandon this demand”.

Nehemiah 5:11#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπιστρέψατε δή. Alia exempl. καὶ ἀπόδοτε αὐτοῖς.^11
Nehemiah 5:11#0 Alia exempl..en: “Give back to them” instead of “turn back”.

Nehemiah 5:14#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἀπὸ ἡμέρας. Alia exempl. καίγε ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας.^12
Nehemiah 5:14#0 Alia exempl..n: Ein zusätzliches „auch“ betont den Beginn der Zeitspanne.
Nehemiah 5:14#0 Alia exempl..en: An additional “also” emphasizes the start of the period.

Nehemiah 5:14#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. βίαν αὐτῶν οὐκ ἔφαγον. Alia exempl. ἄρτον τῆς ἡγεμονίας μου οὐκ ἐφάγομεν.^13
Nehemiah 5:14#1 Alia exempl..n: „Wir aßen das Statthalterbrot nicht“ statt „ich aß ihre Gewalt nicht“.
Nehemiah 5:14#1 Alia exempl..en: “We did not eat the governor’s allowance” instead of “I did not eat their violence”.

Nehemiah 5:15#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ τὰς βίας τὰς πρώτας ἃς πρὸ ἐμοῦ ἐβάρυναν ἐπ’ αὐτούς. Alia exempl. οἱ δὲ ἄρχοντες οἱ ἔμπροσθέν μου ἐβάρυναν κλοιὸν ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν.^14
Nehemiah 5:15#0 Alia exempl..n: Die früheren Statthalter belasten ausdrücklich das Volk mit einem Joch.
Nehemiah 5:15#0 Alia exempl..en: The former governors explicitly burden the people with a yoke.

Nehemiah 5:15#1 Alia exempl..en: “Shekels” instead of “didrachmas”; a different monetary unit.

Nehemiah 5:15#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ οἱ ἐκτετιναγμένοι αὐτῶν ἐξουσιάζονται. Alia exempl. καίγε τὰ παιδάρια αὐτῶν ἐκυρίευσαν.^16
Nehemiah 5:15#2 Alia exempl..n: „Ihre Diener herrschten“ statt „ihre Ausgestoßenen üben Macht aus“.
Nehemiah 5:15#2 Alia exempl..en: “Their servants ruled” instead of “their outcasts exercise authority”.

Nehemiah 5:16#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τοῦ τείχους τούτων οὐκ ἐκράτησα. Alia exempl. τοῦ τείχους τούτου κατίσχυσα.^17
Nehemiah 5:16#0 Alia exempl..n: Er stärkte die Mauer, statt sie nicht zu unterstützen.
Nehemiah 5:16#0 Alia exempl..en: He strengthened the wall instead of failing to support it.

Nehemiah 5:16#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ πάντες. Alia exempl. καὶ τὰ παιδάριά μου καὶ πάντες.^18

Nehemiah 5:17#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες.^19

Nehemiah 5:17#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπὶ τράπεζάν μου. Alia exempl. ἐπὶ τὴν τράπεζάν μου ἐξενίζοντο.^20
Nehemiah 5:17#1 Alia exempl..n: Die Bewirtung an seinem Tisch wird ausdrücklich als Gastfreundschaft bezeichnet.
Nehemiah 5:17#1 Alia exempl..en: Dining at his table is explicitly described as hospitality.

Nehemiah 5:18#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τῆς βίας. Alia exempl. τῆς ἡγεμονίας μου.^22

Nehemiah 5:18#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. βαρεῖα ἡ δουλεία. Alia exempl. ἐβαρύνθη τὸ ἔργον.^23
Nehemiah 5:18#2 Alia exempl..n: „Die Arbeit wurde schwer“ statt „die Knechtschaft war schwer“.
Nehemiah 5:18#2 Alia exempl..en: “The work became heavy” instead of “the servitude was heavy”.

Nehemiah 6:1#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ οὐ κατελείφθη ἐν αὐτοῖς πνοή. Alia exempl. καὶ οὐχ ὑπελείφθη ἐν αὐτῷ διακοπή.^1
Nehemiah 6:1#0 Alia exempl..n: „Keine Lücke blieb darin“ statt „kein Atem blieb in ihnen“.
Nehemiah 6:1#0 Alia exempl..en: “No gap remained in it” instead of “no breath remained in them”.

0890.1.1.la: Sic Comp. (cum οὐ κατ.), et cum duplici versione Codd. 93 (cum οὐ ὑπελήφθη ἐν αὐτοῖς), 108.
0890.1.1.en: So Comp. (with οὐ κατ.), and with a double version Codd. 93 (with οὐ ὑπελήφθη ἐν αὐτοῖς), 108.

Nehemiah 6:4#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. τέταρτον καθόδους; alia, τέσσαρσιν καθόδοις.^2
Nehemiah 6:4#0 Alia exempl..en: Coming four times is explicitly added.

0890.1.2.la: Prior lectio est in Codd. 44, 74, 106, aliis; posterior in Comp., Codd. 93, 108.
0890.1.2.en: The former reading is in Codd. 44, 74, 106, and others; the latter in Comp., Codd. 93, 108.

Nehemiah 6:5#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. κατὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦτον.^3

Nehemiah 6:5#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. τὸν πέμπτον.^4

0891.0.4.la: Sic Comp., Ald., Codd. 52, 64, 93, 108, 243, 248. Alii post τὸν παῖδα αὐτοῦ inferunt τὸ πέμπτον.
0891.0.4.en: So Comp., Ald., Codd. 52, 64, 93, 108, 243, 248. Others after τὸν παῖδα αὐτοῦ insert τὸ πέμπτον.

Nehemiah 6:6#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. καὶ Γησὰμ εἶπεν.^5

0891.0.5.en: So Comp., Ald., Codd. 52, 64, 93, 108, and others.

Nehemiah 6:7#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἵνα καθίσῃς ‥ εἰς βασιλέα ἐπὶ Ἰούδα. Alia exempl. κηρύσσειν περὶ σοῦ ‥ λέγοντας ὅτι ἐβασίλευσας ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ.^7
Nehemiah 6:7#1 Alia exempl..n: „Über dein Königtum ausrufen“ statt „damit du als König eingesetzt wirst“.
Nehemiah 6:7#1 Alia exempl..en: “Proclaim your kingship” instead of “so that you may be installed as king”.

Nehemiah 6:9#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐκραταίωσα τὰς χεῖράς μου. Alia exempl. ἐκραταιώθησαν αἱ χεῖρές μου.^8
Nehemiah 6:9#0 Alia exempl..n: „Meine Hände wurden gestärkt“ statt „ich stärkte meine Hände“.
Nehemiah 6:9#0 Alia exempl..en: “My hands were strengthened” instead of “I strengthened my hands”.

Nehemiah 6:10#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ κλείσωμεν τὰς θύρας αὐτοῦ. Alia exempl. καὶ ἀποκλείσωμεν τὰς θύρας τοῦ ναοῦ.^9
Nehemiah 6:10#0 Alia exempl..n: Die Türen werden ausdrücklich als Tempeltüren bezeichnet.
Nehemiah 6:10#0 Alia exempl..en: The doors are explicitly identified as temple doors.

Nehemiah 6:10#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ὅτι ἔρχονται νυκτὸς φονεῦσαί σε. Alia exempl. ὅτι ἔρχονται φονεῦσαί σε νυκτὸς, ἔρχονται ἀποκτεῖναί σε.^10
Nehemiah 6:10#1 Alia exempl..n: Die Morddrohung wird mit einem zweiten Verb nochmals wiederholt.
Nehemiah 6:10#1 Alia exempl..en: The death threat is repeated with a second verb.

0891.0.10.la: Iidem. Comp.: ὅτι ἔρχ. φ. σε, ἔρχ. νυκτὸς φ. σε.
0891.0.10.en: The same. Comp.: ὅτι ἔρχ. φ. σε, ἔρχ. νυκτὸς φ. σε.

Nehemiah 6:11#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τίς ἐστιν ὁ ἀνὴρ ὃς εἰσελεύσεται. Alia exempl. τίς ἐστιν ὁ ἀνὴρ οἷος ἐγὼ φεύξεται; ἢ τίς οἷος ἀνὴρ ὃς εἰσελεύσεται.^11 Alia: μὴ ἀνὴρ ἐγὼ οἷος ἀποδιδράσκειν; ἢ τίς οἷος ἐγὼ ὅστις εἰσελεύσεται.^12
Nehemiah 6:11#0 Alia exempl..n: Eine zusätzliche Frage weist ausdrücklich die Vorstellung seiner Flucht zurück.
Nehemiah 6:11#0 Alia exempl..en: An additional question explicitly rejects the idea of his fleeing.

0891.0.11.la: Sic Comp. (cum τίς ἐστιν ἀνὴρ … ἢ τίς οἷος ἐγὼ εἰσ.), Ald. (ut Comp., nisi ἐγὼ ὃς εἰσ.), Codd. III, 52 (om. ἀνὴρ), 64 (idem), 71, alii.
0891.0.11.en: So Comp. (with τίς ἐστιν ἀνὴρ … ἢ τίς οἷος ἐγὼ εἰσ.), Ald. (as Comp., except ἐγὼ ὃς εἰσ.), Codd. III, 52 (omitting ἀνὴρ), 64 (the same), 71, and others.

0891.0.12.la: Sic Codd. 93 (cum -κεις), 108 (cum εἴτις pro ἢ τίς). Symmachum sapit constructio elegantior, οἷος ἀποδιδράσκειν, Anglice, _likely to run away._ Statim ναὸν pro οἶκον iidem.
0891.0.12.en: So Codd. 93 (with -κεις), 108 (with εἴτις for ἢ τίς). The more elegant construction, οἷος ἀποδιδράσκειν, in English _likely to run away_, savours of Symmachus. Immediately after, ναὸν for οἶκον the same.

Nehemiah 6:11#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. οὐκ εἰσελεύσομαι.^13

Nehemiah 6:12#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ὅτι ἡ προφητεία λόγος κατ’ ἐμοῦ. Alia exempl. ὅτι ἡ προφῆτις ἐλάλησε πρὸς μέ.^14
Nehemiah 6:12#0 Alia exempl..n: „Die Prophetin sprach zu mir“ statt „das prophetische Wort gegen mich“.
Nehemiah 6:12#0 Alia exempl..en: “The prophetess spoke to me” instead of “the prophetic word against me”.

Nehemiah 6:12#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐμισθώσαντο ἐπ’ ἐμὲ ὄχλον. Alia exempl. ἐμισθώσαντο αὐτόν.^15
Nehemiah 6:12#1 Alia exempl..n: „Sie bestachen ihn“ statt „sie heuerten gegen mich eine Menge an“.
Nehemiah 6:12#1 Alia exempl..en: “They hired him” instead of “they hired a crowd against me”.

0891.0.15.la: Sic Comp., Codd. 93 (cum αὐτὸν ἐμισθήσαντο), 108 (cum ἐμισθώσατο).
0891.0.15.en: So Comp., Codd. 93 (with αὐτὸν ἐμισθήσαντο), 108 (with ἐμισθώσατο).

Nehemiah 6:14#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ τῷ Νωαδίᾳ τῷ προφήτῃ. Alia exempl. καίγε τῇ Ὤδῃ τῇ προφήτιδι.^16
Nehemiah 6:14#0 Alia exempl..n: Eine Prophetin Ode statt des Propheten Noadja.
Nehemiah 6:14#0 Alia exempl..en: A prophetess Ode instead of the prophet Noadiah.

Nehemiah 6:14#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἦσαν φοβερίζοντες. Alia exempl. ἐνουθέτουν.^17

Nehemiah 6:17#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἀπὸ πολλῶν ἐντίμων Ἰούδα ἐπιστολαί. Alia exempl. πολλοὶ ἦσαν τῶν ἐντίμων τῶν Ἰουδαίων, ὧν αἱ ἐπιστολαὶ αὐτῶν.^18
Nehemiah 6:17#0 Alia exempl..n: Die vielen Absender der Briefe werden ausdrücklich als Vornehme der Juden bezeichnet.
Nehemiah 6:17#0 Alia exempl..en: The many senders of letters are explicitly identified as Jewish notables.

Nehemiah 6:19#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ τοὺς λόγους αὐτοῦ ἦσαν λέγοντες πρὸς μέ. Alia exempl. καίγε τὰ συμφέροντα αὐτῷ ἔλεγον ἐνώπιόν μου.^19

Nehemiah 7:3#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἕως ἅμα τῷ ἡλίῳ. Alia exempl. ἕως ἂν ἀνατείλῃ ὁ ἥλιος.^3
Nehemiah 7:3#0 Alia exempl..n: „Bis die Sonne aufgeht“ statt „bis zusammen mit der Sonne“.
Nehemiah 7:3#0 Alia exempl..en: “Until the sun rises” instead of “until together with the sun”.

0891.1.3.la: Sic Codd. 93, 108 (om. ἂν). Hebraeo convenientius foret, ἕως ἂν διαθερμάνῃ ὁ ἥλιος, ut Seniores Exod. xvi. 21. 1 Reg. xi. 9.
0891.1.3.en: So Codd. 93, 108 (omitting ἂν). It would agree better with the Hebrew to have ἕως ἂν διαθερμάνῃ ὁ ἥλιος, as the LXX in Exod. xvi. 21. 1 Reg. xi. 9.

Nehemiah 7:4#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. πλατεῖα. Alia exempl. πλατεῖα χερσίν.^5
Nehemiah 7:4#0 Alia exempl..n: „An Seiten weit“ verstärkt die räumliche Weite.
Nehemiah 7:4#0 Alia exempl..en: “Wide in extent” intensifies the spatial breadth.

0891.1.5.la: Iidem. Cf. Hex. ad Gen. xxxiv. 21. Psal. ciii. 25.
0891.1.5.en: The same. Cf. Hex. on Gen. xxxiv. 21. Psal. ciii. 25.

Nehemiah 7:4#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐν αὐτῇ. Alia exempl. ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς.^6
Nehemiah 7:4#1 Alia exempl..en: “In its midst” instead of merely “in it”.

Nehemiah 7:5#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. εἰς συνοδίας. Alia exempl. εἰς γενεαλογίαν.^8

0892.0.8.la: Iidem. Mox βιβλίον τῆς γενεαλογίας (הַיַּחַשׂ) iidem.
0892.0.8.en: The same. Presently βιβλίον τῆς γενεαλογίας (הַיַּחַשׂ) the same.

Nehemiah 7:5#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. οἳ ἀνέβησαν ἐν πρώτοις. Alia exempl. τῶν ἀναβάντων ἐν ἀρχῇ.^9
Nehemiah 7:5#2 Alia exempl..en: “Of those who ascended initially” instead of “who ascended first”.

Nehemiah 7:7#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. οἱ ἐλθόντες.^10

Nehemiah 7:7#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Ῥεελμά. Alia exempl. Δαμίας.^11 Ο΄. Ἔσδρα. Alia exempl. vacant.^12

variants.n: „Damias“ statt „Reelma“.
variants.en: “Damias” instead of “Reelma”.

variants.n: Der Name Esra fehlt.
variants.en: The name Ezra is absent.

Nehemiah 7:33#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Ναβία, ἑκατόν (potior scriptura Ναβιαάρ^15). Alia exempl. Ναβαῦ.^16
Nehemiah 7:33#0 Alia exempl..n: „Nabau“ statt der anders aufgeteilten Verbindung von Name und Zahl.
Nehemiah 7:33#0 Alia exempl..en: “Nabau” replaces the differently divided combination of name and number.

0892.0.15.la: Cod. II, teste Maio: Ναβιαᾶ ρ̄. Comp.: Ναβὰβ ἑτέρου. Cf. Hex. ad Esdr. ii. 31.
0892.0.15.en: Cod. II, on the testimony of Mai: Ναβιαᾶ ρ̄. Comp.: Ναβὰβ ἑτέρου. Cf. Hex. on Esdr. ii. 31.

Nehemiah 7:63#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ὅτι ἔλαβον … γυναῖκας, καὶ ἐκλήθησαν. Alia exempl. ὃς ἔλαβεν … γυναῖκα, καὶ ἐκλήθη.^17
Nehemiah 7:63#0 Alia exempl..n: Ein einzelner Mann und eine Frau statt mehrerer Männer und Frauen.
Nehemiah 7:63#0 Alia exempl..en: One man and one wife instead of several men and wives.

0892.0.17.la: Sic Comp., Codd. III (cum ὅτι ἔλαβεν), Codd. 93, 108.
0892.0.17.en: So Comp., Codd. III (with ὅτι ἔλαβεν), Codd. 93, 108.

Nehemiah 7:64#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τῆς συνοδίας. Alia exempl. οἱ γενεαλογοῦντες.^18
Nehemiah 7:64#0 Alia exempl..en: “Those recording genealogies” instead of “of the company”.
