Nehemiah 12:28#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἀπὸ ἐπαύλεων, καὶ ἀπὸ ἀγρῶν. Alia exempl. καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἐπαύλεων τοῦ Νετωφατεὶ, καὶ ἐν Βαιθγαλγὰλ, καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀγρῶν Γαβεὲ καὶ Ἀσμώθ.^15
Nehemiah 12:28#0 Alia exempl..n: Netofa, Bet-Gilgal, Geba und Asmawet werden als Herkunftsorte der Sänger ergänzt.
Nehemiah 12:28#0 Alia exempl..en: Netophah, Beth-gilgal, Geba and Azmaveth are added as the singers’ places of origin.

0898.0.15.la: Sic Comp. (cum καὶ ἀπὸ ἐπαύλεων .. καὶ ἀπὸ ἀγρῶν Γαβέαι ..), Codd. 93 (cum καὶ Βαιθγ. .. Γαβελὴ καὶ Ἀζαμὼθ), 108 (cum Γαβεαί).
0898.0.15.en: So Comp. (with καὶ ἀπὸ ἐπαύλεων .. καὶ ἀπὸ ἀγρῶν Γαβέαι ..), Codd. 93 (with καὶ Βαιθγ. .. Γαβελὴ καὶ Ἀζαμὼθ), 108 (with Γαβεαί).

Nehemiah 12:30#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐκαθαρίσθησαν .. καὶ ἐκαθάρισαν. Alia exempl. καὶ ἡγνίσαντο .. καὶ ἥγνισαν.^17
Nehemiah 12:30#0 Alia exempl..n: Reinigung wird mit anderen gleichbedeutenden Verben ausgedrückt, zuerst reflexiv statt passiv.
Nehemiah 12:30#0 Alia exempl..en: Purification uses different synonymous verbs, initially reflexive rather than passive.

Nehemiah 12:30#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ τοὺς πυλωρούς. Alia exempl. καὶ τὰς πύλας.^18

Nehemiah 12:31#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. τῆς πύλης.^19

Nehemiah 12:36#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Γελὼλ, Ἰαμὰ, Ἀΐα. Alia exempl. Γελωλαὶ, Μαΐα.^20
Nehemiah 12:36#0 Alia exempl..n: Drei Namen werden anders zu zwei Namen aufgeteilt.
Nehemiah 12:36#0 Alia exempl..en: Three names are divided differently into two names.

0898.0.20.la: Sic Comp., Codd. 93 (cum Μαλια), 108 (cum Γελωλ αιμ αια). In Codd. II, III, et Frid. Aug. lacuna est; sed in hoc corrector supplevit γελωλαΐ μααΐ.
0898.0.20.en: So Comp., Codd. 93 (with Μαλια), 108 (with Γελωλ αιμ αια). In Codd. II, III, and Frid. Aug. there is a lacuna; but in the last a corrector has supplied γελωλαΐ μααΐ.

Nehemiah 12:37#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπὶ πύλης τοῦ αἰνεῖν. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς πύλης τῆς πηγῆς.^22
Nehemiah 12:37#0 Alia exempl..en: “At the Fountain Gate” instead of “at the gate of praising”.

0898.0.22.la: Sic Comp. (cum ἐπὶ π. pro καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς π.), Codd. 93, 108.
0898.0.22.en: So Comp. (with ἐπὶ π. for καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς π.), Codd. 93, 108.

Nehemiah 12:37#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπὶ κλίμακας. Alia exempl. ἐπὶ τοῖς βαθμοῖς.^23

Nehemiah 12:37#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἕως τῆς πύλης τοῦ ὕδατος Ἐφραΐμ. Alia exempl. καὶ ἕως τῆς πύλης τῶν ὑδάτων κατ’ ἀνατολάς. (38) καὶ περὶ αἰνέσεως ἡ δευτέρα ἐπορεύετο συναντῶσα αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἐγὼ ὀπίσω αὐτῆς, καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ τοῦ λαοῦ ἐπάνω τοῦ τείχους ὑπεράνω τοῦ πύργου τοῦ θαννουρεὶμ, καὶ ἕως τοῦ τείχους τοῦ πλατέος, (39) καὶ ἕως ἐπάνω τῆς πύλης Ἐφραΐμ.^24
Nehemiah 12:37#2 Alia exempl..n: Der Weg des zweiten Dankchors mit Nehemia über die Mauer wird ergänzt.
Nehemiah 12:37#2 Alia exempl..en: The route of the second thanksgiving procession with Nehemiah over the wall is added.

0898.0.24.la: Sic Codd. 93 (cum τοῦ ἥμισυ .. τῆς πύργου .. πλατέως), 108 (om. λαοῦ, cum θανουρείμ); necnon (cum τοῦ ὕδατος .. ἐξεπορεύετο .. ὑπεράνω (pro ἕως ἐπάνω)) Comp. (cum θανουρεὶμ), Ald. (cum θενουρὶμ .. πλατέως .. τοῦ τείχους (pro τῆς πύλης) Ἐφρ.), 44 (cum ἕως πύλης .. θεννωρὶμ .. Ἐφραῒμ κατ’ ἀνατολὰς), 52 (cum ἕως πύλης .. θενουρὶμ), 64 (ut 52), alii (inter quos 243, cum θενουρὶμ, et τοῦ τείχους (pro τῆς πύλης) Ἐφρ.).
0898.0.24.en: So Codd. 93 (with τοῦ ἥμισυ .. τῆς πύργου .. πλατέως), 108 (omitting λαοῦ, with θανουρείμ); and also (with τοῦ ὕδατος .. ἐξεπορεύετο .. ὑπεράνω (for ἕως ἐπάνω)) Comp. (with θανουρεὶμ), Ald. (with θενουρὶμ .. πλατέως .. τοῦ τείχους (for τῆς πύλης) Ἐφρ.), 44 (with ἕως πύλης .. θεννωρὶμ .. Ἐφραῒμ κατ’ ἀνατολὰς), 52 (with ἕως πύλης .. θενουρὶμ), 64 (as 52), and others (among them 243, with θενουρὶμ, and τοῦ τείχους (for τῆς πύλης) Ἐφρ.).

Nehemiah 12:39#2 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ πύργου τοῦ Μεά.^26
Nehemiah 12:39#2 Alia exempl..en: “From the Tower of Meah” is added.

0899.0.26.la: Sic Comp., Ald., Codd. 52, 93 (cum Ἀμμὴλ pro τοῦ Μ.), 108 (cum τοῦ Ἀμμηά).
0899.0.26.en: So Comp., Ald., Codd. 52, 93 (with Ἀμμὴλ for τοῦ Μ.), 108 (with τοῦ Ἀμμηά).

Nehemiah 12:39#3 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. καὶ ἔστησαν ἐν πύλῃ τῆς φυλακῆς. (40) καὶ ἔστησαν αἱ δύο τῆς αἰνέσεως ἐν οἴκῳ τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ ἐγὼ, καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ τῶν στρατηγῶν μετ’ ἐμοῦ· (41) καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς Ἐλιακεὶμ, Μαασίας, Μιαμεὶν, Μιχαίας, Ἐλιωναὶ, Ζαχαρίας, Ἀνανίας, ἐν σάλπιγξιν· (42) καὶ Μαασίας, καὶ Σεμεΐας, καὶ Ἐλεάζαρ, καὶ Ὀζεὶ, καὶ Ἰωανὰν, καὶ Μελχίας, καὶ Αἰλὰμ, καὶ Ἰεζούρ.^27
Nehemiah 12:39#3 Alia exempl..n: Das Aufstellen beider Dankchöre im Gotteshaus und weitere Priester und Sänger werden ergänzt.
Nehemiah 12:39#3 Alia exempl..en: Both thanksgiving processions’ stationing in God’s house and further priests and singers are added.

0899.0.27.la: Sic Comp. (cum ἐπὶ πύλην .. Μιαμὶν .. Σεμεΐας, Ἐλ., Ὀζὶ, Ἰω., Μ., Αἰλ. καὶ Ἰ.), Ald. (cum ἐπὶ πύλης .. Μασίας, Βενιαμὶν [?] .. Ἐλιωνηὰ .. Ἐλαάζαρ, καὶ Ὀζιὰ, καὶ Ἰωανὰ, καὶ Ἐμελχείας, καὶ Ἐλεαμίας, καὶ Ἐζοὺρ), Codd. 52 (cum ἐπὶ πύλης .. Μασίας, Βενιαμὶν .. Ἐλιωινὰ .. (om. ἐν σάλπιγξιν· καὶ Μαασίας) .. καὶ Ὀζιὰ, καὶ Ἰωανὰ .. καὶ Ἐλὰμ, καὶ Ἐζοὺρ), 64 (ut 52, nisi Ἐλιακὶμ .. Βενιαμὶμ .. Ἰωαννὰ .. Ἰεζοὺρ), alii (inter quos 93, cum ἐν τῇ πύλῃ), 108 (om. Μιαμεὶν, cum Μαασέας (in posteriore loco) .. Ἰωνὰν .. Ἐλάμ).
0899.0.27.en: So Comp. (with ἐπὶ πύλην .. Μιαμὶν .. Σεμεΐας, Ἐλ., Ὀζὶ, Ἰω., Μ., Αἰλ. καὶ Ἰ.), Ald. (with ἐπὶ πύλης .. Μασίας, Βενιαμὶν [?] .. Ἐλιωνηὰ .. Ἐλαάζαρ, καὶ Ὀζιὰ, καὶ Ἰωανὰ, καὶ Ἐμελχείας, καὶ Ἐλεαμίας, καὶ Ἐζοὺρ), Codd. 52 (with ἐπὶ πύλης .. Μασίας, Βενιαμὶν .. Ἐλιωινὰ .. (omitting ἐν σάλπιγξιν· καὶ Μαασίας) .. καὶ Ὀζιὰ, καὶ Ἰωανὰ .. καὶ Ἐλὰμ, καὶ Ἐζοὺρ), 64 (as 52, except Ἐλιακὶμ .. Βενιαμὶμ .. Ἰωαννὰ .. Ἰεζοὺρ), and others (among them 93, with ἐν τῇ πύλῃ), 108 (omitting Μιαμεὶν, with Μαασέας (in the latter place) .. Ἰωνὰν .. Ἐλάμ).

Nehemiah 12:42#0 Ἄλλος.unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἠκούσθησαν (Ἄλλος· ἐπευφήμησαν^28) οἱ ᾄδοντες, καὶ ἐπεσκέπησαν. Alia exempl. οἱ ᾠδοὶ ἠκούτισαν, καὶ Ἰεζρίας ἐπίσκοπος.^29

0899.0.28.la: Sic in textu Cod. 119. Praeterea pro καὶ ἐπεσκέπησαν in Ald., Codd. 52, 64, 243, legitur: καὶ ἐπεσκέφθησαν, καὶ ἐπευφήμησαν. (Voces εὐφημεῖν, εὐφημία, εὔφημος, pro Hebraeis רָנַן et רִנָּה, Symmacho in deliciis sunt.)
0899.0.28.en: So in the text Cod. 119. Moreover for καὶ ἐπεσκέπησαν in Ald., Codd. 52, 64, 243, there is read: καὶ ἐπεσκέφθησαν, καὶ ἐπευφήμησαν. (The words εὐφημεῖν, εὐφημία, εὔφημος, for the Hebrew רָנַן and רִנָּה, are favourites of Symmachus.)

0899.0.29.la: Sic Comp. (cum καὶ ἠκούσθ. οἱ ᾆδ.), Codd. 93 (cum ἠκούτησαν), 108.
0899.0.29.en: So Comp. (with καὶ ἠκούσθ. οἱ ᾆδ.), Codd. 93 (with ἠκούτησαν), 108.

Nehemiah 12:42#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἠκούσθησαν (Ἄλλος· ἐπευφήμησαν^28) οἱ ᾄδοντες, καὶ ἐπεσκέπησαν. Alia exempl. οἱ ᾠδοὶ ἠκούτισαν, καὶ Ἰεζρίας ἐπίσκοπος.^29
Nehemiah 12:42#0 Alia exempl..n: „Jesrachja als Aufseher“ statt „sie wurden beaufsichtigt“; andere Aufteilung des Namens.
Nehemiah 12:42#0 Alia exempl..en: “Jezrahiah as overseer” instead of “they were supervised”; a different division of the name.

0899.0.28.la: Sic in textu Cod. 119. Praeterea pro καὶ ἐπεσκέπησαν in Ald., Codd. 52, 64, 243, legitur: καὶ ἐπεσκέφθησαν, καὶ ἐπευφήμησαν. (Voces εὐφημεῖν, εὐφημία, εὔφημος, pro Hebraeis רָנַן et רִנָּה, Symmacho in deliciis sunt.)
0899.0.28.en: So in the text Cod. 119. Moreover for καὶ ἐπεσκέπησαν in Ald., Codd. 52, 64, 243, there is read: καὶ ἐπεσκέφθησαν, καὶ ἐπευφήμησαν. (The words εὐφημεῖν, εὐφημία, εὔφημος, for the Hebrew רָנַן and רִנָּה, are favourites of Symmachus.)

0899.0.29.la: Sic Comp. (cum καὶ ἠκούσθ. οἱ ᾆδ.), Codd. 93 (cum ἠκούτησαν), 108.
0899.0.29.en: So Comp. (with καὶ ἠκούσθ. οἱ ᾆδ.), Codd. 93 (with ἠκούτησαν), 108.

Nehemiah 12:43#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. μεγάλως. Alia exempl. εὐφροσύνῃ μεγάλῃ.^30

0899.0.30.la: Sic Comp., Codd. 93, 108. Cf. Hex. ad 1 Paral. xxix. 9.
0899.0.30.en: So Comp., Codd. 93, 108. Cf. Hex. on 1 Paral. xxix. 9.

Nehemiah 12:44#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ τοῖς συνηγμένοις ἐν αὐτοῖς ἄρχουσι τῶν πόλεων, μερίδας. Alia exempl. τοῦ συναγαγεῖν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἀπὸ τῶν ἀγρῶν καὶ τῶν πόλεων τοῖς ἄρχουσι τῶν πόλεων μερίδας τοῦ νόμου.^32
Nehemiah 12:44#0 Alia exempl..n: Das Sammeln der gesetzlichen Anteile aus Feldern und Städten wird ausdrücklich als Zweck genannt.
Nehemiah 12:44#0 Alia exempl..en: Collecting the prescribed portions from fields and towns is explicitly stated as the purpose.

0899.0.32.la: Sic Comp. (om. τοῖς ἄρχ. τ. π. et τοῦ νόμου), Codd. 93, 108 (cum καὶ τοῖς συνηγ. pro τοῦ συναγ. (?)).
0899.0.32.en: So Comp. (omitting τοῖς ἄρχ. τ. π. and τοῦ νόμου), Codd. 93, 108 (with καὶ τοῖς συνηγ. for τοῦ συναγ. (?)).

Nehemiah 12:45#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ, καὶ τοὺς ᾄδοντας, καὶ τοὺς πυλωροὺς, ὡς ἐντολαί. Alia exempl. τῆς ἁγνείας, καὶ οἱ πυλωροὶ καὶ οἱ ᾠδοὶ κατ’ ἐντολήν.^33
Nehemiah 12:45#0 Alia exempl..n: Sänger und Torhüter werden im Nominativ statt als Objekte genannt.
Nehemiah 12:45#0 Alia exempl..en: Singers and gatekeepers appear in the nominative rather than as objects.

Nehemiah 12:46#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ὕμνον καὶ αἴνεσιν. Alia exempl. καὶ ὕμνος καὶ ἐξομολογήσεις καὶ αἴνεσις.^34
Nehemiah 12:46#0 Alia exempl..n: Danksagungen werden zusätzlich zu Hymnus und Lob genannt.
Nehemiah 12:46#0 Alia exempl..en: Thanksgivings are mentioned in addition to hymn and praise.

Nehemiah 13:3#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐχωρίσθησαν πᾶς ἐπίμικτος. Alia exempl. διέστειλαν τὸν λαὸν τὸν ἀναμεμιγμένον.^2
Nehemiah 13:3#0 Alia exempl..n: „Sie sonderten das vermischte Volk ab“ statt „alle Vermischten wurden abgesondert“.
Nehemiah 13:3#0 Alia exempl..en: “They separated the mixed people” instead of “all mixed people were separated”.

Nehemiah 13:5#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. τὴν μαναά. Alia exempl. τὴν θυσίαν.^3

Nehemiah 13:5#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐντολήν. Alia exempl. καὶ τὰ ἄζυμα (מַצּוֹת).^4

Nehemiah 13:6#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ μετὰ τὸ τέλος τῶν ἡμερῶν ᾐτησάμην. Alia exempl. εἰς τὸν καιρὸν τῶν ἡμερῶν ὧν ᾐτησάμην.^5
Nehemiah 13:6#0 Alia exempl..n: „Zur Zeit der erbetenen Tage“ statt „nach Ablauf der Tage bat ich“.
Nehemiah 13:6#0 Alia exempl..en: “At the time of the requested days” instead of “after the days ended I requested”.

0899.1.5.la: Iidem (cum duplici versione εἰς τὸν καιρὸν—παρὰ τοῦ β. καὶ μετὰ τὸ τέλος τ. ἡ. ὧν ᾐτ. παρὰ τοῦ β.).
0899.1.5.en: The same (with the double version εἰς τὸν καιρὸν—παρὰ τοῦ β. καὶ μετὰ τὸ τέλος τ. ἡ. ὧν ᾐτ. παρὰ τοῦ β.).

Nehemiah 13:11#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐμαχεσάμην τοῖς στρατηγοῖς. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐκρίθην μετὰ τῶν στρατηγῶν.^7
Nehemiah 13:11#0 Alia exempl..n: „Ich stritt gerichtlich mit den Heerführern“ statt „ich kämpfte gegen sie“.
Nehemiah 13:11#0 Alia exempl..en: “I disputed judicially with the commanders” instead of “I fought them”.

0900.0.7.la: Iidem. Cf. ad Cap. v. 7. Verba τοῖς στρατηγοῖς desunt in Codd. II, III, FA (ante corr.), 55, 58.
0900.0.7.en: The same. Cf. on Cap. v. 7. The words τοῖς στρατηγοῖς are wanting in Codd. II, III, FA (before correction), 55, 58.

Nehemiah 13:13#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπὶ χεῖρα. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐνετειλάμην ἐπὶ χεῖρα.^8
Nehemiah 13:13#0 Alia exempl..en: “I commissioned” is added to the statement of responsibility.

Nehemiah 13:14#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐν ταῖς φυλακαῖς αὐτοῦ.^9
Nehemiah 13:14#0 Alia exempl..en: “And in its prescribed duties” is added.

Nehemiah 13:16#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐκάθισαν. Alia exempl. καὶ οἱ Τύριοι· καὶ ἐκάθισαν; alia, καὶ οἱ Τύριοι ἐκάθηντο.^11
Nehemiah 13:16#0 Alia exempl..n: Die Tyrier werden ausdrücklich als Bewohner genannt.
Nehemiah 13:16#0 Alia exempl..en: The Tyrians are explicitly named as residents.

0900.0.11.la: Prior lectio est in Comp., Ald., Codd. 52, 64, 248; posterior in Codd. 93, 108.
0900.0.11.en: The former reading is in Comp., Ald., Codd. 52, 64, 248; the latter in Codd. 93, 108.

Nehemiah 13:17#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἐμαχεσάμην τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰούδα τοῖς ἐλευθέροις. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐκρίθην μετὰ τῶν ἐλευθέρων Ἰούδα.^12
Nehemiah 13:17#0 Alia exempl..n: „Ich stritt gerichtlich mit Judas Freien“ statt „ich kämpfte gegen Judas freie Söhne“.
Nehemiah 13:17#0 Alia exempl..en: “I disputed judicially with Judah’s free men” instead of “I fought Judah’s free sons”.

Nehemiah 13:19#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἡνίκα κατέστησαν πύλαι. Alia exempl. ἡνίκα ἡσύχασα, κατέστησαν αἱ πύλαι.^13
Nehemiah 13:19#0 Alia exempl..n: „Als ich ruhte“ wird vor der Aussage über die Tore ergänzt.
Nehemiah 13:19#0 Alia exempl..en: “When I rested” is added before the statement about the gates.

0900.0.13.en: So Codd. 93, 108. Hieron.: "_when the gates had rested._"

Nehemiah 13:19#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ὥστε μὴ αἴρειν. Alia exempl. τοῦ μὴ εἰσφέρειν.^14

Nehemiah 13:20#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. πάντες, καὶ ἐποίησαν πρᾶσιν. Alia exempl. πάντες οἱ μετάβολοι, καὶ οἱ ποιοῦντες πᾶσαν πρᾶσιν.^15
Nehemiah 13:20#0 Alia exempl..n: Die Betroffenen werden ausdrücklich als Händler und Verkäufer bezeichnet.
Nehemiah 13:20#0 Alia exempl..en: Those concerned are explicitly identified as merchants and sellers.

0900.0.15.la: Sic Comp. (cum καὶ ἐποίησαν πρ.), Codd. 93, 108 (cum πρᾶξιν). Ad μετάβολοι cf. ad Cap. iii. 31.
0900.0.15.en: So Comp. (with καὶ ἐποίησαν πρ.), Codd. 93, 108 (with πρᾶξιν). On μετάβολοι cf. on Cap. iii. 31.

Nehemiah 13:20#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἅπαξ. Alia exempl. καὶ ἐκωλύθησαν ἅπαξ.^16

Nehemiah 13:21#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐκτενῶ χεῖρά μου ἐν ὑμῖν. Alia exempl. τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπιβαλῶ ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς.^17
Nehemiah 13:21#0 Alia exempl..n: „Ich werde Hand an euch legen“ statt „meine Hand gegen euch ausstrecken“.
Nehemiah 13:21#0 Alia exempl..en: “I will lay hands on you” instead of “stretch out my hand against you”.

Nehemiah 13:22#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. οἳ ἦσαν καθαριζόμενοι, καὶ ἐρχόμενοι φυλάσσοντες. Alia exempl. ἵνα ἐρχόμενοι ἁγνίζωνται, καὶ φυλάσσωσι.^18
Nehemiah 13:22#0 Alia exempl..n: Reinigung und Bewachung werden als Zweck statt als laufende Tätigkeiten formuliert.
Nehemiah 13:22#0 Alia exempl..en: Purifying and guarding are expressed as purposes rather than ongoing activities.

Nehemiah 13:22#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. πρὸς ταῦτα. Alia exempl. καίγε τούτου.^19
Nehemiah 13:22#1 Alia exempl..en: “Also because of this” instead of “concerning these things”.

Nehemiah 13:24#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. ἀλλὰ κατὰ γλῶσσαν λαοῦ καὶ λαοῦ.^20
Nehemiah 13:24#0 Alia exempl..n: Die unterschiedlichen Volkssprachen werden ausdrücklich ergänzt.
Nehemiah 13:24#0 Alia exempl..en: The different national languages are explicitly added.

Nehemiah 13:25#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Alia exempl. καὶ ἑαυτοῖς.^21

Nehemiah 13:26#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. οὐχ οὕτως. Alia exempl. οὐ περὶ τούτου.^22
Nehemiah 13:26#0 Alia exempl..en: “Was it not for this?” instead of “was it not so?”.

Nehemiah 13:27#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. πονηρίαν ταύτην. Alia exempl. τὴν κακίαν τὴν μεγάλην ταύτην.^24
Nehemiah 13:27#0 Alia exempl..n: Die Bosheit wird zusätzlich als groß bezeichnet.
Nehemiah 13:27#0 Alia exempl..en: The wickedness is additionally described as great.

0900.0.24.la: Sic Codd. 93 (cum μεγ. pro τὴν μεγ.), 108.
0900.0.24.en: So Codd. 93 (with μεγ. for τὴν μεγ.), 108.

Nehemiah 13:27#1 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. καθίσαι. Alia exempl. ὥστε ἐπιστρέψαι.^25
Nehemiah 13:27#1 Alia exempl..en: “So as to turn back” instead of “to settle”.

0900.0.25.la: Iidem. Cf. Hex. ad Esdr. x. 2.
0900.0.25.en: The same. Cf. Hex. on Esdr. x. 2.

Nehemiah 13:29#0 Alia exempl..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπὶ ἀγχιστείᾳ τῆς ἱερατείας καὶ διαθήκῃ (alia exempl. διαθήκης^27) τῆς ἱερατείας, καὶ τοὺς Λευίτας. Alia exempl. ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀλισγῶντας τὴν ἱερωσύνην καὶ τὴν διαθήκην τῶν ἱερέων καὶ τῶν Λευιτῶν.^28
Nehemiah 13:29#0 Alia exempl..n: Die Entweihung des Priestertums und des Priester- und Levitenbundes wird ausdrücklich benannt.

0900.0.28.la: Sic Comp. (cum ἐπὶ ἀγχ. τῆς ἱερ.), Codd. 93, 108 (cum ἀλίσγοντας). (Lexica dant formas ἀλισγέω et ἀλίσγω (Hesych.: Ἀλίσγοντες· μολύνοντες, μιαίνοντες); sed derivativa ἠλίσγησα, ἀλισγηθῇ, ἀλίσγημα etc. ad ἀλισγάω pariter referri possunt.)

0940.0.20.en: Hieron.: “For _some other, I know not who_, which Sym. rendered τινί ποτε, and whom we too have followed, Aq. and Theod. and the LXX put the Hebrew word itself, φελμονὶ (sic).” (That for לפלמוני Aquila rendered לפנימי, (to the angel) _within_, i.e. _of preeminent dignity_, is reported in Bereschith rabba fol. 24 c, on the testimony of Anger in the treatise _De Onkelo_ etc. p. 23.)

0019.0.19.la: Colb., Reg. unus. Nobil.: Σ. ἐπὶ τῆς σποδοῦ. “In haec verba, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐκάθητο, in Colb. notatur ad marginem, οὗτος ἦν πολύς: quae verba quorsum spectent, non satis assequimur.”—_Montef._ Spectant ad praecedentia, ἵνα τὸν ἰχῶρα ξύῃ; post quae Cod. 259 in textu, et Cod. 258 in marg. addunt: οὕτως ἦν πολύς.
0019.0.19.en: Colb., one Reg. Job 2:9#2 Ἄλλος.unitText: Ο΄. εἰπόν τι ῥῆμα εἰς κύριον. Διπλῆ γραφή· εὐλόγησον θεόν.^23 Ἄλλος· κατάρασαι τὸν θεόν.^24

variants.n: „Verfluche Gott“ statt der verhüllenden Aufforderung „segne Gott“.
variants.en: “Curse God” rather than the euphemistic command “bless God.”

0019.0.23.la: “In Colb. sic habetur: Δπ. γρ. εὐλόγησον θεόν. Illud vero Δπ., ni fallor, significat Tetrapla, ubi sic scriptum habebatur.”—_Montef._ Nobis vero aliter persuasum est, nempe notam hanc nil nisi διπλῆ γραφὴ significare. Cf. ad Cap. viii. 22. Syro-hex. in marg. sine auctore: ܒܪܟ ܠܐܠܗܐ ◆.
0019.0.23.en: “In Colb. it reads thus: Δπ. γρ. εὐλόγησον θεόν. That Δπ., unless I am mistaken, signifies the Tetrapla, where it was so written.”—_Montef._ We, however, are persuaded otherwise, namely that this note signifies nothing but διπλῆ γραφὴ. Cf. on Cap. viii. 22. Syro-hex. in the margin without an author: ܒܪܟ ܠܐܠܗܐ ◆.

0019.0.24.la: Sic Codd. 161, 248 in marg. Nobil. affert: Schol. κατάρασον (sic) τὸν θεόν.
0019.0.24.en: Thus Codd. 161, 248 in the margin. Nobil. gives: Schol. κατάρασον (sic) τὸν θεόν.

Job 3:5#2 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. καταραθείη (ἐν ἄλλῳ ἀντιγράφῳ, καταραχθείη· ἄλλος, καὶ ταραχθείη^9) ἡ ἡμέρα. Ἀ. καὶ ἐκθαμβήσαισαν αὐτὴν ὡς πικραμμοὶ (ἡμέρας).^10

variants.n: „Bitterkeiten des Tages sollen sie erschrecken“ statt „der Tag sei verflucht“.
variants.en: “Let the day’s bitternesses terrify it” rather than “let the day be cursed.”

0020.1.9.en: Colb. Cod. 253 has καταραχθείη; Comp., Ald. and Cod. 256, καὶ ταραχθείη. Syro-hex. in the text καὶ ταραχθείη; in the margin, however, καταραθείη (ܢܬܠܛܐ[?]).

0020.1.10.la: Nobil. Hieron.: ※ _et conturbent eam quasi amaritudines diei._
0020.1.10.en: Nobil. Jerome: “※ _and let them trouble it as the bitternesses of the day._”

Job 3:6#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. ἀπενέγκοιτο αὐτὴν σκότος. Ἀ. … σκοτομηνία.^11 Διπλῆ γραφή· ἀνατεῖλαι ἐπ’ αὐτὴν (σκότος).^12

0020.1.12.en: “Colb.: Δ. γρ. ἀνατεῖλαι ἐπ’ αὐτὴν (σκότος).”—_Montef._ Cf. on Cap. ii. 9. Syro-hex. without an author: ܕܢܚ[?] ܥܠܝܗ̇ ܚܫܘܟܐ ◆, i. e. ἀνατελεῖ ἐπ’ αὐτὴν σκότος (or ζόφος).

0020.1.16.en: Thus, for χαρμονὴ, a Schol. in Nobil. and Cod. 248 in the margin.

Job 3:8#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. ἀλλὰ καταράσαιτο αὐτὴν ὁ καταρώμενος τὴν ἡμέραν ἐκείνην. Ἀ. μὴ ὀνομάσαισαν αὐτὴν ἐπικαταρώμενοι ἡμέραν.^17

variants.n: „Die Tagesverflucher sollen sie nicht nennen“ statt „der Verflucher soll sie verfluchen“.
variants.en: “Let those cursing the day not name it” rather than “let the curser curse it.”

0020.1.17.en: Thus Codd. 138, 255, and without an author 137. Syro-hex. has the same, but anonymous: ܠܐ ܢܩܒܘܢܗ̇[?] ܟܕ ܠܐܛܝܢ[?] ܝܘܡܐ ◆.

Job 3:9#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. ὑπομείναι, καὶ εἰς φωτισμὸν μὴ ἔλθοι. Ἀ. προσμείναι εἰς φῶς, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν.^20 Σ. προσδοκηθείη φῶς, καὶ μὴ εἴη.^21

variants.reading: προσμείναι εἰς φῶς, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν.^20
variants.n: „Sie warte auf Licht, doch es ist nicht da“ statt „sie warte und komme nicht ans Licht“.
variants.en: “Let it await light, but there is none” rather than “let it wait and not come into light.”

0021.0.20.en: Thus Cod. 252, where προσειναι is written.

0021.0.21.la: Nobil. Montef. autem: “Σ. προσδοκηθείη φῶς, καὶ μὴ εἴη ὑπομεῖναι ἐν σκότῳ. Sic lectionem plenam exhibent Orat. et Nicetas. Partem vero solam postremam affert Colb.: καὶ μὴ εἴη ὑπομεῖναι ἐν σκότῳ.” Verba, ὑπομεῖναι ἐν σκότῳ, a Sym. abjudicanda esse recte censuit Kreyssigius.
0021.0.21.en: Nobil. Montef., however: “Σ. προσδοκηθείη φῶς, καὶ μὴ εἴη ὑπομεῖναι ἐν σκότῳ. Orat. and Nicetas exhibit the reading in full thus. Colb. gives only the last part: καὶ μὴ εἴη ὑπομεῖναι ἐν σκότῳ.” Kreyssig rightly judged that the words ὑπομεῖναι ἐν σκότῳ must be denied to Sym.

0021.0.22.la: Reg. unus. Colb. et Reg. alter οἰκοδομήσαντο habent. Montef. vero haec ad v. 15, οἳ ἔπλησαν τοὺς οἴκους αὐτῶν ἀργυρίου, perperam refert.

Job 3:16#0 Ἀ. Θ..unitText: Ο΄. ἐκπορευόμενον. Ἀ. Θ. κεκρυμμένον. Σ. κατορυγέν.^23

0021.0.23.la: Symmachi lectionem affert Colb., quam Montef. ad נֵפֶל, ἔκτρωμα, male apponit. Syro-hex. ܐ. ܬ. ܕܡܛܫܝܐ ◆ ܣ. ܕܐܬܛܡܪ ◆. Middeld. vertit: Ἀ. Θ. κατορυγέν. Σ. κεκρυμμένον. Sed praeter testimonium Colbertini, Syr. ܛܡܪ ponitur pro κατώρυξε Jerem. xiii. 7. Ezech. xxxix. 12; et ܐܬܛܡܪ pro κατορύγῃ Amos ix. 2.
0021.0.23.en: Colb. gives the reading of Symmachus, which Montef. wrongly places at נֵפֶל, ἔκτρωμα. Syro-hex. ܐ. ܬ. ܕܡܛܫܝܐ ◆ ܣ. ܕܐܬܛܡܪ ◆. Middeld. renders: Ἀ. Θ. κατορυγέν. Σ. κεκρυμμένον. But besides the testimony of the Colbertine, Syr. ܛܡܪ is used for κατώρυξε Jerem. xiii. 7. Ezech. xxxix. 12; and ܐܬܛܡܪ for κατορύγῃ Amos ix. 2.

Job 4:2#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. μὴ πολλάκις σοι λελάληται ἐν κόπῳ; Ἀ. μήτι ἐπαροῦμεν λαλῆσαι πρὸς σὲ, κοπιάσεις. Σ. ἐὰν ἀναλάβωμεν λόγον (πρὸς σὲ), μοχθήσεις. Θ. εἰ ληψόμεθα λαλῆσαι πρὸς σὲ, κοπιάσεις.^1

variants.reading: μήτι ἐπαροῦμεν λαλῆσαι πρὸς σὲ, κοπιάσεις.
variants.n: „Wenn wir zu reden beginnen, wirst du ermüden“ statt „Wurde dir oft unter Mühen zugesprochen?“.
variants.en: “If we begin speaking, you will tire” rather than “Have you often been addressed with toil?”

0022.1.1.la: Aquilae lectionem affert Nobil.; Symmachi et Theodotionis Olymp. “Sic omnes MSS.”—_Montef._ Aquilae κοπιάσεις, quod aberat, ex Syro-hex. ad codicem exacto restituimus. Cf. Hex. nostra ad Jerem. xx. 9. Syrus affert: ܐ. ܕܠܡܐ ܠܝܛܝܢܢ[?] ܠܡܡܠܠܘ ܠܘܬܟ. ܠܐܐ ܐܢܬ ◆ ܣ. ܐܢ ܢܣܒܝܢܢ[?] ܡܠܬܐ ܠܘܬܟ ܠܐܐ ܐܢܬ ◆ ܬ. ܐܢ ܢܣܒ[?] ܠܡܡܠܠܘ ܠܘܬܟ ܠܐܐ ܐܢܬ ◆. Quae Graecis satis accurate respondere videntur, nisi quod apud Aquilam ἐπαροῦμεν s. ἐπάρωμεν sensu _exsecrandi_ imprudenter cepit Syrus, ac si ἐπαρώμεθα scriptum invenisset.
0022.1.1.en: Nobil. gives the reading of Aquila; Olymp. those of Symmachus and Theodotion. “Thus all the MSS.”—_Montef._ Aquila's κοπιάσεις, which was missing, we have restored from Syro-hex. as checked against the codex. Cf. our Hexapla on Jerem. xx. 9. The Syriac gives: ܐ. ܕܠܡܐ ܠܝܛܝܢܢ[?] ܠܡܡܠܠܘ ܠܘܬܟ. ܠܐܐ ܐܢܬ ◆ ܣ. ܐܢ ܢܣܒܝܢܢ[?] ܡܠܬܐ ܠܘܬܟ ܠܐܐ ܐܢܬ ◆ ܬ. ܐܢ ܢܣܒ[?] ܠܡܡܠܠܘ ܠܘܬܟ ܠܐܐ ܐܢܬ ◆. These seem to answer to the Greek accurately enough, except that in Aquila the Syriac carelessly took ἐπαροῦμεν or ἐπάρωμεν in the sense of _cursing_, as if he had found ἐπαρώμεθα written.

variants.n: „Löwe ohne Jagdbeute“ statt „Ameisenlöwe ohne Nahrung“.
variants.en: “Lion without prey” rather than “ant-lion without food.”

0022.1.7.la: Σ. ἀνυπόστατος λ. ἀπόλλυται (ἀπώλετο Colb.). Sic Colb., Reg. unus. Disceptatio orta est de vocab. ἀνυπόστατος, Symmacho satis familiari, de eo _cujus impetus sustineri nequit._ Hinc alii vertunt _insuperabilis, fortissimus_, et ἀνυπ. λέων uni vocab. לַיִשׁ aptant, quemadmodum idem Sym. pro Hebr. כְּפִיר λέων ὀλοθρεύων posuit Psal. xc. 13. ciii. 21. Cum vero ἀνυπόστατος significare possit, _substantiam non habens_, alii opinantur verba, ἀνυπ. λέων ἀπόλλυται, ad totam sententiam pertinere, ut ἀνυπόστατος dicatur leo _cui substantia_, h. e. _alimentum, desit._ Sic Montef.: _Subsistere non potens leo periit._ At aliud est, _substantiam non habere_, ἀνυπόστατος εἶναι, cui contrarium est ἐνυπόστατος; aliud, _sustentatione egere_, quae notio hic requiritur. Praeterea notandum est, Syro-hex. ad βορὰν haec afferre: Σ. ἐθηρεύθη (ܐܬܨܝܕ). Θ. θήραν (ܨܝܕܐ); unde colligere licet, integram hujus interp. versionem talem fuisse: ἀνυπ. λέων ἀπόλλυται, _propterea quod nihil_ ἐθηρεύθη.
0022.1.7.en: Σ. ἀνυπόστατος λ. ἀπόλλυται (ἀπώλετο Colb.). Thus Colb., one Reg. A dispute has arisen about the word ἀνυπόστατος, quite familiar to Symmachus, of one _whose onset cannot be withstood._ Hence some render _invincible, most mighty_, and fit ἀνυπ. λέων to the single word לַיִשׁ, just as the same Sym. put λέων ὀλοθρεύων for the Hebr. כְּפִיר Psal. xc. 13. ciii. 21. But since ἀνυπόστατος can mean _having no substance_, others think that the words ἀνυπ. λέων ἀπόλλυται belong to the whole sentence, so that the lion is called ἀνυπόστατος _who lacks substance_, i. e. _sustenance._ Thus Montef.: “_The lion, unable to subsist, perished._” But it is one thing _to have no substance_, ἀνυπόστατος εἶναι, the opposite of which is ἐνυπόστατος; another _to lack sustenance_, which is the notion required here. Moreover it should be noted that Syro-hex. on βορὰν gives this: Σ. ἐθηρεύθη (ܐܬܨܝܕ). Θ. θήραν (ܨܝܕܐ); from which one may infer that the complete version of this interpreter was as follows: ἀνυπ. λέων ἀπόλλυται, _because nothing_ ἐθηρεύθη.

0022.1.8.la: Colb., Syro- hex. Colb. subjungit: καὶ οἱ δυνατοὶ οὐκ εἰς διαδοχὰς παραπέμπονται. Ad seqq. σκύμνοι δὲ κ. τ. ἑ. Parsons. e Cod. 151 affert: Ἀ. Θ. θῆρες καὶ οἱ δυνατοὶ οὐκ εἰς δ. παραπέμπονται. Schol. οὐδὲ γὰρ μεθ’ ἑτέρων νομεύονται. Quae omnia ad explicationem potius quam ad interpretationem pertinent.

Job 4:12#0 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. εἰ δέ τι ῥῆμα ἀληθινὸν ἐγεγόνει ἐν λόγοις σου, ÷ οὐθὲν ἄν σοι τούτων κακὸν ἀπήντησε ↙.^9 Σ. πρὸς ἐμὲ δὲ ἐλαλήθη λαθραίως ὡς ἐν κλοπῇ.^10

variants.reading: πρὸς ἐμὲ δὲ ἐλαλήθη λαθραίως ὡς ἐν κλοπῇ.^10
variants.n: „Mir wurde heimlich zugesprochen“ statt der Bedingung, dass wahre Worte Unglück verhindert hätten.
variants.en: “I was secretly addressed” rather than the condition that true words would have prevented misfortune.

0023.0.9.la: ÷ οὐθὲν—ἀπήντησε ↙. Sic, sed om. τούτων, Syro-hex.
0023.0.9.en: ÷ οὐθὲν—ἀπήντησε ↙. Thus, but omitting τούτων, Syro-hex.

0023.0.10.la: Nobil., Colb., Regii duo et Orat. Reg. alter pro δὲ ἐλαλήθη, διελαλήθη habet. In Nobil. et Orat. deest ὡς.
0023.0.10.en: Nobil., Colb., two Regii and Orat. The other Reg. has διελαλήθη for δὲ ἐλαλήθη. In Nobil. and Orat. ὡς is wanting.

Job 4:12#1 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. πότερον οὐ δέξεταί μου τὸ οὖς ἐξαίσια παρ’ αὐτοῦ. Σ. καὶ ἐδέξατο τὸ οὖς μου ψιθυρισμὸν παρ’ αὐτοῦ.^11

variants.reading: καὶ ἐδέξατο τὸ οὖς μου ψιθυρισμὸν παρ’ αὐτοῦ.^11
variants.n: „Mein Ohr empfing sein Flüstern“ statt einer Frage nach dem Empfang außergewöhnlicher Dinge.
variants.en: “My ear received his whisper” rather than a question about receiving extraordinary things.

0023.0.11.la: Nicet., Colb., Regii duo. Sic, sed om. παρ’ αὐτοῦ, Nobil.
0023.0.11.en: Nicet., Colb., two Regii. Thus, but omitting παρ’ αὐτοῦ, Nobil.

Job 4:13#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. φόβῳ δὲ καὶ ἤχῳ νυκτερινῇ. Ἀ. ἐν παραλλαγαῖς ἀπὸ ὁραματισμῶν νυκτός.^12 Σ. ἐν ἐκπλήξει ἀπὸ ὁραμάτων νυκτερινῶν.^13

variants.n: „In Veränderungen durch nächtliche Visionen“ statt „in Furcht und nächtlichem Geräusch“.
variants.en: “In changes from nightly visions” rather than “in fear and nightly noise.”

0023.0.13.la: Sic Colb., Reg. unus. Nobil.: Σ. ἐν ἐκπ. ἀπὸ ὁράματός μου νυκτερινοῦ. Parsons. e Cod. 255 affert: Σ. ὅτ’ (ὅταν Cod. 256) ἐνθυμηθῶ περὶ θεοῦ, πάντα μοι φοβερὰ φαίνεται. Sic, sed omisso titulo, Cod. 256. Est scholium ad v. 14 pertinens.
0023.0.13.en: Thus Colb., one Reg. Nobil.: Σ. ἐν ἐκπ. ἀπὸ ὁράματός μου νυκτερινοῦ. Parsons gives from Cod. 255: Σ. ὅτ’ (ὅταν Cod. 256) ἐνθυμηθῶ περὶ θεοῦ, πάντα μοι φοβερὰ φαίνεται. Thus, but with the name omitted, Cod. 256. It is a scholium belonging to v. 14.

variants.en: “Fear blows against me” rather than “shuddering met me.”

Job 4:15#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπὶ πρόσωπόν μου ἐπῆλθεν. (Ἀ.) διὰ τοῦ προσώπου μου ᾤχετο.^15

variants.en: “It passed through my face” rather than “it came upon my face.”

0023.0.15.la: Schol. διὰ τοῦ προσώπου μου. Sic Nobil. et Codd. 161, 248 in marg. Deinde Montef. ex Colb. affert: Ἀ. ᾤχετο. Postremo in marg. Cod. 252 legitur: ἃ (sic) διὰ τοῦ προσώπου ᾤχετο. Cf. ad v. 16.
0023.0.15.en: Schol. διὰ τοῦ προσώπου μου. Thus Nobil. and Codd. 161, 248 in the margin. Next Montef. gives from Colb.: Ἀ. ᾤχετο. Finally in the margin of Cod. 252 is read: ἃ (sic) διὰ τοῦ προσώπου ᾤχετο. Cf. on v. 16.

0024.1.4.en: Olymp.: κολαβρισθείησαν· τουτέστιν, ἐπιτριβείησαν, ἐξευτελισθείησαν· κόλαβρος γὰρ ὁ μικρὸς χοῖρος. Lex. Cyrill. Brem.: κολαβρισθείησαν, περιρραγείησαν, χλευασθείησαν. Syro-hex. renders ܢܬܒܕܪܘܢ, _let them be scattered_.

0024.1.5.la: “Olymp.: ἀνθ᾽ οὗ ὁ μὲν Ἀ., ἐπιτριβήσονται· ὁ δὲ Θ., κατεκλάσθησαν· ὁ δὲ Σ., ταπεινωθήτωσαν, ἐξέδωκαν. Aliud schol.: Ἀ. καὶ ἐπιτριβήσονται. Θ. καὶ ταπεινωθήσονται. 0025.0.29.la: “Haec quae sequuntur in aliquibus edd., non reperiuntur in LL. VV. qui collati sunt: ὅτι μετὰ τῶν λίθων τοῦ ἀγροῦ ἡ διαθήκη σου, καὶ τὰ θηρία τοῦ ἀγροῦ εἰρηνεύσουσί (εἰρηνεύσει Alex.) σοι.”—_Nobil._ Eadem leguntur in Ald., Cod. Alex. et Cod. 249, et Theodotionis esse videntur.
0025.0.29.en: “The following words, which are in some editions, are not found in the MSS. that have been collated: ὅτι μετὰ τῶν λίθων τοῦ ἀγροῦ ἡ διαθήκη σου, καὶ τὰ θηρία τοῦ ἀγροῦ εἰρηνεύσουσί (εἰρηνεύσει Alex.) σοι.”—_Nobil._ The same are read in Ald., Cod. Alex. and Cod. 249, and seem to be Theodotion's.

0025.0.30.la: Syro-hex. in textu: ※ ܡܛܠ ܕܥܡ ܟܐܦܐ ܕܐܪܥܐ ܢܗܘܐ ܠܟ ܡܫܥܠܐ[?] ↙. Idem in marg. notat: “Non positum est in Octaplis Origenis.” Ad Syro-hex. proxime accedit Hieron.: ※ _quia cum lapidibus agri habebis foedus._ Fortasse Symmacho debetur. Restat tertia interpretatio, ※ ὅτι μετὰ λίθων ἀγροῦ συνθήκη σου, quam unicam affert Montef. notans: “Hunc versiculum cum asterisco affert [Hieron.] editio libri Job Latina, quia in LXX non legitur.” Graeca, ut videtur, ipsius Montef. sunt.
0025.0.30.en: Syro-hex. in the text: ※ ܡܛܠ ܕܥܡ ܟܐܦܐ ܕܐܪܥܐ ܢܗܘܐ ܠܟ ܡܫܥܠܐ[?] ↙. The same notes in the margin: “It is not placed in the Octapla of Origen.” Jerome comes nearest to Syro-hex.: “※ _for with the stones of the field thou shalt have a covenant._” Perhaps it is due to Symmachus. There remains a third rendering, ※ ὅτι μετὰ λίθων ἀγροῦ συνθήκη σου, which alone Montef. gives, noting: “This versicle is given with an asterisk by the Latin edition of the book of Job [of Jerome], because it is not read in the LXX.” The Greek, as it seems, is Montef.'s own.

Job 6:5#0 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. τί γάρ; μὴ διακενῆς κεκράξεται ὄνος ἄγριος, ἀλλ᾽ ἢ τὰ σῖτα ζητῶν; Σ. μὴ στένει λιμῷ ὄναγρος παρούσης χλόης;^8

variants.reading: μὴ στένει λιμῷ ὄναγρος παρούσης χλόης;^8
variants.n: Ein Wildesel stöhnt nicht vor Hunger bei vorhandenem Gras, statt nur nach Nahrung zu schreien.
variants.en: A wild donkey does not groan from hunger when grass is present, rather than merely crying for food.

Job 6:5#1 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. εἰ δὲ καὶ ῥήξει φωνήν. Σ. ἢ μυκήσεται.^9

variants.n: „Er wird brüllen“ statt allgemein „seine Stimme ertönen lassen“.
variants.en: “It will bellow” rather than generally “utter its voice.”

0026.0.9.la: Reg. unus et Colb. Mendose adhuc editum: ἢ μηκήσεται. Cod. 256: εἰ δὲ καὶ ῥήξει εἰ μυκήσεται φωνήν (sic).
0026.0.9.en: One Reg. and Colb. Hitherto wrongly printed: ἢ μηκήσεται. Cod. 256: εἰ δὲ καὶ ῥήξει εἰ μυκήσεται φωνήν (sic).

Job 6:6#0 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. εἰ βρωθήσεται ἄρτος ἄνευ ἁλός; Σ. μήτι βρωθήσεται ἄναρτυτον τῷ μὴ ἔχειν ἅλα;^10

variants.reading: μήτι βρωθήσεται ἄναρτυτον τῷ μὴ ἔχειν ἅλα;^10
variants.n: „Ungewürztes ohne Salz“ statt ausdrücklich „Brot ohne Salz“.
variants.en: “Unseasoned food lacking salt” rather than specifically “bread without salt.”

0026.0.10.la: Nobil., Olymp. et “omnes.” Montef. ἅλας dedit.
0026.0.10.en: Nobil., Olymp. and “all.” Montef. gave ἅλας.

Job 6:8#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. τὴν ἐλπίδα μου. Ἀ. ὑπομονήν.^11

variants.n: „Meine Geduld“ statt „meine Hoffnung“.
variants.en: “My endurance” rather than “my hope.”

0026.0.11.la: Colb. Reg. unus: ἀπομονήν. Syro-hex. a Norbergio neglectus: ܐ. ܡܣܘܟܝܐ ܀.
0026.0.11.en: Colb. One Reg.: ἀπομονήν. Syro-hex., overlooked by Norberg: ܐ. ܡܣܘܟܝܐ ܀.

Job 6:9#0 Ἀ. Σ..unitText: Ο΄. εἰς τέλος δέ. Ἀ. Σ. ἐπιβαλὼν τὴν χεῖρα.^12

variants.n: „Die Hand anlegen“ statt „bis zum Ende“.
variants.en: “To lay on the hand” rather than “to the end.”

0026.0.12.la: Nobil. et “omnes.” Minus recte Olymp. in Cat. Nicet. p. 171: Ἀ. δὲ καὶ Σ. ἀντὶ τοῦ, ἀρξάμενος, ἐπιβαλὼν τὴν χεῖρα, ἐξέδωκαν.
0026.0.12.en: Nobil. and “all.” Less correctly Olymp. in the Cat. of Nicet. p. 171: Ἀ. δὲ καὶ Σ. ἀντὶ τοῦ, ἀρξάμενος, ἐπιβαλὼν τὴν χεῖρα, ἐξέδωκαν.

Job 6:10#0 Ἀ. Θ..unitText: Ο΄. εἴη δέ μου πόλις τάφος. Ἀ. Θ. καὶ ἔσται ἔτι παράκλησίς μου.^13

variants.n: „Noch bleibt mir Trost“ statt „das Grab sei meine Stadt“.
variants.en: “Consolation still remains for me” rather than “may the grave be my city.”

Job 6:11#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. ἢ τίς μου ὁ χρόνος, ὅτι ἀνέχεταί μου ἡ ψυχή; Ἀ. καὶ τί τὸ τέλος μου, ὅτι μακροθυμήσω;^14

variants.reading: καὶ τί τὸ τέλος μου, ὅτι μακροθυμήσω;^14
variants.n: „Was ist mein Ende, dass ich geduldig bleibe?“ statt einer Frage nach Lebenszeit und Aushalten.
variants.en: “What is my end, that I should be patient?” rather than asking about lifetime and endurance.

0026.0.14.la: Nobil., Nicet., Colb., Orat. et sine auctore Cod. 248.
0026.0.14.en: Nobil., Nicet., Colb., Orat. and without an author Cod. 248.

Job 6:15#0 Ἄλλος.unitText: Ο΄. οἱ ἐγγύτατοί μου. Ἄλλος· ἀδελφοί μου.^15

variants.n: „Meine Brüder“ statt „meine Nächsten“.
variants.en: “My brothers” rather than “those nearest me.”

0026.0.15.en: Colb. and Codd. 161, 248, 250 in the margin.

Job 6:17#0 Ἄλλος.unitText: Ο΄. ὅπερ ἦν. Ἄλλος· ὅπου ἦν.^17 Ἀ. Σ. Θ. ἐκ τόπου . .^18

variants.n: „Wo es war“ statt „was es war“.
variants.en: “Where it was” rather than “what it was.”

0026.0.17.en: Colb. Thus Syro-hex. in the text.

Job 6:17#0 Ἀ. Σ. Θ..unitText: Ο΄. ὅπερ ἦν. Ἄλλος· ὅπου ἦν.^17 Ἀ. Σ. Θ. ἐκ τόπου . .^18

variants.n: „Vom Ort“ statt „was es war“.
variants.en: “From a place” rather than “what it was.”

0026.0.17.en: Colb. Thus Syro-hex. in the text.

Job 6:19#1 Σ. Θ..unitText: Ο΄. Vacat. Σ. Θ. αὐτοῖς s. ἑαυτοῖς.^20

variants.n: „Ihnen“ oder „sich selbst“ wird ergänzt.
variants.en: “To them” or “to themselves” is added.

0026.0.20.la: Syro-hex. ܣ. ܬ. ܠܗܘܢ ܀. Ponitur pro ἑαυτοῖς Prov. i. 18.
0026.0.20.en: Syro-hex. ܣ. ܬ. ܠܗܘܢ ܀. It is used for ἑαυτοῖς Prov. i. 18.

Job 6:21#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. ἀτὰρ δέ. Ἀ. ὅτι νῦν. Θ. ἀλλὰ μήν.^21

variants.n: „Denn jetzt“ statt „aber“.
variants.en: “For now” rather than “but.”

0026.0.21.la: “MSS.” apud Montef. Ad καὶ ὑμεῖς, quod in LXX statim sequitur, est scholium in Syro-hex. ܐܢܬܘܢ ܠܡ ܗܢܘܢ ܕܚܙܝܬܘܢ[?] ܀, h. e. ὑμεῖς, _nempe qui videtis._
0026.0.21.en: “MSS.” in Montef. On καὶ ὑμεῖς, which immediately follows in the LXX, there is a scholium in Syro-hex. ܐܢܬܘܢ ܠܡ ܗܢܘܢ ܕܚܙܝܬܘܢ[?] ܀, i. e. ὑμεῖς, _namely you who see._

Job 6:21#0 Θ..unitText: Ο΄. ἀτὰρ δέ. Ἀ. ὅτι νῦν. Θ. ἀλλὰ μήν.^21

variants.n: Ein anderer Ausdruck verstärkt ebenfalls den Gegensatz: „doch gewiss“.
variants.en: Another expression likewise reinforces the contrast: “but indeed.”

0026.0.21.la: “MSS.” apud Montef. Ad καὶ ὑμεῖς, quod in LXX statim sequitur, est scholium in Syro-hex. ܐܢܬܘܢ ܠܡ ܗܢܘܢ ܕܚܙܝܬܘܢ[?] ܀, h. e. ὑμεῖς, _nempe qui videtis._

Job 6:25#0 Ἄλλος.unitText: Ο΄. ἀλλ᾽, ὡς ἔοικε, φαῦλα (Ἄλλος· λυπηρά^22) ἀληθινοῦ ῥήματα. Ἀ. τί ἐμοχθηρώθησαν λόγοι εὐθοῦς.^23

variants.n: „Schmerzlich“ statt „schlecht“ beschreibt die Worte.
variants.en: “Painful” rather than “worthless” describes the words.

Job 6:25#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. ἀλλ᾽, ὡς ἔοικε, φαῦλα (Ἄλλος· λυπηρά^22) ἀληθινοῦ ῥήματα. Ἀ. τί ἐμοχθηρώθησαν λόγοι εὐθοῦς.^23

variants.n: „Warum wurden aufrichtige Worte schlecht?“ statt „Wahre Worte erscheinen schlecht“.
variants.en: “Why did upright words become worthless?” rather than “True words appear worthless.”

Job 6:28#0 Θ..unitText: Ο΄. Perplexa est sententia. ※ Θ. σχολάσατέ μοι.^24

variants.n: Die Bitte „Nehmt euch Zeit für mich“ wird ergänzt.
variants.en: The request “Make time for me” is added.

0026.0.24.la: Sic sine nomine Montef. ex Hieron.: ※ _vacate mihi_, ut videtur. Syro-hex. ※ ܬ. ܐܬܦܢܘ[?] ܠܝ. ܠܐ ܣܝܡ ܒܬܡܢܝܐ[?] ܠܐܘܟܛܐܦܠܐ[?] ܕܐܘܪܝܓܢܣ ܀. Hoc est: “※ Θ. σχολάσατέ μοι. Non positum est in Octaplis Origenis.”
0026.0.24.en: Thus without a name Montef., from Jerome, as it seems: “※ _be at leisure for me_.” Syro-hex. ※ ܬ. ܐܬܦܢܘ[?] ܠܝ. ܠܐ ܣܝܡ ܒܬܡܢܝܐ[?] ܠܐܘܟܛܐܦܠܐ[?] ܕܐܘܪܝܓܢܣ ܀. That is: “※ Θ. σχολάσατέ μοι. It is not placed in the Octapla of Origen.”

Job 6:29#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ μὴ εἴη ἄδικον. Ἀ. μὴ γίνησθε παρανομία.^25

variants.n: „Werdet nicht zu Gesetzlosigkeit“ statt „es sei kein Unrecht“.
variants.en: “Do not become lawlessness” rather than “let there be no injustice.”

Job 7:3#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. νύκτες δὲ ὀδυνῶν δεδομέναι μοί εἰσιν. Ἀ. νύκτας κόπου ἠρίθμησάν μοι. Θ. καὶ νύκτας μοχθοῦ ἠρίθμησάν μοι.^2

variants.n: „Nächte der Mühe wurden mir zugezählt“ statt „Nächte der Schmerzen wurden mir gegeben“.
variants.en: “Nights of toil were counted for me” rather than “nights of pain were given me.”

0027.1.2.la: Syro-hex. ܐ. ܠܠܝܐ[?] ܕܥܡܠܐ ܡܢܘ ܠܝ ܀ ܬ. ܘܠܠܝܐ ܕܠܐܘܬܐ ܡܢܘ ܠܝ ܀
0027.1.2.en: Syro-hex. ܐ. ܠܠܝܐ[?] ܕܥܡܠܐ ܡܢܘ ܠܝ ܀ ܬ. ܘܠܠܝܐ ܕܠܐܘܬܐ ܡܢܘ ܠܝ ܀

Job 7:3#0 Θ..unitText: Ο΄. νύκτες δὲ ὀδυνῶν δεδομέναι μοί εἰσιν. Ἀ. νύκτας κόπου ἠρίθμησάν μοι. Θ. καὶ νύκτας μοχθοῦ ἠρίθμησάν μοι.^2

variants.n: „Nächte der Mühsal wurden mir zugezählt“ statt „Nächte der Schmerzen wurden mir gegeben“.
variants.en: “Nights of hardship were counted for me” rather than “nights of pain were given me.”

0027.1.2.la: Syro-hex. ܐ. ܠܠܝܐ[?] ܕܥܡܠܐ ܡܢܘ ܠܝ ܀ ܬ. ܘܠܠܝܐ ܕܠܐܘܬܐ ܡܢܘ ܠܝ ܀
0027.1.2.en: Syro-hex. ܐ. ܠܠܝܐ[?] ܕܥܡܠܐ ܡܢܘ ܠܝ ܀ ܬ. ܘܠܠܝܐ ܕܠܐܘܬܐ ܡܢܘ ܠܝ ܀

Job 7:4#0 Ἀ. Θ..unitText: Ο΄. πότε ἡμέρα; ὡς δ᾽ ἂν ἀναστῶ. Ἀ. Θ. πότε ἀναστήσομαι;^3

variants.n: „Wann werde ich aufstehen?“ statt „Wann ist Tag? Wenn ich aufstehe“.
variants.en: “When shall I rise?” rather than “When is day? When I rise.”

Job 7:6#0 Οἱ λοιποί.unitText: Ο΄. ὁ δὲ βίος μου. Οἱ λοιποί· αἱ ἡμέραι μου.^4

variants.n: „Meine Tage“ statt „mein Leben“.
variants.en: “My days” rather than “my life.”

Job 7:6#1 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. ὁ δὲ βίος μού ἐστιν ἐλαφρότερος λαλιᾶς. Ἀ. αἱ ἡμέραι μου ἠλαφρύνθησαν ὑπὲρ ὑφάσματος.^5 Σ. αἱ ἡμέραι μου ταχύτεραι ὑφάσματος.^6 Θ. αἱ ἡμέραι μου ἐταχύνθησαν . . . ὑφάσματος.^7

variants.reading: αἱ ἡμέραι μου ἠλαφρύνθησαν ὑπὲρ ὑφάσματος.^5
variants.n: „Meine Tage“ statt „mein Leben“; ein Webbild ersetzt den Vergleich mit Gerede.
variants.en: “My days” rather than “my life”; weaving imagery replaces the comparison with talk.

0027.1.5.la: Syro-hex. ܐ. ܝܘܡܬܐ ܕܝܠܝ ܐܬܩܠܠܘ ܝܬܝܪ ܡܢ ܡܚܘܬܐ[?] ܀. Pro קַלֹּתִי, ἠλαφρύνθην interpretatus est Aq. Job. xl. 4.
0027.1.5.en: Syro-hex. ܐ. ܝܘܡܬܐ ܕܝܠܝ ܐܬܩܠܠܘ ܝܬܝܪ ܡܢ ܡܚܘܬܐ[?] ܀. For קַלֹּתִי Aq. rendered ἠλαφρύνθην Job. xl. 4.

0027.1.6.la: Syro-hex. ܣ. ܝܘܡܬܐ ܕܝܠܝ ܝܬܝܪ ܡܩܠܠܢ[?] ܡܢ ܡܚܘܬܐ[?] ܀. Ex Colb. exscripsit Montef.: Σ. ταχυτέρα (sic) ὑφάσματος.
0027.1.6.en: Syro-hex. ܣ. ܝܘܡܬܐ ܕܝܠܝ ܝܬܝܪ ܡܩܠܠܢ[?] ܡܢ ܡܚܘܬܐ[?] ܀. Montef. copied from Colb.: Σ. ταχυτέρα (sic) ὑφάσματος.

0027.1.7.la: Syro-hex. ܬ. ܝܘܡܬܐ ܕܝܠܝ ܐܬܥܒܝܘ[?] ܝܬܝܪ ܕܡܚܘܬܐ[?] ܀. Pro ἐταχύνθησαν Syrus in apographo suo ἐπαχύνθησαν habuisse videtur. (Constructio per ܝܬܝܪ, sequente ܕ, confirmatione eget; sed ita est in codice.) Post Symmachi fragmentum Colb. affert: Δπ. γρ. δρομέως, idemque τοῖς λοιποῖς tribuit Olymp. Syro-hex. in textu juxta apographum Norberg. habet λαλιᾶς δρομέως; sed in cod. δρομέως est lectio marginalis pro λαλιᾶς. Idem in textu habent Codd. Alex., 249, 257, e Cap. ix. 25, ut videtur, huc translatum.
0027.1.7.en: Syro-hex. ܬ. ܝܘܡܬܐ ܕܝܠܝ ܐܬܥܒܝܘ[?] ܝܬܝܪ ܕܡܚܘܬܐ[?] ܀. For ἐταχύνθησαν the Syriac seems to have had ἐπαχύνθησαν in his copy. (The construction with ܝܬܝܪ followed by ܕ needs confirmation; but so it is in the codex.) After the fragment of Symmachus Colb. gives: Δπ. γρ. δρομέως, and Olymp. ascribes the same τοῖς λοιποῖς. Syro-hex. in the text, according to Norberg's transcript, has λαλιᾶς δρομέως; but in the codex δρομέως is a marginal reading for λαλιᾶς. Codd. Alex., 249, 257 have the same in the text, transferred here, as it seems, from Cap. ix. 25.

0027.1.7.en: Syro-hex. ܬ. ܝܘܡܬܐ ܕܝܠܝ ܐܬܥܒܝܘ[?] ܝܬܝܪ ܕܡܚܘܬܐ[?] ܀. For ἐταχύνθησαν the Syriac seems to have had ἐπαχύνθησαν in his copy. (The construction with ܝܬܝܪ followed by ܕ needs confirmation; but so it is in the codex.) After the fragment of Symmachus Colb. gives: Δπ. γρ. δρομέως, and Olymp. ascribes the same τοῖς λοιποῖς. Syro-hex. in the text, according to Norberg's transcript, has λαλιᾶς δρομέως; but in the codex δρομέως is a marginal reading for λαλιᾶς. Codd. Alex., 249, 257 have the same in the text, transferred here, as it seems, from Cap. ix. 25.

variants.n: „Mich außer Fassung bringen“ statt „mich beunruhigen“.
variants.en: “To confound me” rather than “to distress me.”

0031.0.44.la: “Ἀ. Θ. ἐκθλιβέτω με. Sic Colb., Reg. unus. Sed Colb. uni Aquilae tribuit.”—_Montef._ Syro-hex. ܐ. ܢܐܠܨܢܝ[?] ܀ ܣ. D 2 […] ܀ ܬ. ܢܬܕܡܪ[?] ܀. (Middeld. Aquilae vindicat, ἐκπλησσάτω (sic) με, propter Cod. 252, ubi ita scriptum est. Sed Syr. ܐܠܨ cum ἐκθλίβειν permutatur Jud. i. 34. ii. 15. 4 Reg. xiii. 22, et saepius; non ita cum ἐκπλήσσειν.)
0031.0.44.en: “Ἀ. Θ. ἐκθλιβέτω με. Thus Colb., one Reg. But Colb. ascribes it to Aquila alone.”—_Montef._ Syro-hex. ܐ. ܢܐܠܨܢܝ[?] ܀ ܣ.

Job 9:35#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ οὐ μὴ φοβηθῶ. Ἀ. αὐτόν.^45

variants.n: „Ihn“ wird als Gegenstand der Furcht ergänzt.
variants.en: “Him” is added as the object of fear.

0032.0.45.la: Syro-hex. ܐ. ܡܢܗ ܀. Middeld.: Ἀ. ἀπ᾽ αὐτοῦ, Syrismum nimis premens.
0032.0.45.en: Syro-hex. ܐ. ܡܢܗ ܀. Middeld.: Ἀ. ἀπ᾽ αὐτοῦ, pressing the Syriac idiom too hard.

Job 9:35#1 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. οὐ γὰρ οὕτω συνεπίσταμαι. Σ. οὐ γάρ εἰμι ἐγὼ ὁ αὐτὸς παρ᾽ ἐμαυτῷ.^46

variants.reading: οὐ γάρ εἰμι ἐγὼ ὁ αὐτὸς παρ᾽ ἐμαυτῷ.^46
variants.n: „Bei mir bin ich nicht derselbe“ statt „so verstehe ich es nicht“.
variants.en: “Within myself I am not the same” rather than “I do not understand thus.”

Job 10:1#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπ᾽ αὐτόν. Ἀ. ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ. Θ. εἰς ἐμαυτόν.^1

variants.n: „Auf mich“ statt „auf ihn“.
variants.en: “Upon me” rather than “upon him.”

0032.1.1.la: Colb., Reg. unus. Lectio ἐπ᾽ ἐμαυτὸν est in Cod. Alex., aliis. Syro-hex. ܥܠܝ.
0032.1.1.en: Colb., one Reg. The reading ἐπ᾽ ἐμαυτὸν is in Cod. Alex. and others. Syro-hex. ܥܠܝ.

Job 10:1#0 Θ..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπ᾽ αὐτόν. Ἀ. ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ. Θ. εἰς ἐμαυτόν.^1

variants.n: „Auf mich selbst“ statt „auf ihn“.
variants.en: “Upon myself” rather than “upon him.”

0032.1.1.la: Colb., Reg. unus. Lectio ἐπ᾽ ἐμαυτὸν est in Cod. Alex., aliis. Syro-hex. ܥܠܝ.
0032.1.1.en: Colb., one Reg. The reading ἐπ᾽ ἐμαυτὸν is in Cod. Alex. and others. Syro-hex. ܥܠܝ.

Job 10:2#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. μή με ἀσεβεῖν δίδασκε. Ἀ. μὴ καταδικάσῃς με.^2

variants.n: „Verurteile mich nicht“ statt „lehre mich nicht freveln“.
variants.en: “Do not condemn me” rather than “do not teach me impiety.”

Job 10:3#0 Ἄλλος.unitText: Ο΄. ἢ καλόν σοι, ἐὰν ἀδικήσω; Ἄλλος· μήτι ἀγαθόν σοι, ὅταν συκοφαντήσῃς;^3

variants.n: Gottes Bedrücken wird erfragt statt des Unrechttuns des Sprechers.
variants.en: God’s oppression is questioned rather than the speaker’s wrongdoing.

0032.1.3.la: Nobil., Reg. unus, et Cod. 248 in marg. Montef. edidit ὅτι pro ὅταν, juxta falsam Drusii scripturam. Quasi scholium affert Nobil.; sed proculdubio aut Aquilae, aut Symmachi, aut utriusque versio est.
0032.1.3.en: Nobil., one Reg., and Cod. 248 in the margin. Montef. printed ὅτι for ὅταν, following Drusius' false reading. Nobil. gives it as a scholium; but without doubt it is the version either of Aquila, or of Symmachus, or of both.

Job 10:4#0 Θ..unitText: Ο΄. Vacabat. ※ Θ. ἢ καθὼς ὁρᾷ ἄνθρωπος, βλέψῃ;^4

variants.n: „Siehst du wie ein Mensch?“ wird ergänzt.
variants.en: “Do you see as a human sees?” is added.

0032.1.4.la: Sic Montef. Versiculus exstat in Ed. Rom., sed deest in Codd. 106, 160, 261. In Syro-hex. et Hieron. asterisco notatur.
0032.1.4.en: Thus Montef. The versicle is extant in the Roman Ed., but is wanting in Codd. 106, 160, 261. In Syro-hex. and Jerome it is marked with an asterisk.

Job 10:5#0 Ἀ. Θ..unitText: Ο΄. ἀνδρός. ※ Ἀ. Θ. ὡς ἡμέραι ↙ ἀνδρός.^5

variants.n: „Wie die Tage“ wird zum Vergleich ergänzt.
variants.en: “Like the days” is added to the comparison.

0032.1.5.la: Syro-hex. in marg. ※ ܐ. ܬ. ܐܝܟ ܝܘܡܬܐ ↙ ܀. Cod. 249: ὡς ἡμέραι ἀνδρός. Hieron.: ※ _tanquam dies_ : _hominis._ Perperam Montef.: ※ ὡς ἡμέραι ἀνθρώπου.
0032.1.5.en: Syro-hex. in the margin ※ ܐ. ܬ. ܐܝܟ ܝܘܡܬܐ ↙ ܀. Cod. 249: ὡς ἡμέραι ἀνδρός. Jerome: “※ _as the days_ : _of a man._” Wrongly Montef.: ※ ὡς ἡμέραι ἀνθρώπου.

variants.n: „Sie bereiteten“ statt „sie formten mich“.
variants.en: “They prepared” rather than “they formed me.”

0032.1.6.la: Schol. apud Nobil. et Codd. 161, 248 in marg.
0032.1.6.en: Schol. in Nobil. and Codd. 161, 248 in the margin.

Job 10:8#1 Ἀ. Θ..unitText: Ο΄. μετὰ ταῦτα μεταβαλών με ἔπαισας. Ἀ. Θ. ἅμα κύκλῳ κατεπόντισάς με.^7

variants.n: „Du vernichtetest mich ringsum“ statt „danach verändertest und schlugst du mich“.
variants.en: “You destroyed me all around” rather than “afterward you changed and struck me.”

variants.n: „Also“ wird als verbindende Partikel ergänzt.
variants.en: “Therefore” is added as a connective particle.

0032.1.8.la: Syro-hex. in marg. ※ ܐ. ܬ. ܗܟܝܠ ↙ ܀. Cod. 55: μνήσθητι οὖν.
0032.1.8.en: Syro-hex. in the margin ※ ܐ. ܬ. ܗܟܝܠ ↙ ܀. Cod. 55: μνήσθητι οὖν.

variants.n: „Du ließest mich tropfen“ statt „du molkst mich“.
variants.en: “You made me drip” rather than “you milked me.”

variants.n: „Du ließest mich gerinnen“ statt ausdrücklich „du machtest mich zu Käse“.
variants.en: “You curdled me” rather than explicitly “you made me into cheese.”

0032.1.10.en: Colb. Thus Cod. Alex. and one other.

Job 10:12#0 Ἀ. Θ..unitText: Ο΄. ἔθου παρ᾽ ἐμοί. Ἀ. Θ. ἐποίησας μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ. Σ. παρέσχες μοι.^12

variants.n: „Du tatest an mir“ statt „du legtest bei mir nieder“.
variants.en: “You did with me” rather than “you placed beside me.”

Job 10:12#0 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. ἔθου παρ᾽ ἐμοί. Ἀ. Θ. ἐποίησας μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ. Σ. παρέσχες μοι.^12

variants.n: „Du gewährtest mir“ statt „du legtest bei mir nieder“.
variants.en: “You granted me” rather than “you placed beside me.”

Job 10:14#0 Ἀ. Θ..unitText: Ο΄. οὐκ ἀθῷόν με πεποίηκας. Ἀ. Θ. οὐκ ἀθῳώσεις με. Σ. οὐ καθαρίσεις με.^14

variants.n: „Du wirst mich nicht freisprechen“ statt „du hast mich nicht schuldlos gemacht“.
variants.en: “You will not acquit me” rather than “you have not made me innocent.”

0032.1.14.la: Colb. Didymus: Οἱ ἄλλοι, οὐκ ἀθῳώσεις με, οὐ καθαρίσεις με, εἶπον. Lectio οὐ καθαρίσεις με est in Codd. 161, 248 in marg.
0032.1.14.en: Colb. Didymus: Οἱ ἄλλοι, οὐκ ἀθῳώσεις με, οὐ καθαρίσεις με, εἶπον. The reading οὐ καθαρίσεις με is in Codd. 161, 248 in the margin.

Job 10:14#0 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. οὐκ ἀθῷόν με πεποίηκας. Ἀ. Θ. οὐκ ἀθῳώσεις με. Σ. οὐ καθαρίσεις με.^14

variants.n: „Du wirst mich nicht reinigen“ statt „du hast mich nicht schuldlos gemacht“.
variants.en: “You will not cleanse me” rather than “you have not made me innocent.”

0032.1.14.la: Colb. Didymus: Οἱ ἄλλοι, οὐκ ἀθῳώσεις με, οὐ καθαρίσεις με, εἶπον. Lectio οὐ καθαρίσεις με est in Codd. 161, 248 in marg.
0032.1.14.en: Colb. Didymus: Οἱ ἄλλοι, οὐκ ἀθῳώσεις με, οὐ καθαρίσεις με, εἶπον. The reading οὐ καθαρίσεις με is in Codd. 161, 248 in the margin.

Job 10:15#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. ἐὰν δὲ ὦ δίκαιος, οὐ δύναμαι ἀνακύψαι. Ἀ. καὶ δικαιωθεὶς οὐκ ἀρῶ κεφαλήν.^15

variants.n: Auch gerechtfertigt erhebt er den Kopf nicht, statt ihn als Gerechter nicht erheben zu können.
variants.en: Even justified he will not raise his head rather than being unable to raise it while righteous.

0032.1.15.la: Nobil., Olymp., Colb., Orat. Syro-hex. vero: ܐ. ܘܟܕ[?] ܐܙܕܕܩܬ ܠܐ ܡܪܝܡ ܐܢܐ ܪܫܐ ܕܝܠܝ ܀.
0032.1.15.en: Nobil., Olymp., Colb., Orat. Syro-hex., however: ܐ. ܘܟܕ[?] ܐܙܕܕܩܬ ܠܐ ܡܪܝܡ ܐܢܐ ܪܫܐ ܕܝܠܝ ܀.

Job 10:16#1 Ἀ. Θ..unitText: Ο΄. πάλιν γὰρ μεταβαλὼν δεινῶς με ὀλέκεις. Ἀ. Θ. καὶ ἐπιστρέψας ἐθαυμάστωσας ἐν ἐμοί.^17

variants.n: Gott handelt erneut wunderbar an ihm statt ihn erneut schrecklich zu vernichten.
variants.en: God again acts wondrously upon him rather than again destroying him terribly.

Job 10:16#2 Ἀ. Θ..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπανακαινίζων ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ τὴν ἔτασίν μου. Ἀ. Θ. ἀνεκαίνισας μάρτυράς σου κατέναντί μου. Σ. καὶ ἀνακαινίζεις σεαυτῷ ἀντικείμενον (s. ὑπεναντίον) μοι.^18

variants.n: „Du erneuertest deine Zeugen gegen mich“ statt „du erneuerst meine Prüfung“.
variants.en: “You renewed your witnesses against me” rather than “you renew my examination.”

0033.0.18.la: Syro-hex. ܐ. ܬ. ܚܕܬܬ ܣܗܕܘܬܐ ܕܝܠܟ ܠܘܩܒܠܝ ܀ ܣ. ܘܡܚܕܬ ܐܢܬ ܐܢܬ[?] ܠܟ ܕܠܘܩܒܠܐ ܠܝ ܀. Haec, fere ut Middeld., Graeca fecimus. Quae si vera sunt, Sym. pro עֵדֶיךָ legisse videtur עָדֶיךָ. Montef. vero, Nobilio auctore, tantum habet: Σ. (sic) μάρτυράς σου κατέναντί μου αὐξάνων: ubi αὐξάνων ad seq. vocab. וְתֶרֶב pertinet. Idem monet, Cod. Colb. hic deficere, amissis quatuor foliis.
0033.0.18.en: Syro-hex. ܐ. ܬ. ܚܕܬܬ ܣܗܕܘܬܐ ܕܝܠܟ ܠܘܩܒܠܝ ܀ ܣ. ܘܡܚܕܬ ܐܢܬ ܐܢܬ[?] ܠܟ ܕܠܘܩܒܠܐ ܠܝ ܀. We have turned these into Greek much as Middeld. did. If they are correct, Sym. seems to have read עָדֶיךָ for עֵדֶיךָ. Montef., however, on the authority of Nobilius, has only: Σ. (sic) μάρτυράς σου κατέναντί μου αὐξάνων: where αὐξάνων belongs to the following word וְתֶרֶב. He also points out that the Colb. Cod. fails here, four leaves having been lost.

Job 10:16#2 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπανακαινίζων ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ τὴν ἔτασίν μου. Ἀ. Θ. ἀνεκαίνισας μάρτυράς σου κατέναντί μου. Σ. καὶ ἀνακαινίζεις σεαυτῷ ἀντικείμενον (s. ὑπεναντίον) μοι.^18

variants.reading: καὶ ἀνακαινίζεις σεαυτῷ ἀντικείμενον (s. ὑπεναντίον) μοι.^18
variants.n: „Du erneuerst dir einen Gegner gegen mich“ statt „du erneuerst meine Prüfung“.
variants.en: “You renew an opponent against me” rather than “you renew my examination.”

0033.0.18.la: Syro-hex. ܐ. ܬ. ܚܕܬܬ ܣܗܕܘܬܐ ܕܝܠܟ ܠܘܩܒܠܝ ܀ ܣ. ܘܡܚܕܬ ܐܢܬ ܐܢܬ[?] ܠܟ ܕܠܘܩܒܠܐ ܠܝ ܀. Haec, fere ut Middeld., Graeca fecimus. Quae si vera sunt, Sym. pro עֵדֶיךָ legisse videtur עָדֶיךָ. Montef. vero, Nobilio auctore, tantum habet: Σ. (sic) μάρτυράς σου κατέναντί μου αὐξάνων: ubi αὐξάνων ad seq. vocab. וְתֶרֶב pertinet. Idem monet, Cod. Colb. hic deficere, amissis quatuor foliis.
0033.0.18.en: Syro-hex. ܐ. ܬ. ܚܕܬܬ ܣܗܕܘܬܐ ܕܝܠܟ ܠܘܩܒܠܝ ܀ ܣ. ܘܡܚܕܬ ܐܢܬ ܐܢܬ[?] ܠܟ ܕܠܘܩܒܠܐ ܠܝ ܀. We have turned these into Greek much as Middeld. did. If they are correct, Sym. seems to have read עָדֶיךָ for עֵדֶיךָ. Montef., however, on the authority of Nobilius, has only: Σ. (sic) μάρτυράς σου κατέναντί μου αὐξάνων: where αὐξάνων belongs to the following word וְתֶרֶב. He also points out that the Colb. Cod. fails here, four leaves having been lost.

Job 10:17#1 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. πειρατήρια. Ἀ. στρατιάς. Θ. δυνάμεις.^19

variants.n: „Heere“ statt „Prüfungen“.
variants.en: “Armies” rather than “trials.”

Job 10:17#1 Θ..unitText: Ο΄. πειρατήρια. Ἀ. στρατιάς. Θ. δυνάμεις.^19

variants.n: „Streitkräfte“ statt „Prüfungen“.
variants.en: “Forces” rather than “trials.”

Job 10:19#0 Ἀ. Θ..unitText: Ο΄. οὐκ ἀπηλλάγην. Ἀ. Θ. ἀπηνέχθην.^20

variants.n: „Ich wurde fortgetragen“ statt „ich wurde nicht entfernt“.
variants.en: “I was carried away” rather than “I was not removed.”

0033.0.20.la: Codd. 137, 138, 255. Montef. ex Reg. uno affert: Ἀ. Θ. οὐκ ἀνηνέχθην.
0033.0.20.en: Codd. 137, 138, 255. Montef. gives from one Reg.: Ἀ. Θ. οὐκ ἀνηνέχθην.

Job 10:21#0 Ἄλλος.unitText: Ο΄. πρὸ τοῦ με πορευθῆναι. Ἄλλος· πρὸ τοῦ με ἀπελθεῖν.^21

variants.n: „Bevor ich weggehe“ statt „bevor ich gehe“.
variants.en: “Before I depart” rather than “before I go.”

0033.0.21.la: Reg. unus. Sic Ald. et codd.
0033.0.21.en: One Reg. Thus Ald. and the MSS.

Job 10:21#1 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ γνοφεράν. Σ. (καὶ) σκεπομένην θανάτῳ.^22

variants.n: „Vom Tod bedeckt“ statt „finster“.
variants.en: “Covered by death” rather than “gloomy.”

0033.0.22.la: Nobil., Polychron., Reg. unus, et Orat. Cf. Hex. ad Psal. xxii. 4.
0033.0.22.en: Nobil., Polychron., one Reg., and Orat. Cf. Hex. on Psal. xxii. 4.

Job 10:22#0 Ὁ Ἑβραῖος.unitText: Ο΄. εἰς γῆν σκότους αἰωνίου. Ὁ Ἑβραῖος· εἰς γῆν σκοτεινὴν ὑπὲρ τὸ σκότος.^23

variants.reading: · εἰς γῆν σκοτεινὴν ὑπὲρ τὸ σκότος.^23
variants.n: „Dunkler als Dunkelheit“ statt „von ewiger Dunkelheit“.
variants.en: “Darker than darkness” rather than “of eternal darkness.”

Job 11:2#0 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. ὁ τὰ πολλὰ λέγων καὶ ἀντακούσεται. Σ. μὴ ὁ πολύλαλος ἀναντίρρητος ἔσται;^1

variants.n: „Wird der Vielredner unwidersprochen bleiben?“ statt „der Vielredner wird Antwort erhalten“.
variants.en: “Will the talkative remain uncontradicted?” rather than “the talkative will receive an answer.”

Job 11:3#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἀντικρινόμενός σοι.^2 Ἀ. καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐντρέπων σε.^3

variants.n: „Keiner beschämt dich“ statt „keiner antwortet dir“.
variants.en: “No one shames you” rather than “no one answers you.”

0033.1.2.la: Syro-hex. in marg.: ἢ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἀνταποκρινόμενός (ܗܘ ܕܡܦܢܐ) σοι. Lectio ἀνταποκρινόμενος est in Comp. et sex codd.
0033.1.2.en: Syro-hex. in the margin: ἢ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἀνταποκρινόμενός (ܗܘ ܕܡܦܢܐ) σοι. The reading ἀνταποκρινόμενος is in Comp. and six MSS.

0033.1.3.la: Sic Codd. 137, 255. Pro ἐντρέπων Montef. ἀνατρέπων edidit, suo an Regii sui errore, incertum.
0033.1.3.en: Thus Codd. 137, 255. For ἐντρέπων Montef. printed ἀνατρέπων, whether by his own error or that of his Reg. is uncertain.

Job 11:4#0 Ε΄..unitText: Ο΄. καὶ ἄμεμπτος ※ Ε΄. γενηθήσομαι ↙ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ.^4

variants.n: „Ich werde werden“ ergänzt ausdrücklich die zukünftige Untadeligkeit.
variants.en: “I shall become” explicitly adds future blamelessness.

0033.1.4.la: Syro-hex. in marg. affert: Ε΄. ※ γεννηθήσομαι (ܐܬܝܠܕ), mendosum apographum vertens. Hieron.: _et sine crimine_ ※ _fui ante eum_ : (rectius, ※ _fui_ : _ante eum_): unde Montef. dedit: ※ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ.
0033.1.4.en: Syro-hex. in the margin gives: Ε΄. ※ γεννηθήσομαι (ܐܬܝܠܕ), translating a faulty copy. Jerome: “_and without crime_ ※ _I was before him_ :” (more correctly, ※ _I was_ : _before him_): from which Montef. gave: ※ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ.

Job 11:5#0 Ἄλλος.unitText: Ο΄. ἀλλὰ πῶς ἄν. Ἄλλος· ἀλλ᾽ εἴθε ἦν ὅπως ἄν.^5

variants.n: Ein ausdrücklicher Wunsch verstärkt „Wie könnte doch“.
variants.en: An explicit wish reinforces “How might.”

0033.1.5.la: Schol. apud Nobil. Idem habet Cod. 248 in marg.
0033.1.5.en: Schol. in Nobil. Cod. 248 has the same in the margin.

Job 11:6#0 Ἀ..unitText: Ο΄. δύναμιν σοφίας. Ἀ. ἀπορρήτους σοφίας. Σ. ἀπορρήτου σοφίας.^7

variants.n: „Geheimnisse der Weisheit“ statt „Kraft der Weisheit“.
variants.en: “Secrets of wisdom” rather than “power of wisdom.”

0033.1.7.la: “Ἀ. ἀπορρήτους σοφίας, si modo verba integra sunt.”—_Nobil._ “Σ. ἀπορρήτου σοφίας. Sic Reg. unus.”—_Montef._ Syro-hex. affert: Σ. ἀπόρρητον (ܠܐ ܡܬܡܠܠܢܐ). Denique Comp. habet ἀπόρρητα σοφίας, quod libenter tam Aquilae quam Symmacho vindicaremus.
0033.1.7.en: “Ἀ. ἀπορρήτους σοφίας, if only the words are intact.”—_Nobil._ “Σ. ἀπορρήτου σοφίας. Thus one Reg.”—_Montef._ Syro-hex. gives: Σ. ἀπόρρητον (ܠܐ ܡܬܡܠܠܢܐ). Finally Comp. has ἀπόρρητα σοφίας, which we would gladly claim for Aquila as well as for Symmachus.

Job 11:6#0 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. δύναμιν σοφίας. Ἀ. ἀπορρήτους σοφίας. Σ. ἀπορρήτου σοφίας.^7

variants.n: „Geheime Weisheit“ statt „Kraft der Weisheit“.
variants.en: “Secret wisdom” rather than “power of wisdom.”

0033.1.7.la: “Ἀ. ἀπορρήτους σοφίας, si modo verba integra sunt.”—_Nobil._ “Σ. ἀπορρήτου σοφίας. Sic Reg. unus.”—_Montef._ Syro-hex. affert: Σ. ἀπόρρητον (ܠܐ ܡܬܡܠܠܢܐ). Denique Comp. habet ἀπόρρητα σοφίας, quod libenter tam Aquilae quam Symmacho vindicaremus.
0033.1.7.en: “Ἀ. ἀπορρήτους σοφίας, if only the words are intact.”—_Nobil._ “Σ. ἀπορρήτου σοφίας. Thus one Reg.”—_Montef._ Syro-hex. gives: Σ. ἀπόρρητον (ܠܐ ܡܬܡܠܠܢܐ). Finally Comp. has ἀπόρρητα σοφίας, which we would gladly claim for Aquila as well as for Symmachus.

variants.n: „Übersehenes“ statt „was du gesündigt hast“.
variants.en: “Things overlooked” rather than “what you have sinned.”

0033.1.10.la: Post οὐρανὸς Cod. Alex. infert: γῆ δὲ βαθεῖα. Sic Syro-hex. in marg. ܐܪܥܐ ܕܝܢ ܥܡܝܩܐ ܀.
0033.1.10.en: After οὐρανὸς Cod. Alex. inserts: γῆ δὲ βαθεῖα. Thus Syro-hex. in the margin ܐܪܥܐ ܕܝܢ ܥܡܝܩܐ ܀.

0033.1.11.la: “Ἄλλ. μετεωρότητας οὐρανοῦ τίς κατεργάσῃ; Drusius [Nobil.] qui haec ut scholion affert. Sed est revera alicujus interpretis.”—_Montef._ Proculdubio est Aquilae, qui μετεωρότης pro גֹּבַהּ interpretatus est Ezech. i. 18, teste Cod. 88. Ceterum τί pro τίς scripsimus ex emendatione Kreyssigii. Vid. Schleusner. _Opusc. Crit._ p. 155.
0033.1.11.en: “Ἄλλ. μετεωρότητας οὐρανοῦ τίς κατεργάσῃ; Drusius [Nobil.], who gives this as a scholium. But it is in truth that of some interpreter.”—_Montef._ Without doubt it is Aquila's, who rendered גֹּבַהּ by μετεωρότης Ezech. i. 18, according to Cod. 88. For the rest, we have written τί for τίς following the emendation of Kreyssig. See Schleusner, _Opusc. Crit._ p. 155.

0033.1.12.la: Nobil. Drusius vertit: _dubitationes quomodo attingas;_ Montef.: _difficultates quomodo adieris;_ uterque ἀπορήσεις pro nomine habens. Rectius Kreyssigius: _dubius haerebis, quomodo pervenias;_ ut haec verba tantum ad מַה־תִּפְעָל pertineant. Ingeniosam conjecturam protulit Valckenaer. _Opusc._ Tom. II. p. 181: πορείας θεοῦ πῶς ἂν ἐφίκοιο; ut haec ad praecedentia Hebraea, הַחֵקֶר אֱלוֹהַּ תִּמְצָא (v. 7) aptentur. Certe ἐφῖκται pro מָצָא Symmacho tribuitur Eccles. ix. 10.
0033.1.12.en: Nobil. Drusius renders: “_doubts, how thou mayest reach them;_” Montef.: “_difficulties, how thou mayest approach them;_” both taking ἀπορήσεις as a noun. More correctly Kreyssig: “_thou wilt be in doubt, how thou mayest arrive;_” so that these words belong only to מַה־תִּפְעָל. An ingenious conjecture

variants.en: Measuring the firmament beyond the earth is explicitly questioned.

0034.0.14.la: Syro-hex. Aquilae continuat: ܕܠܡܐ ܐܦ ܫܘܪܝܪܐ[?] ܠܒܪ ܡܢ ܐܪܥܐ ܬܡܫܘܚ: ܘܦܬܝܐ ܝܬܝܪ ܡܢ ܝܡܐ ܀. Tam lectionem ipsam quam scholium ei appositum, “_Firmamentum_ terram vocat,” exscribendo praeterlapsus est Norberg. Interpres, quisquis fuerit, non אֲרֻכָּה, sed הָרָקִיעַ legisse videtur.
0034.0.14.en: Syro-hex. continues to Aquila: ܕܠܡܐ ܐܦ ܫܘܪܝܪܐ[?] ܠܒܪ ܡܢ ܐܪܥܐ ܬܡܫܘܚ: ܘܦܬܝܐ ܝܬܝܪ ܡܢ ܝܡܐ ܀. Both the reading itself and the scholium attached to it, “He calls the earth the _firmament_,” Norberg passed over in copying. The interpreter, whoever he was, seems to have read not אֲרֻכָּה, but הָרָקִיעַ.

Job 11:10#0 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. ἐὰν δὲ καταστρέψῃ τὰ πάντα, ※ Σ. ἢ συναγάγῃς καὶ ἐκκλησιάσῃς.^16

variants.n: „Oder du versammelst und rufst zusammen“ wird ergänzt.
variants.en: “Or you gather and assemble” is added.

0034.0.16.la: Syro-hex. ܣ. ※ ܐܘ ܡܟܢܫ ܐܢܬ ܘܡܥܕܬܬܐ[?] ܐܢܬ ܀. Hujus lectionis, quae in cod. ad v. 9, ἡ μακρότερα κ.τ.έ., minus recte apposita est, particulam tantum, ܣ. ※ ܐܘ ܡܟܢܫ, quasi post πάντα inserendam affert Middeld. Verbum ܥܕܬܬܐ[?], quod nescimus an aliunde notum sit, per ἐκκλησιάζειν Graecum fecimus, secundum scholium codicis philologicum: ܡܥܕܬܬܐ[?] ܐܢܬ ܡܢ ܥܕܬܐ ܀. Hieronymi versio hexaplaris est: _Quod si everterit omnia ※ aut congregaverit:_ unde Montef. edidit: ויקהיל. ※ ἢ συναγάγῃ.
0034.0.16.en: Syro-hex. ܣ. ※ ܐܘ ܡܟܢܫ ܐܢܬ ܘܡܥܕܬܬܐ[?] ܐܢܬ ܀. Of this reading, which in the codex is less correctly attached to v. 9, ἡ μακρότερα κ.τ.έ., Middeld. gives only a part, ܣ. ※ ܐܘ ܡܟܢܫ, as if to be inserted after πάντα. The verb ܥܕܬܬܐ[?], which we do not know whether it is known from elsewhere, we have rendered into Greek by ἐκκλησιάζειν, according to the philological scholium of the codex: ܡܥܕܬܬܐ[?] ܐܢܬ ܡܢ ܥܕܬܐ ܀. Jerome's Hexaplaric version is: “_But if he shall overturn all things ※ or gather them together:_” from which Montef. printed: ויקהיל. ※ ἢ συναγάγῃ.

Codex exhibet ζωην οσφρυος (sic); unde fortasse colligi potest, Seniores vertisse, καὶ περιζωννύων αὐτοὺς ζώνῃ ὀσφύος αὐτῶν, et περιέδησεν ex Theodotione invectum esse. Alex., following Grabe, Parsons carelessly copied: καὶ περιζωννύων αὐτοὺς ζώνῃ ὀσφύας αὐτῶν. Jerome gives: “※ _And he girded their loins with a belt_ :.”

Theodotioni continuat: ܘܥܡܗ[?] ܒܙܒܢܐ[?]. ܐܢܐ ܐܝܬܝ ܡܢܟܘܢ ܀.

0036.1.9.la: “Orat., Reg. unus, Nicetas [qui Polychronium compilavit] et Drusius. Colb. haec tantum Symmacho tribuit, καὶ ἰατροὶ etc., quibus asteriscum praemittit. 0036.1.9.en: “Orat., one Reg., Nicetas [who compiled Polychronius] and Drusius. Colb. ascribes only these words to Symmachus, καὶ ἰατροὶ etc., to which it prefixes an asterisk. Aliae proponuntur, sed vitiatae et mendosae; nimirum in Ed. Rom.: Ἀ. ὡς ἀπὸ ξύλου εἱρκτῆς. Σ. ἐν ταλαιπωρίᾳ. Regii duo et Orat.: Ἀκ. δὲ καὶ Σύμ., ὁ μὲν, ἐν ταλαιπωρίᾳ, ὁ δὲ, ὑπὸ ξύλον εἱρκτῆς. Unus tamen Reg. habet: ὡς ἀπὸ ξύλου εἱρκτῆς. Nicetas vero ex Polychronio et Olympiodoro: Ἀκ. μὲν καὶ Σύμ., ὁ μὲν, ἐν ταλαιπωρίᾳ, ὡς ὑπὸ ξύλον εἱρκτῆς· ὁ δὲ, ἐν ξυλοπέδῃ, ἐξέδωκεν.”—_Montef._

Here perhaps belongs the anonymous rendering in the margin of Syro-hex. ܒܣܕܐ ܀, _in the stocks._ Cf. on Cap. xxxiii. 11. “We do not doubt that these readings are genuine. 0038.1.8.la: “Duo MSS.” Polychron.: πάλιν δὲ ὁ μὲν Ἑλληνικὸς, ποιήσει θερισμὸν, ἀπὸ τοῦ τέλους εἴρηκεν· ὁ δὲ Ἑβραῖος ἀπὸ τοῦ πράγματος, ποιήσει καρπόν. Haec non cepit Montef., qui τῷ Ἑβραίῳ perverse tribuit, ἀπὸ τοῦ πράγματος ποιήσει καρπὸν, pro Hebraeis, וְעָשָׂה קָצִיר כְּמוֹ־נָטַע: illum vero Ἑλληνικὸν de aliquo trium interpretum intelligit, cum manifeste indicetur ipsa versio LXXviralis.
0038.1.8.en: “Two MSS.” Polychron.: πάλιν δὲ ὁ μὲν Ἑλληνικὸς, ποιήσει θερισμὸν, ἀπὸ τοῦ τέλους εἴρηκεν· ὁ δὲ Ἑβραῖος ἀπὸ τοῦ πράγματος, ποιήσει καρπόν. Montef. did not grasp this, perversely ascribing τῷ Ἑβραίῳ the words ἀπὸ τοῦ πράγματος ποιήσει καρπὸν, for the Hebrew וְעָשָׂה קָצִיר כְּמוֹ־נָטַע: and he understands that Ἑλληνικὸν of one of the three interpreters, whereas the Septuagint version itself is manifestly meant.

variants.n: Warten auf Ablösung statt auf erneutes Entstehen.
variants.en: Awaiting relief rather than coming into being again.

0039.0.14.la: “Has lectiones habent omnes MSS. et Editi. Illud porro Symmachi, ἡ ἁγία φύσις, vitiatum prorsus videtur. An legendum ἡ ἄλλαξις?”—_Montef._ Semlero in _Epist. Crit._ p. 55, legendum videbatur ἡ ἀλλοίωσις, nescio an ex commentariis Olympiodori, qui ait: Ἀκ. δὲ, καὶ Θ., καὶ Συμ., οἱ μὲν, ἐλπιῶ ἕως ἂν ἔλθῃ τὸ ἄλλαγμά μου· ὁ δὲ, ἕως ἂν ἔλθῃ ἡ ἁγία φύσις μου. Ὁ δὲ νοῦς οὗτος· ἐὰν ἐν ᾅδου φυλαχθῶ, προσδοκῶ τὴν παλιγγενεσίαν, καὶ τὴν ἐπὶ τὸ κρεῖττον ἀλλαγὴν καὶ ἀλλοίωσιν. Verum vidit Kreyssigius, qui in _Obss. Critt. in Graecos Jobi Intt._ p. 14, ἡ ἀνάφυσις, _regerminatio_, rescribendum censuit. Vocab. ἀνάφυσις deest in Lexicis, sed in Hexaplis incerto interpreti (quem Symmachum esse affirmant Codd. 139, 255) tribuitur pro Hebr. מֹצָא, Job. xxxviii. 27. Nunc de Syro nostro videndum, qui affert: Ἀ. ἔλθῃ τὸ ἄλλαγμά (ܫܘܚܠܦܐ) μου. Θ. (rectius Σ.) ἔλθῃ ܡܘܥܒܬܐ[?] μου. Syr. ܡܘܥܒܬܐ[?], quod Castello est _germen_, in Syro-hex. commutatur cum βλαστὸς, βλάστημα, ῥάδαμνος, ἀνατολὴ (Jerem. xxiii. 5. Ezech. xvii. 10), ἀνάδοσις (Ezech. xlvii. 12); et hic proculdubio cum ἀνάφυσις.
0039.0.14.en: “All the MSS. and printed editions have these readings. Moreover that reading of Symmachus, ἡ ἁγία φύσις, seems entirely corrupt. Should ἡ ἄλλαξις be read?”—_Montef._ To Semler, in _Epist. Crit._ p. 55, it seemed that ἡ ἀλλοίωσις should be read, perhaps from the commentaries of Olympiodorus, who says: Ἀκ. δὲ, καὶ Θ., καὶ Συμ., οἱ μὲν, ἐλπιῶ ἕως ἂν ἔλθῃ τὸ ἄλλαγμά μου· ὁ δὲ, ἕως ἂν ἔλθῃ ἡ ἁγία φύσις μου. Ὁ δὲ νοῦς οὗτος· ἐὰν ἐν ᾅδου φυλαχθῶ, προσδοκῶ τὴν παλιγγενεσίαν, καὶ τὴν ἐπὶ τὸ κρεῖττον ἀλλαγὴν καὶ ἀλλοίωσιν. The truth was seen by Kreyssig, who in _Obss. Critt. in Graecos Jobi Intt._ p. 14, judged that ἡ ἀνάφυσις, _regermination_, should be written. The word ἀνάφυσις is wanting in the Lexicons, but in the Hexapla it is ascribed to an anonymous interpreter (whom Codd. 139, 255 affirm to be Symmachus) for the Hebr. מֹצָא, Job. xxxviii. 27. Now we must consider our Syriac, which gives: Ἀ. ἔλθῃ τὸ ἄλλαγμά (ܫܘܚܠܦܐ) μου. Θ. (more correctly Σ.) ἔλθῃ ܡܘܥܒܬܐ[?] μου. Syr. ܡܘܥܒܬܐ[?], which in Castell is _sprout_, is interchanged in Syro-hex. with βλαστὸς, βλάστημα, ῥάδαμνος, ἀνατολὴ (Jerem. xxiii. 5. Ezech. xvii. 10), ἀνάδοσις (Ezech. xlvii. 12); and here without doubt with ἀνάφυσις.

0039.0.17.la: Colb., Reg. unus, teste Montef., qui tamen haec ad priorem hujus versus clausulam refert, חָתֻם בִּצְרוֹר פִּשְׁעִי, h.e. _obsignatum in sacculo scelus meum:_ minus probabiliter. Supra Cap. xiii. 4, טָפַל Symmacho est προστίθεσθαι.
0039.0.17.en: Colb., one Reg., according to Montef., who however refers this to the former clause of this verse, חָתֻם בִּצְרוֹר פִּשְׁעִי, i.e. _my transgression is sealed up in a bag:_ less probably. Above, Cap. xiii. 4, טָפַל is for Symmachus προστίθεσθαι.

Job 14:18#0 Θ..unitText: Ο΄. Vacabat. ※ Θ. καὶ πλὴν — ἀπώλεσας.^18

0039.0.18.la: Colb.: Ἐκ Θ. οἱ ε΄, h.e. _Ex Theodotione hi quinque versiculi_, qui in hodiernis τῶν Ο΄ exemplaribus locum habent. Iidem in Ed. Lat. Hieronymi sub ※, et in Syro-hex. sub ※ Θ. leguntur.
0039.0.18.en: Colb.: Ἐκ Θ. οἱ ε΄, i.e. _From Theodotion these five versicles_, which have a place in the present-day copies τῶν Ο΄. The same are read in the Latin Ed. of Jerome under ※, and in Syro-hex. under ※ Θ.

variants.n: Hoffnung wird künftig vernichtet; anschließend Stärkung und Rückruf statt endgültigen Wegstoßens.
variants.en: Hope will be destroyed; then strengthening and recalling replace permanent rejection.

0039.0.20.la: “Σ. οὕτω προσδοκίαν ἀνδρὸς ἀπολέσεις. Sic Colbert. Drusius vero [post Nobil.], προσδοκίαν ἑκάστου ἀνδρὸς ἀπολέσεις.”—_Montef._ Olymp.: ἀνθ᾿ οὗ Σύμμαχος οὕτω, προσδοκίαν ἑκάστου ἀνδρὸς ἀπολήσῃς (sic), ἐκδέδωκε. Plenius Syrus noster, ad codicem exactus: ܣ. ܗܟܢܐ ܣܒܪܐ ܕܟܠ ܓܒܪ ܬܘܒܕ. ܡܚܝܠ ܐܢܬ ܒܟܠܙܒܢ ܠܗ ܕܐܙܠ. ܬܘܒ ܐܢܬ ܕܝܢ ܩܪܐ ܐܢܬ ܠܦܪܨܘܦܗ ܠܗ ܕܫܕܪܬ[?] ܀. “Σ. οὕτως προσδοκίαν ἑκάστου ἀνδρὸς (ita Drusius recte) ἀπολέσεις ἐν παντὶ χρόνῳ, _ut abeat; iterum vero vocas faciem ejus, quem dimiseras._”—_Middeld._ Mirari subit, quo jure V. D. Syriaca ܡܚܝܠ ܐܢܬ, _roborans_, per ἀπολέσεις reddiderit, E 2 ut nihil omnino habeat Syrus, quod vocabulo תִּתְקְפֵהוּ respondeat. Manifestum est verbum aliquod in Syriacis excidisse, idque in fine v. 14, non in principio v. 15, qui a ܡܚܝܠ[?] recte incipit. Hoc suppleto, locus conjectando verti potest: Σ. οὕτως προσδοκίαν ἑκάστου ἀνδρὸς (ἀπολέσεις)· ἐνισχύων διαπαντὸς τὸν ἀπελθόντα, ἀνακαλῶν δὲ τὸ πρόσωπον ᾧ ἐξαπέστειλας.
0039.0.20.en: “Σ. οὕτω προσδοκίαν ἀνδρὸς ἀπολέσεις. Thus Colbert. Drusius, however [following Nobil.], προσδοκίαν ἑκάστου ἀνδρὸς ἀπολέσεις.”—_Montef._ Olymp.: ἀνθ᾿ οὗ Σύμμαχος οὕτω, προσδοκίαν ἑκάστου ἀνδρὸς ἀπολήσῃς (sic), ἐκδέδωκε. More fully our Syriac, checked against the codex: ܣ. ܗܟܢܐ ܣܒܪܐ ܕܟܠ ܓܒܪ ܬܘܒܕ. ܡܚܝܠ ܐܢܬ ܒܟܠܙܒܢ ܠܗ ܕܐܙܠ. ܬܘܒ ܐܢܬ ܕܝܢ ܩܪܐ ܐܢܬ ܠܦܪܨܘܦܗ ܠܗ ܕܫܕܪܬ[?] ܀. “Σ. οὕτως προσδοκίαν ἑκάστου ἀνδρὸς (so Drusius rightly) ἀπολέσεις ἐν παντὶ χρόνῳ, _that he may depart; but again thou callest the face of him whom thou hadst sent away._”—_Middeld._ One may well wonder by what right the learned man rendered the Syriac ܡܚܝܠ ܐܢܬ, _strengthening_, by ἀπολέσεις,

0044.1.3.la: "Colb. habet: Ἐκ Θ. οἱ δ΄. [sc. a τίς ἐστιν usque ad κακίας, v. 5.] ... Post illud, Ἐκ Θ. οἱ δ΄. subjicitur μ° π̄[?] ᾱ. quo significatur, ut puto, solum Theodotionem in primo versiculo haberi, μόνος πρὸς ᾱ. Symmachum deinde indicat pro secundo, tertio et quarto, hoc modo, ※ C. ※ ※ ※."—_Montef._ Idem in Praelimin. p. 69 post C. duo tantum asteriscos habet. "Certo certius est, alterum siglum, π̄[?], non πρὸς, sed Θεοδοτίων significare: sic vero enodantur omnes difficultates, e quibus se non potuit expedire ill. Hexaplorum instaurator, ut ingenue fatetur in Praeliminaribus, necnon in nota ad Cap. xxi. 21 hujus libri. Cf. infra Cap. xx. 23 et xxi. 21, 28."—_Drach._ In Ed. Lat. Hieron. asterisci quatuor versiculis praemittuntur, sed versiculus quartus usque ad voc. ἐτάκησαν extenditur. Syro-hex. habet: ※ Θ. τίς ἐστιν—συνδεθήτω↙. ὅτι καρδίαν—φρονήσεως, ※ διὰ τοῦτο—κακίας↙.
0044.1.3.en: "Colb. has: Ἐκ Θ. οἱ δ΄. [namely from τίς ἐστιν as far as κακίας, v. 5.] ... After that Ἐκ Θ. οἱ δ΄. there is added μ° π̄[?] ᾱ., by which is signified, I think, that Theodotion alone is found in the first versicle, μόνος πρὸς ᾱ. Then it indicates Symmachus for the second, third and fourth, in this way, ※ C. ※ ※ ※."—_Montef._ The same, in the Praelimin. p. 69, has only two asterisks after C. "It is more than certain that the second siglum, π̄[?], signifies not πρὸς, but Θεοδοτίων: and thus all the difficulties are resolved from which the illustrious restorer of the Hexapla could not extricate himself, as he candidly admits in the Preliminaries, and also in the note on Cap. xxi. 21 of this book. Cf. below Cap. xx. 23 and xxi. 21, 28."—_Drach._ In the Latin Ed. of Jerome asterisks are prefixed to four versicles, but the fourth versicle extends as far as the word ἐτάκησαν. Syro-hex. has: ※ Θ. τίς ἐστιν—συνδεθήτω↙. ὅτι καρδίαν—φρονήσεως, ※ διὰ τοῦτο—κακίας↙.

Vid. Job. xviii. 14. xxvii. 20."—_Middeld._ Idem pro ܒܪ̈ܓܠܘܗܝ dedit, πρὸς ποσὶν αὐτοῦ; Rördamus vero ad Jud. iv. 10, κατὰ πόδας αὐτοῦ, invito, ni fallor, Syri nostri usu.
0045.1.11.en: Syro-hex. ܐ. ܚܕܪܐ[?] ܐܬܕܘܕܘܗܝ[?] ܣܪ̈ܝܩܘܬܐ[?] ܘܒܕܪܘܗܝ ܒܪ̈ܓܠܘܗܝ܀ ܬ. ܒܕܪܘܗܝ ܒܪ̈ܓܠܘܗܝ܀ "We have used the word ἀνυπαρξίαι [in English, _non-entities_] for the Syr. ܣܪ̈ܝܩܘܬܐ[?], _false imaginations_, since it is Aquila's ordinary word for the Hebr. בַּלָּהוֹת. See Job. xviii. 14. xxvii. 20."—_Middeld._ The same gave for ܒܪ̈ܓܠܘܗܝ, πρὸς ποσὶν αὐτοῦ; Rördam, however, on Jud. iv. 10, κατὰ πόδας αὐτοῦ, against, unless I am mistaken, the usage of our Syriac.

0045.1.12.la: "Has lectiones mutuamur ex codd. et ex Niceta."—_Montef._ Prior est in Cod. 259; posteriorem habet Nicet. et Cod. Alex.
0045.1.12.en: "We borrow these readings from the MSS. and from Nicetas."—_Montef._ The former is in Cod. 259; the latter Nicet. and Cod. Alex. have.

Job 19:12#1 Θ..unitText: Ο΄. ἐπ᾿ ἐμοὶ, ταῖς ὁδοῖς μου. ※ Θ. καὶ ἡτοίμασαν (s. κατεσκεύασαν) ↙ ἐπ᾿ ἐμοὶ (τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτῶν). Σ. Θ. .. ἐπ᾿ ἐμοὶ τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτῶν.^13

variants.reading: καὶ ἡτοίμασαν (s. κατεσκεύασαν) ↙ ἐπ᾿ ἐμοὶ (τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτῶν).
variants.n: Das Herrichten ihres Weges gegen ihn wird ergänzt.
variants.en: Preparing their way against him is added.

0047.0.13.la: Syro-hex. in textu: ※ ܬ. ܘܐܛܝܒܘ ↙ ܥܠܝ. Idem in marg. ܣ. ܬ. ܥܠܝ ܠܐܘܪܚܐ ܕܝܠܗܘܢ܀ Hieron.: ※ _et fecerunt per me viam suam;_ unde Montef. Graeca sua concinnavit: καὶ ἐποίησαν δι᾿ ἐμοῦ τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτῶν.
0047.0.13.en: Syro-hex. in the text: ※ ܬ. ܘܐܛܝܒܘ ↙ ܥܠܝ. The same in the margin ܣ. ܬ. ܥܠܝ ܠܐܘܪܚܐ ܕܝܠܗܘܢ܀ Jerome: “※ _and they made their way through me;_” from which Montef. composed his Greek: καὶ ἐποίησαν δι᾿ ἐμοῦ τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτῶν.

variants.n: „Ihren Weg gegen mich“ statt „auf mir, meinen Wegen“.
variants.en: “Their way against me” rather than “upon me, my ways.”

Job 19:12#2 Σ. Θ..unitText: Ο΄. ἐκύκλωσαν ἐγκάθετοι. Σ. Θ. καὶ παρενέβαλον κύκλῳ (s. περὶ) τῆς σκηνῆς μου.^14

variants.reading: καὶ παρενέβαλον κύκλῳ (s. περὶ) τῆς σκηνῆς μου.^14
variants.n: Das Lager um sein Zelt ersetzt die Umzingelung durch Auflauernde.
variants.en: Camping around his tent replaces encirclement by ambushers.

0047.0.14.la: Syro-hex. ܣ. ܬ. ܘܫܪܘ[?] ܚܕܪ ܡܫܟܢܐ ܕܝܠܝ܀ Hieron.: ※ _et circumdederunt tabernaculum meum;_ h. e. vertente Montef., καὶ περιεκύκλωσαν τὴν σκηνήν μου. Sed multo certiora sunt ea quae ex Syro-hex. eruimus.
0047.0.14.en: Syro-hex. ܣ. ܬ. ܘܫܪܘ[?] ܚܕܪ ܡܫܟܢܐ ܕܝܠܝ܀ Jerome: “※ _and they surrounded my tabernacle;_” i. e., as Montef. renders, καὶ περιεκύκλωσαν τὴν σκηνήν μου. But what we have drawn from Syro-hex. is much more certain.

variants.n: Die Brüder stehen am Satzanfang; derselbe Abstand wird beschrieben.
variants.en: The brothers stand first in the sentence; the same estrangement is described.

variants.n: „Gast“ statt „Fremdstämmiger“.
variants.en: “Stranger” rather than “foreigner.”

Job 19:17#0 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. προσεκαλούμην δὲ κολακεύων υἱοὺς παλλακίδων μου. Σ. .. υἱοὺς παίδων μου.^18

variants.n: „Söhne meiner Diener“ statt „Söhne meiner Nebenfrauen“.
variants.en: “Sons of my servants” rather than “sons of my concubines.”

0047.0.18.la: Polychron. Montef. e Colb. affert: Σ. καὶ προσεκαλούμην κολακεύων υἱοὺς παίδων μου, Eodem teste, Reg. unus habet: προσεποιούμην etc. (?). Hieron.: _invocabam_ ÷ _blandiens_ : _filios_ ※ _uteri mei._
0047.0.18.en: Polychron. Montef. gives from Colb.: Σ. καὶ προσεκαλούμην κολακεύων υἱοὺς παίδων μου, According to the same, one Reg. has: προσεποιούμην etc. (?). Jerome: “_I called upon_ ÷ _coaxing_ : _the sons_ ※ _of my womb._”

Job 19:19#0 Σ..unitText: Ο΄. οἱ ἰδόντες με. Σ. οἱ συνόμιλοί μου.^20

variants.en: “My companions” rather than “those who saw me.”

variants.en: The bone sticks to skin and flesh rather than flesh rotting within the skin.

0048.0.21.en: "Thus all the MSS. and printed editions."—_Montef._ [Montef. printed κρέει, but κρέᾳ is in Polychron.] Thus Syro-hex., except that it has ἐκολλήθη τὰ ὀστᾶ μου (ܕܒܩܘ ܓܪ̈ܡܝ).

variants.en: “Saved with the skin of my teeth” rather than “my bones cling to teeth.”

0048.0.23.la: Syro-hex. Aquilae continuat: ܘܐܬܦܨܝܬ ܒܡܫܟܐ ܕܫܢ̈ܝ܀
0048.0.23.en: Syro-hex. continues to Aquila: ܘܐܬܦܨܝܬ ܒܡܫܟܐ ܕܫܢ̈ܝ܀

0048.0.24.la: Polychron. et "omnes." Syro-hex. Symmacho continuat: καὶ ἐξέτιλα (ܘܬܠܫܬ) τὸ δέρμα ὀδοῦσιν ἐμοῖς. ("Verbum ܬܠܫ, _evulsit, eradicavit, discerpsit_, apud Chaldaeos vulgare, in Lexicis Syriacis immerito omittitur. Videantur loca haec, in quibus respondet Gr. ἐκτίλλειν: Psal. li. 5. cxl. 6 in marg. Eccles. iii. 2. Jerem. xxiv. 6. etc."—_Middeld._) Fallitur ergo Schleusner. in _Nov. Thesaur._ s. v. ἐκτίλλειν: "Videtur haec versio Aquilae potius esse."

("The verb ܬܠܫ, _he plucked out, uprooted, tore apart_, common among the Chaldeans, is undeservedly omitted in the Syriac Lexicons. variants.en: An iron and lead tablet rather than an iron stylus and lead.

0048.0.28.en: Montef. printed from Colb. and Jerome: ※ εἰς μαρτύριον. Syro-hex. in the text: ἢ (in the margin Θ. εἰς μαρτύριον) ※ ἐν πέτρᾳ ↙ ἐγγλυφῆναι.

Job 20:3#0 Θ..unitText: Ο΄. Vacabat. ※ Θ. παιδείαν ἐντροπῆς μου ἀκούσομαι, καὶ πνεῦμα ἐκ τῆς συνέσεως ἀποκρίνεταί μοι. μὴ ταῦτα ἔγνως ἀπὸ τοῦ ἔτι;^1 Σ. .. (μὴ) τοῦτο οἶδα ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος;^2

variants.reading: παιδείαν ἐντροπῆς μου ἀκούσομαι, καὶ πνεῦμα ἐκ τῆς συνέσεως ἀποκρίνεταί μοι. μὴ ταῦτα ἔγνως ἀπὸ τοῦ ἔτι;^1
variants.n: Das Hören beschämender Zurechtweisung und die Antwort des Geistes werden ergänzt.
variants.en: Hearing shameful reproof and the spirit’s response are added.

0049.1.1.la: Colb.: Ἐκ Θ. οἱ γ΄. Secundum Montef. _tertius_ versiculus est: μὴ ταῦτα ἔγνως ἀπὸ τοῦ ἔτι, ἀφ᾿ οὗ ἐτέθη ἄνθρωπος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς; repugnante usu annotatoris Colb. Etiam Syro-hex. cuneolum post ἔτι ponit, sed verba ἀποκρίνεταί μοι non Theodotioni, sed τοῖς Ο΄ tribuit. Idem pro ἀπὸ τοῦ ἔτι habet ܡܢ ܡܩܕܡ[?], _a principio._
0049.1.1.en: Colb.: Ἐκ Θ. οἱ γ΄. According to Montef. the _third_ versicle is: μὴ ταῦτα ἔγνως ἀπὸ τοῦ ἔτι, ἀφ᾿ οὗ ἐτέθη ἄνθρωπος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς; against the usage of the Colb. annotator. Syro-hex. too places the metobelus after ἔτι, but ascribes the words ἀποκρίνεταί μοι not to Theodotion, but τοῖς Ο΄. The same has for ἀπὸ τοῦ ἔτι ܡܢ ܡܩܕܡ[?], _from the beginning._

0049.1.2.la: Syro-hex. ܣ. ܗܕܐ ܝܕܥ ܐܢܐ ܡܢ ܥܠܡ܀ Montef. affert: Σ. ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος, ut Olymp., Colb., Orat.

Job 20:23#0 Θ..unitText: Ο΄. Vacabat. ※ Θ. εἴ πως πληρώσαι γαστέρα αὐτοῦ.^27

variants.n: Die Absicht, seinen Bauch zu füllen, wird ergänzt.

0050.0.27.la: In textu τῶν Ο΄ juxta Ed. Rom. legitur: εἴ πως εἶ πληρῶσαι γ. αὐτοῦ. Vocula εἶ abest a libris plurimis, etiam a Syro-hex., qui habet: ※ ܕܟܡܐ[?] ܢܡܠܐ ܟܪܣܐ ܕܝܠܗ ↙, h.e. εἴ πως πληρώσαι (s. πληρώσει) γ. αὐτοῦ. "In Colb. notatur Θ, post sequitur ※, et consequenter μ° π̄[?] ἀντὶ τοῦ ὅπως, quo forte significatur solum Theodotionem εἴπως pro ὅπως habere. Sed haec hariolando dicimus."—_Montef._ Cf. ad Cap. xvii. 3.
0050.0.27.en: In the text τῶν Ο΄ according to the Roman Ed. is read: εἴ πως εἶ πληρῶσαι γ. αὐτοῦ. The little word εἶ is missing in most books, also in Syro-hex., which has: ※ ܕܟܡܐ[?] ܢܡܠܐ ܟܪܣܐ ܕܝܠܗ ↙, i.e. εἴ πως πληρώσαι (or πληρώσει) γ. αὐτοῦ. "In Colb. Θ is noted, then follows ※, and accordingly μ° π̄[?] ἀντὶ τοῦ ὅπως, by which perhaps is signified that Theodotion alone has εἴπως for ὅπως. But we say this by guessing."—_Montef._ Cf. on Cap. xvii. 3.

0051.0.7.en: For θαυμάσετε Comp., Ald. and the MSS. have either θαῦμα σχέτε or θαῦμα ἔχετε. Syro-hex., as it seems, θαῦμα ἕξετε (ܕܬܗܪܐ ܢܗܘܐ ܠܟܘܢ).

0051.0.8.la: Nicet. et "omnes," uno excepto Regio, qui ad Sym. habet ἄφθονοι. Parsonsii Codd. 137, 255: Σ. ἄφθονοι γίνεσθε. Cod. 138: Σ. ἄφωνοι γ. Cod. 259: Σ. ἄφθογγοι γ. Denique Schleusner. in _Opusc. Crit._ p. 158 ex Catena MS. Jobi in Bibl. D. Marci n. 21 affert: Σ. ἄφρονοι (sic) γίνεσθε, ἀναλογιζόμενοι τὰ κατ᾿ ἐμέ; quae pro Hebr. פְּנוּ־אֵלַי וְהָשַׁמּוּ posita esse contendit. Sed scriba compilavit Olymp. ad loc., cujus verba sunt: κατ᾿ ἐμὲ δὲ κριτὴν ἐκεῖνό φησιν· ἀναλογιζόμενοι τὰ κατ᾿ ἐμὲ θαυμάσατε κ.τ.ἑ.
0051.0.8.en: Nicet. and "all," except one Regius, which has ἄφθονοι for Sym. Parsons' Codd. 137, 255: Σ. ἄφθονοι γίνεσθε. Cod. 138: Σ. ἄφωνοι γ. Cod. 259: Σ. ἄφθογγοι γ. Finally Schleusner, in _Opusc. Crit._ p. 158, gives from the MS. Catena on Job in the Library of St. Mark, no. 21: Σ. ἄφρονοι (sic) γίνεσθε, ἀναλογιζόμενοι τὰ κατ᾿ ἐμέ; which he contends were put for the Hebr. פְּנוּ־אֵלַי וְהָשַׁמּוּ. But the scribe compiled from Olymp. on the passage, whose words are: κατ᾿ ἐμὲ δὲ κριτὴν ἐκεῖνό φησιν· ἀναλογιζόμενοι τὰ κατ᾿ ἐμὲ θαυμάσατε κ.τ.ἑ.

0051.0.18.la: Syro-hex. affert: ܣ. ܘܡܚܠܠܐܝܬ ܠܐ ܟܪܝܗܐ ܘܠܐ ܡܬܢܓܕܢܐ ܠܫܝܘܠ ܢܚܬܝܢ܀ Middeld. tentat: Σ. καὶ ταχέως (s. συντόμως, s. κούφως) οὐκ ἄρρωστοι (s. οὐ κάμνοντες) _neque excruciati_ εἰς ᾅδην κατέρχονται. Kreyssigius (in Addend. ad Schleusner. _Nov. Thes._ T. V, p. 585) notam hanc e Catena Nicet. p. 365 explicandam suscepit, ubi ex Origene notatur: ἀντὶ τοῦ, μέχρι θανάτου ἀναπαυόμενοι καὶ εὐθυμοῦντες, ἀβασάνιστοι εἰς ᾅδην κατέρχονται. Itaque Syriaca nostra Graece sic restituit: καὶ ἐξαίφνης εὐθυμοῦντες καὶ ἀβασ. εἰς ᾅ. κ.; ut verba εὐθυμ. καὶ ἀβασ. ex Origene in Symmachi reliquias irrepserint. Hoc verum esse potest, modo Graeca magis ad veritatem versionis Syr. conformata fuerint; nam neque ἐξαίφνης in ܡܚܠܠܐܝܬ, neque εὐθυμοῦντες in ܠܐ ܟܪܝܗܐ ullo modo latere potest. Vertimus: καὶ ταχέως ἄνοσοι καὶ ἀβασάνιστοι κ.τ.ἑ. Parsons. e Cod. 255 exscripsit: Ἀ. βασανιστοι εἰς ᾅ. κατέρχονται; ubi pro Ἀ. βασανιστοι manifesto legendum ἀβασάνιστοι. Obiter noto, in v. 14 post λέγει δὲ Syro-hex. in marg. afferre ὁ ἀσεβὴς, quod in textum Codd. III, 254 irrepsit.
0051.0.18.en: Syro-hex. gives: ܣ. ܘܡܚܠܠܐܝܬ ܠܐ ܟܪܝܗܐ ܘܠܐ ܡܬܢܓܕܢܐ ܠܫܝܘܠ ܢܚܬܝܢ܀ Middeld. attempts: Σ. καὶ ταχέως (or συντόμως, or κούφως) οὐκ ἄρρωστοι (or οὐ κάμνοντες) _nor tormented_ εἰς ᾅδην κατέρχονται. Kreyssig (in the Addenda to Schleusner's _Nov. Thes._ T. V, p. 585) undertook to explain this note from the Catena of Nicet. p. 365, where it is noted from Origen: ἀντὶ τοῦ, μέχρι θανάτου ἀναπαυόμενοι καὶ εὐθυμοῦντες, ἀβασάνιστοι εἰς ᾅδην κατέρχονται. Accordingly he restored our Syriac in Greek thus: καὶ ἐξαίφνης εὐθυμοῦντες καὶ ἀβασ. εἰς ᾅ. κ.; so that the words εὐθυμ. καὶ ἀβασ. crept from Origen into the remains of Symmachus. This may be true, provided the Greek were conformed more closely to the truth of the Syriac version; for neither can ἐξαίφνης in any way lie hidden in ܡܚܠܠܐܝܬ, nor εὐθυμοῦντες in ܠܐ ܟܪܝܗܐ. We render: καὶ ταχέως ἄνοσοι καὶ ἀβασάνιστοι κ.τ.ἑ. Parsons copied from Cod. 255: Ἀ. βασανιστοι εἰς ᾅ. κατέρχονται; where for Ἀ. βασανιστοι one should manifestly read ἀβασάνιστοι. I note in passing that in v. 14, after λέγει δὲ, Syro-hex. gives in the margin ὁ ἀσεβὴς, which crept into the text of Codd. III, 254.

The Syriac, however, contracted the two versions, as being not dissimilar in sense, into one.
